zh: 像潮水一样慢慢把呼气拉长。
en: Stretch the exhale like a slow tide.

zh: 让吸气和呼气像走进安静树林那样稳定。
en: Steady inhale and exhale like entering a quiet forest.

zh: 把身体里的热和急一点点放出去。
en: Let emotional heat leave a little at a time.

zh: 让节拍更克制，把注意力收回到呼吸效率。
en: A more disciplined pace focused on efficiency and recovery.

zh: 把注意力带回一进一出的稳定脉冲。
en: Pull attention back into the pulse of breathing.

zh: 建立腹式呼吸手感的默认训练。
en: Default mode for learning diaphragmatic breathing.

zh: 用鼻吸鼻呼，吸气时腹部向外，呼气时腹部回落。适合作为日常基础练习。
en: Nasal inhale and exhale with a belly expansion on inhale and release on exhale.

zh: 肩颈保持放松，胸口不过度抬起，让腹部带动节奏。
en: Keep the shoulders soft and let the belly, not the chest, drive the motion.

zh: 适合早晨开始、久坐后重新调整呼吸，或学习间隙做基础稳态练习。
en: Use at the start of the day, after long sitting, or between study blocks.

zh: 腹式呼吸在健康成年人研究中与压力下降、注意力改善相关，适合作为入门训练。
en: Diaphragmatic breathing has been linked to lower stress and better attention in healthy adults.

zh: 降低辅助呼吸肌紧张，提升膈肌参与度，让呼吸更深、更稳。
en: It shifts work toward the diaphragm and away from unnecessary upper-body tension.

zh: 开工前、阅读前、任务切换时的安静聚焦。
en: A quiet focusing rhythm before deep work, reading, or task switching.

zh: 全程鼻吸鼻呼，不加屏息，让注意力稳定贴住呼吸。
en: Nasal-only breathing without holds keeps attention anchored without overstimulating.

zh: 吸气和呼气一样长，不追求大口，避免把自己吹得发飘。
en: Keep inhale and exhale equal and avoid over-breathing.

zh: 适合进入深度工作前、阅读前，或想把视线和心绪收回来时。
en: Use before focused work or any time you want to gather your attention back in.

zh: 鼻呼吸与认知网络和情绪线路同步研究有关，适合需要清醒又不想过度调动的人。
en: Nasal breathing has been linked to limbic and cognitive timing, making it useful for calm alertness.

zh: 保留平稳节拍和鼻呼吸的感觉输入，把专注建立在稳定而不是刺激上。
en: It combines a steady rhythm with the sensory pattern of nasal breathing to support stable focus.

zh: 会前、演讲前、任务开始前的节拍稳定。
en: Steady your rhythm before meetings, talks, or demanding tasks.

zh: 四段等长，像在心里画一个正方形，把注意力从外部压力拉回到可控节拍。
en: Four equal sides create a square rhythm that pulls attention back from pressure.

zh: 每一段都保持同样长度，遇到紧张时先守住节拍，不追求更深。
en: Keep each side the same length and prioritize consistency over depth.

zh: 适合高压任务前做 2-5 分钟的稳定化；如果屏息不舒服，改用共振 5-5。
en: Best for a 2-5 minute reset before a demanding task; switch to 5-5 if the holds feel uncomfortable.

zh: 它更偏向节拍控制和注意力锚定，而不是强刺激；适合作为压力前的呼吸校准。
en: It works best as a pacing and attention anchor rather than a high-intensity technique.

zh: 规则计数降低呼吸漂移，让身体和注意力一起回到可预测节奏。
en: The regular counting pattern reduces drift and brings attention back to a predictable cycle.

zh: 如果屏息让你更紧张，请改用“共振慢呼 5-5”或“平息长呼 3-6”。
en: If breath holding makes you more tense, switch to Coherent 5-5 or Calm 3-6.

zh: 任务切换、情绪波动后、想回到稳态时的核心模式。
en: Balanced breathing for transitions and longer regulation sessions.

zh: 均匀吸、均匀呼，适合做 5-10 分钟的稳态练习。
en: Equal inhale and exhale are ideal for longer steady-state regulation sessions.

zh: 让吸气和呼气都保持圆润，不额外加屏息。
en: Keep both directions smooth and rounded without extra holds.

zh: 适合番茄钟之间、情绪恢复期、工作和休息转换时。
en: Use between focus blocks or during transitions between work and recovery.

zh: 接近每分钟 5-6 次的慢呼吸，是 HRV 和压力调节研究中最常见的训练区间。
en: Slow breathing near 5-6 breaths per minute is the most studied range for HRV and regulation.

zh: 更容易进入呼吸和心率同步的节奏，帮助稳定注意力与恢复感。
en: It supports a rhythm that more readily synchronizes breathing and heart-rate dynamics.

zh: 下班、运动后、长时间用脑后的降速模式。
en: A downshift rhythm for after work, exercise, or heavy screen time.

zh: 延长呼气，让身体从高唤醒慢慢回到恢复区。
en: A longer exhale helps the body come down from a high-alert state.

zh: 呼气时下颌放松，肩颈跟着一起往下落。
en: Relax the jaw and let the shoulders drop with the exhale.

zh: 适合连续工作 45 分钟后、通勤结束后，或想慢下来时。
en: Use after long work blocks, after commuting, or whenever you need to slow down.

zh: 长呼气慢呼吸常被用于帮助身体从高唤醒转向恢复和放松。
en: Slow breathing with a longer exhale is commonly used to shift from activation toward recovery.

zh: 把呼气拉长到吸气之上，给副交感占优势留出窗口。
en: Extending the exhale relative to the inhale creates more room for down-regulation.

zh: 焦躁、争执后、心跳偏快时先降强度。
en: A simple de-escalation rhythm for agitation or a racing mind.

zh: 短吸长呼，不额外屏息，在紧张时更容易执行。
en: A short inhale and long exhale are easier to use when you already feel activated.

zh: 先把呼气做完整，再让下一次吸气自然回来。
en: Finish the exhale fully before letting the next inhale arrive.

zh: 适合临时平息情绪、会议前心跳偏快，或刚从压力消息里出来时。
en: Use when emotions are elevated and you need a quick downshift.

zh: 在已经紧张的时候，不带长屏息的长呼气模式通常更容易坚持。
en: When you are already activated, long-exhale patterns without long holds are often easier to sustain.

zh: 优先做完整呼气，帮助降低呼吸频率和防御性肌肉紧张。
en: Prioritizing the exhale can help lower breathing frequency and soften defensive tension.

zh: 准备入睡或夜间醒来后的轻柔节奏。
en: A gentle bedtime rhythm for settling into sleep or returning to sleep.

zh: 不加屏息，保持轻吸长呼，避免把自己练得更清醒。
en: No breath hold, just a gentle inhale and longer exhale so you do not wake yourself up more.

zh: 吸气不追求深，呼气像慢慢放气，越安静越好。
en: Do not chase a deep inhale. Think of the exhale as a slow soft release.

zh: 适合关灯后、半夜醒来后，或想把节奏慢慢带向睡眠时。
en: Use after lights out, after waking in the night, or whenever you want to drift toward sleep.

zh: 睡前慢呼吸与放松干预常用于缩短入睡前的高唤醒阶段。
en: Pre-sleep slow breathing is commonly used to reduce the arousal that blocks sleep onset.

zh: 减少呼吸用力和认知负担，让身体更容易接受“可以睡了”的信号。
en: It lowers effort and cognitive load so the body can accept a quieter bedtime signal.

zh: 更慢、更克制的进阶睡前节律。
en: A slower, more deliberate bedtime rhythm for people already comfortable with slow breathing.

zh: 经典 4-7-8 节律，适合已经能舒适地做慢呼吸的人作为睡前进阶版。
en: Classic 4-7-8 pacing for bedtime, best used as an advanced option if you already tolerate slow breathing well.

zh: 吸气不要过深，重点是安静和耐心地把呼气放长。
en: Do not overfill the inhale. Quietness and a patient exhale matter more.

zh: 适合临睡前 3-5 分钟；如果长屏息让你紧张，立刻改用“睡前轻缓 4-6”。
en: Use for a few minutes right before sleep; switch to Bedtime 4-6 if the long hold feels too strong.

zh: 它属于更慢、更强的节律呼吸变体，适合已经具备舒适慢呼吸基础的人。
en: This is a slower and more demanding paced-breathing variant best suited to experienced users.

zh: 较长屏息和长呼气会显著放慢整体节拍，只适合在舒适区内使用。
en: The long hold and long exhale slow the whole cycle down substantially, so comfort limits matter.

zh: 如果 7 秒屏息让你不舒服，请改用“睡前轻缓 4-6”或“放松延呼 4-2-6-2”。
en: If the 7-second hold feels uncomfortable, switch to Bedtime 4-6 or Unwind 4-2-6-2.
Exhale long like a soft sigh

zh: 从工作模式切回恢复模式。
en: Shift from task mode into recovery mode.

zh: 较长呼气加短恢复停顿，帮助身体从追赶状态切回稳态恢复。
en: A longer exhale plus a short recovery pause help shift the body away from urgency and back to recovery.

zh: 呼气结束后停两拍，感受心率和肩颈一起慢下来。
en: After the exhale, notice the quiet rest and the body slowing down with it.

zh: 适合通勤结束后、冥想前、洗漱后，或作为晚间收尾过渡。
en: Use after commuting, before meditation, or as an evening transition.

zh: 慢速呼吸和较长呼气常用于恢复段、晚间过渡和冥想前的下行切换。
en: Slow breathing with a longer exhale is commonly used for evening downshifts and recovery transitions.

zh: 把长呼气和短暂停顿放在一起，让节奏从“追赶”切回“回收”。
en: The long exhale plus short pause helps the rhythm shift from urgency toward restoration.

zh: 让心跳跟着一起慢下来
en: Let the pulse follow the exhale

zh: 突发紧张、屏幕压迫感、胸口发紧时的短练习。
en: A short drill for acute stress, screen-pressure fatigue, or chest tightness before a task.

zh: 两段吸气后接一段更长的呼气，适合做 1-2 分钟短练，不建议长时间连续做。
en: Two inhales followed by a longer exhale work best as a brief 1-2 minute practice rather than a long session.

zh: 第一次吸气把肺底装满，第二次只补一小口，不要耸肩。
en: Let the first inhale fill low into the ribs, then take only a small top-up inhale without shrugging.

zh: 适合收到压力消息后、会议前胸口发紧、连续工作后呼吸变浅时。
en: Use after stressful messages, before tense meetings, or when long screen time makes your breathing shallow.

zh: 随机对照研究中，cyclic sighing 在数种短时呼吸练习里对改善情绪和降低呼吸频率表现最好之一。
en: In a randomized trial, cyclic sighing was among the strongest brief breath practices for mood and respiratory-rate reduction.

zh: 双吸气帮助重新张开部分肺泡，长呼气负责把整体唤醒往下拉。
en: The double inhale helps reopen underused air sacs, while the long exhale drives the downshift.

zh: 如果出现头晕，立刻停下并恢复自然呼吸；它适合短练，不适合连做很多分钟。
en: Stop immediately if you feel dizzy and return to natural breathing. This works best as a short practice.
Add a small sip of air
Let it out like a long sigh

zh: 给已经能舒适鼻呼吸的人做的短时低氧耐受练习。
en: A short hypoxic-tolerance drill for users who already handle nasal breathing comfortably.

zh: 先慢慢呼出，再做短时间屏息，模拟“空气更稀薄、呼吸更克制”的节律。只建议短练，不建议长时间连续做。
en: A slower exhale followed by a short hold simulates a thinner-air, lower-volume rhythm. Keep it brief rather than turning it into a long session.

zh: 全程保持肩颈松开、嘴唇轻闭，恢复吸气时不要猛吸，只让下一口气安静回来。
en: Keep the neck and jaw soft, lips lightly closed, and let the recovery inhale return quietly instead of gasping.

zh: 只适合白天、静坐或安全站立时短练；更适合已经完成过 BOLT 测试且知道自己余量的人。
en: Use only as a brief daytime drill while seated or standing safely, ideally after a recent BOLT check so you know your margin.

zh: 《学会呼吸》将屏息训练归类为低海拔下模拟高海拔刺激的方法，但强调要按健康状况和 BOLT 余量循序渐进。
en: The Oxygen Advantage frames breath-hold work as a way to simulate altitude stress at low altitude, while emphasizing progression by health status and BOLT margin.

zh: 较长呼气加短时间屏息会提高对空气饥饿的耐受度，把注意力拉回到更安静、更节制的呼吸效率上。
en: The longer exhale and short hold raise tolerance to air hunger and redirect attention toward quieter, more efficient breathing.

zh: 如果你有头晕、胸闷、孕期、心血管不适，或最近状态不稳，请不要练。出现明显不适时立刻停止并恢复自然呼吸。
en: Skip this if you feel dizzy, tight-chested, pregnant, cardiovascularly unwell, or generally unstable. Stop immediately and return to natural breathing if symptoms appear.

zh: 只吸到七成满，不追求大口
en: Inhale only to about seventy percent

zh: 慢慢把气送出去，保持安静
停在第一次明确呼吸欲望前后，不要硬扛
en: Pause around the first clear urge, not beyond
Let the next inhale return quietly

zh: 从 {currentCity} 到 {targetCity}，变化最大的成本是 {biggest}（{biggestValue} 元/月），其次是 {second}。
en: From {currentCity} to {targetCity}, the largest cost change is {biggest} ({biggestValue} CNY/month), followed by {second}.

zh: 同样薪资迁往 {targetCity} 后，月结余会从 {currentBuffer} 元变为 {targetBuffer} 元，差值 {delta} 元。
en: With the same salary in {targetCity}, monthly buffer changes from {currentBuffer} CNY to {targetBuffer} CNY, a delta of {delta} CNY.

zh: 参考数据用于估算。{targetCity} 市中心一居室租金约为 {currentCity} 的 {centerRentRatio} 倍，国际学校预算差为 {educationGap} 元/月。
en: Reference data is for estimation. A central 1-bedroom in {targetCity} is about {centerRentRatio}x {currentCity}; international-school budget differs by {educationGap} CNY/month.

zh: 若想在 {targetCity} 维持当前月结余，目标税前月薪约需 {salary} 元。
en: To keep the current monthly buffer in {targetCity}, target gross monthly salary should be about {salary} CNY.

zh: 常见护照/签证尺寸，请以实际提交要求为准。
en: Common passport/visa size; confirm against the actual submission requirement.

zh: 常用于美签等 2x2 英寸证件照。
en: Often used for 2x2 inch visa photos such as US visa photos.

zh: 该方案已被标记为不考虑，仅保留用于对比。
en: This option is marked as not considered and kept only for comparison.

zh: 扣除税费、住宿和生活成本后月结余为负，需重新核算现金流。
en: Monthly surplus is negative after tax, housing, and living costs; recalculate cash flow.

zh: 月结余低于安全缓冲，意外支出会放大压力。
en: Monthly surplus is below a safe buffer, so unexpected costs may amplify pressure.

zh: 有效时间成本过高，容易压缩学习、休息和生活安排。
en: Effective time cost is high and may squeeze learning, rest, and life planning.

zh: 通勤时间偏长且远程弹性不足，真实体感成本可能高于分数。
en: Commute time is high and remote flexibility is limited, so the lived cost may be higher than the score shows.

zh: 环境压力或健康损耗较高，需要明确边界和恢复空间。
en: Stress or health cost is high; clarify boundaries and recovery space.

zh: 奖金或浮动收入不够确定，不宜全部当作稳定现金流。
en: Bonus or variable pay is uncertain and should not all be treated as stable cash flow.

zh: 录用确定性不足，建议保留备选并确认关键条款。
en: Offer certainty is limited; keep alternatives and confirm key terms.

zh: 稳定性偏弱，需确认合同类型、试用期、续约和退出成本。
en: Stability is weaker; confirm contract type, probation, renewal, and exit cost.

zh: 预计月可支配结余约 {amount} 元，现金流表现较强。
en: Estimated monthly disposable surplus is about {amount} CNY, giving strong cash flow.

zh: 时间成本较低，更容易保留学习、休息和生活空间。
en: Time cost is lower, leaving more room for learning, rest, and life.

zh: 工作节奏和健康边界相对友好。
en: Work rhythm and health boundaries are relatively friendly.

zh: 成长、平台或长期积累的得分较高。
en: Growth, platform value, or long-term accumulation scores well.

zh: 稳定性与确定性较强，适合降低不确定风险。
en: Stability and certainty are strong, helping reduce uncertainty risk.

zh: {city} 的生活成本与偏好匹配度较好。
en: {city} matches the cost-of-living and preference profile well.

zh: 没有明显单项优势，适合作为稳定基线继续对比。
en: No single dimension stands out; use it as a stable baseline for comparison.

zh: 当前只有 {company} 一个有效方案。
{leader} 与 {runner} 差距很小，建议重点看风险和个人偏好。
en: {leader} and {runner} are very close; focus on risks and personal preference.

zh: {company} 暂时领先，但存在高风险项，需要复核。
en: {company} is currently leading, but has high-risk items that need review.

zh: 已使用主头中的 AES-XTS 数据区 key 解密容器数据区开头的有限字节。
en: A bounded leading sample of the container data area was decrypted with the AES-XTS data-area key from the primary header.

zh: 本结果只证明数据区首段可被解密读取；目录浏览和导出使用下方只读文件浏览，不会系统挂载或写入原容器。
en: This only proves the leading data-area sample can be decrypted and read; directory browsing and export use the read-only file browser below and do not system-mount or write the original container.

zh: 首个解密扇区包含 FAT 标签和启动签名，可尝试在 App 内浏览目录。
en: The first decrypted sector contains a FAT label and boot signature; in-app directory browsing can be attempted.

zh: 首段解密成功，但当前启发式未确认 FAT；exFAT、NTFS 和其他布局仍在后续兼容范围内。
en: The leading sample decrypted successfully, but the current heuristic did not confirm FAT; exFAT, NTFS, and other layouts remain future compatibility work.

zh: 已解锁主头，但加密区起点、长度或扇区大小不满足本轮有限只读探测条件。
en: The primary header unlocked but the encrypted-area start length or sector size does not meet this pass's bounded read-only probe requirements.

zh: 只读会话已就绪，可浏览 FAT 卷并导出选中文件。
en: Read-only session ready; you can browse the FAT volume and export selected files.

zh: 缺少可用主头，无法打开只读会话。
en: No usable primary header; cannot open a read-only session.

zh: 需要口令或 keyfile 才能打开只读会话。
en: A passphrase or key file is required to open a read-only session.

zh: PIM 无效，无法打开只读会话。
en: PIM is invalid; cannot open a read-only session.

zh: 解锁材料不受支持，无法打开只读会话。
en: Unlock material is not supported; cannot open a read-only session.

zh: 主头解锁失败，无法打开只读会话。
en: Primary header unlock failed; cannot open a read-only session.

zh: 目录列表为只读；不会创建、修改或删除条目。
en: Directory listing is read-only; entries are never created, modified, or deleted.

zh: 文件内容为只读读取；不会写入容器。
en: File content is read-only; the container is never written.

zh: 文件超过导出上限，已截断导出。
en: The file exceeds the export limit; the export was truncated.

zh: .hc 是 VeraCrypt 文件容器的常见扩展名。
en: .hc is a common VeraCrypt file-container extension.

zh: .tc 常见于 TrueCrypt 旧版容器；兼容解锁需要后续单独验证。
en: .tc is common for legacy TrueCrypt containers; compatible unlock needs separate later validation.

zh: 无扩展名容器符合 VeraCrypt/TrueCrypt 常见用法；仍需口令材料才能后续解锁。
en: Extensionless containers match common VeraCrypt/TrueCrypt usage; later unlock still needs credential material.

zh: 该扩展名不是 .hc、.tc 或无扩展名；本阶段只做结构复核。
en: This extension is not .hc, .tc, or extensionless; this phase only reviews the structure.

zh: AES、Serpent、Twofish、Camellia、Kuznyechik 及 VeraCrypt 官方 XTS 级联已接入主头解锁、数据区读写和创建容器。
en: AES, Serpent, Twofish, Camellia, Kuznyechik, and VeraCrypt's official XTS cascades are wired for header unlock, data-area reads/writes, and container creation.

zh: PBKDF2-SHA512/SHA256/Whirlpool/BLAKE2s/Streebog 与 Argon2id 已接入主头 key 派生；Argon2id 自动候选试探限制在 128 MiB 内，移动端 UI 暂不主动暴露选择入口。
en: PBKDF2-SHA512/SHA256/Whirlpool/BLAKE2s/Streebog and Argon2id are wired for header-key derivation; automatic Argon2id candidate attempts remain limited to 128 MiB, so the mobile UI does not expose an active selector yet.

zh: FAT12/16/32 只读浏览与单文件导出已部分支持（当前已支持的主头 cipher/KDF 组合）；exFAT、NTFS 和隐藏卷仍待评估。
en: FAT12/16/32 read-only browsing and single-file export are partially supported for currently supported primary-header cipher/KDF combinations; exFAT, NTFS, and hidden volumes remain to be evaluated.

zh: FAT12/16/32 已有文件等长写回已部分支持（当前已支持的主头 cipher/KDF 组合，可写文件句柄）；不创建、删除、重命名、扩容或分配簇。
en: Same-size overwrites of existing FAT12/16/32 files are partially supported for currently supported primary-header cipher/KDF combinations with a writable file handle; files are not created, deleted, renamed, expanded, or assigned new clusters.

zh: 已支持服务层创建 AES、Twofish、Camellia 或 AES-Twofish XTS 的 FAT 根目录容器并写入根目录文件；文件名会写成兼容 8.3 短名，目录树、隐藏卷和 Serpent/Kuznyechik 仍待扩展。
en: The service can create FAT root-directory containers with AES, Twofish, Camellia, or AES-Twofish XTS and write root files; file names are stored as compatible 8.3 short names, while directory trees, hidden volumes, and Serpent/Kuznyechik remain future work.

zh: 口令已填写；页面只记录长度，不展示、不记录口令内容。
en: Passphrase entered. The page records only its length and does not display or store the content.

zh: 尚未填写口令；大多数容器后续解锁至少需要口令或 keyfile。
en: No passphrase entered. Most containers need at least a passphrase or keyfile for later unlock.

zh: PIM 留空时按默认 PIM 路线进入后续兼容评估。
en: Blank PIM follows the default-PIM path for later compatibility evaluation.

zh: PIM 格式有效；实际迭代次数和性能成本会在后续解锁阶段评估。
en: PIM format is valid. Actual iterations and performance cost will be evaluated in the later unlock phase.

zh: PIM 必须为空或正整数；请先修正后再进入后续解锁尝试。
en: PIM must be blank or a positive integer. Correct it before a later unlock attempt.

zh: 未选择 keyfile；如果容器创建时使用了 keyfile，后续解锁会缺少材料。
en: No keyfile selected. If the container was created with one, later unlock will lack material.

zh: Keyfile 长度为 0，后续解锁材料不应依赖它。
en: The keyfile length is 0; later unlock material should not rely on it.

zh: Keyfile 指纹已读取；页面不会显示或保存其原始内容。
en: The keyfile fingerprint was read; the page does not display or store its raw content.

zh: 解锁信息可用于容器解密；后续浏览和导出只在 App 内执行，不做系统挂载。
en: Unlock information is ready for container decryption; later browsing and export stay in-app and do not use system mounting.

zh: 主头解密失败，已回退到容器末尾的标准备份头并通过校验；建议尽快修复或重建主头。
en: The primary header failed to decrypt; verification passed after falling back to the standard backup header at the container tail. Consider repairing or rebuilding the primary header soon.

zh: 主头窗口不足 512 字节，无法执行解密验证。
en: The primary header window is smaller than 512 bytes, so decryption cannot be verified.

zh: PIM 必须为空或不超过 VeraCrypt 上限的正十进制整数。
en: PIM must be empty or a positive decimal integer within the VeraCrypt limit.

zh: 请先输入口令或选择 keyfile，再尝试解锁主头。
en: Enter a passphrase or choose a keyfile before trying to unlock the primary header.

zh: 当前仅支持 VeraCrypt 128 字节以内的 UTF-8 口令材料。
en: Only VeraCrypt UTF-8 passphrase material up to 128 bytes is supported in this pass.

zh: 已通过 VERA magic、头字段 CRC 与 master key 区 CRC 校验。
en: VERA magic, header-field CRC, and master-key-area CRC all verified.

zh: 本结果只证明主头可解密；文件浏览和导出需继续打开只读文件浏览，不会系统挂载或写入原容器。
en: This only proves the primary header can be decrypted; file browsing and export require opening the read-only file browser and do not system-mount or write the original container.

zh: 当前候选 cipher/KDF 组合均未通过 magic 与 CRC 校验。
en: Current candidate cipher/KDF combinations did not pass magic and CRC validation.

zh: 可能原因包括口令/PIM/keyfile 不匹配，或容器使用了 Serpent/Kuznyechik、BLAKE2s/Streebog、隐藏头等尚未接入路径。
en: Possible causes include mismatched passphrase/PIM/keyfile, or a container using Serpent/Kuznyechik, BLAKE2s/Streebog, hidden headers, or another path that is not wired yet.

zh: 尚未读取容器。请选择本机可访问的文件容器。
en: No container has been read. Choose a locally accessible file container.

zh: 该文件小于 VeraCrypt 文件卷头部和备份头区域所需的最小布局。
en: This file is smaller than the minimum layout needed for VeraCrypt file-volume headers and backup headers.

zh: 主卷头窗口位于文件开头 512 字节。
en: The primary volume header window is the first 512 bytes of the file.

zh: 隐藏卷头候选窗口位于 64 KiB 偏移处；本阶段只识别窗口，不判断是否存在隐藏卷。
en: The hidden-volume header candidate window starts at the 64 KiB offset; this phase identifies the window but does not determine whether a hidden volume exists.

zh: 备份头位于文件末尾 128 KiB 区域内，不是简单的最后 512 字节。
en: Backup headers sit inside the final 128 KiB area, not simply the last 512 bytes.

zh: Salt 指纹来自每个 512 字节头部窗口前 64 字节，只用于区分窗口，不证明口令正确或隐藏卷存在。
en: Salt fingerprints come from the first 64 bytes of each 512-byte header window. They only distinguish windows and do not prove a correct passphrase or hidden volume.

zh: 当前阶段是检查器：不会写入容器，不会修改源文件。
en: This phase is an inspector: it does not write the container or modify the source file.

zh: 移动端路线是 App 内只读浏览/导出，不提供系统盘符或全局文件系统挂载。
en: The mobile path is app-internal read-only browsing/export, not a drive letter or global filesystem mount.

zh: 默认以双休 40 小时工作周作为对照。
en: The default comparison uses a five-day, 40-hour workweek.

zh: 单程通勤超过 1 小时会明显侵蚀可支配时间。
en: A one-way commute over 1 hour noticeably eats into discretionary time.

zh: 带薪休假越多，长期恢复能力越强。
en: More paid leave improves long-term recovery capacity.

zh: 法定假日和调休安排会影响实际工作天数。
en: Public holidays and adjusted schedules affect real working days.

zh: 月结余低于收入 30% 时，风险承受能力会下降。
en: When monthly surplus is below 30% of income, risk tolerance drops.

zh: 高压环境需要预留健康恢复成本。
en: High-pressure environments require reserved health recovery cost.

zh: 先稳住起床、晨光和晚间减光，再慢慢把夜里的节奏拉回来。
en: Stabilize wake time, morning light, and evening dim-down first.

zh: 醒来后尽快接触自然光
优先处理夜醒挣扎和床上清醒过久的问题，再看要不要收紧睡眠窗口。
en: Address long awake time in bed before adding stricter sleep work.

zh: 学习夜醒后的离床策略
en: Use a leave-bed strategy when fully awake

zh: 重点看晨起恢复感、午后低谷和白天行为怎样拖累了夜里。
en: Focus on daytime behaviors that drag down the night.

zh: 先清掉卧室里最明显的刺激和不适，再看更细的习惯。
en: Fix the most obvious bedroom stressors first.
Make the room darker and cooler

zh: 把工作和手机移出床边
en: Keep work and phones away from bed

zh: 记录哪些环境更影响夜醒
优先降低睡前唤醒水平，让脑子和身体都慢慢收下来。
en: Lower bedtime activation with a softer wind-down.

zh: 用轻柔呼吸代替硬扛入睡
en: Use gentle breathing instead of forcing sleep

zh: 先连续记录几天，找出真正拖累睡眠的主因。
en: Track a few days first and identify the main drag on sleep.

zh: 先记 3 到 7 天睡眠日志

en: Change one thing at a time

zh: 先别加任务，保持低刺激，看看困意会不会自己回来。
en: Keep things low-stim and give the sleep drive a chance to return.

zh: 如果你明显越来越清醒，先离开床，去做一件枯燥又不刺激的事。
en: If you are fully awake, leave bed and do something calm and boring.

zh: 不要在床上继续解决问题，先把念头停放下来，再回到呼吸。
en: Stop problem-solving in bed, park the thoughts, then return to breathing.

zh: 先让身体降下来，做轻柔呼气或放松动作，不追求立刻睡着。
en: Lower body activation first with a softer exhale or a small release.

zh: 先处理冷热和不适，再决定要不要离床。
en: Adjust temperature discomfort first, then decide whether to leave bed.

zh: 焦点锁定已激活。长按解锁栏以退出焦点。
en: Focus lock is active. Long press the unlock bar to exit focus.

zh: 这将关闭当前应用。继续？
en: This will close the current app. Continue?

zh: 今天没有安排的待办事项。
en: No active todos scheduled for today.

zh: 暂时无法加载每日语录。
en: Unable to load the daily quote right now.
Unable to load weather right now.

zh: 初始下载未完成。打开时资源仍会按需下载。
en: Initial downloads did not finish. Resources will still download on demand when opened.

zh: 正在解析和导入，请稍候...
{label} 当前已禁用。请在模块管理中重新启用。
en: {label} is currently disabled. Re-enable it in module management.

zh: 没有找到匹配的单词。可以清空搜索或切换词书
en: No matching words found. Clear search or switch wordbooks

zh: 当前词书还没有词条。可以新增单词、管理词书或切换到其他词书
en: The current wordbook has no words yet. Add words or manage wordbooks or switch to another one
No wordbook ready to play yet

zh: 当前搜索没有可播放单词
en: No playable words in this search

zh: 当前词书没有可播放单词
en: Current wordbook has no playable words

zh: 清除搜索后再播放，或切换到包含单词的词书
en: Clear search before playing or switch to a wordbook with words

zh: 请先在词库添加单词，或切换到其他词书
en: Add words in the library first or switch to another wordbook

zh: 词书已选中但尚未加载
en: Wordbook selected but not loaded yet
No words ready for practice yet

zh: 当前词书没有可练习的单词。请切换词书或先在词库中添加单词
en: The current wordbook has no words to practice. Switch wordbooks or add words in the library first

zh: 一个简短的问卷，用于了解你的睡眠模式并提供个性化指导。
en: A short questionnaire to understand your sleep patterns and get personalized guidance.

zh: 你短暂醒来，想要快速重新入睡。
en: You woke briefly and want to fall back asleep quickly.

zh: 你完全清醒，无法重新入睡。
en: You are wide awake and unable to fall back asleep.

zh: 你的大脑活跃，不停运转。
en: Your mind is busy and keeps spinning.

zh: 你的身体感到紧绷、不安或亢奋。
en: Your body feels tense, restless, or activated.
You feel too hot or too cold.

zh: 为期七天的项目，通过光照和作息锚定来稳定你的睡眠-觉醒节律。
en: A 7-day program to stabilize your sleep-wake rhythm through light exposure and schedule anchoring.

zh: 为期两周的全面睡眠重置，提供每日指导和习惯追踪。
en: A two-week comprehensive sleep reset with daily guidance and habit tracking.

zh: 温和的五步入门程序，帮助管理偶发性失眠。
en: A gentle 5-step starter program for managing occasional insomnia.
Dim only the lights you can reach
Get into bed without adding tasks

zh: 压力对你睡眠的影响程度
en: How much stress impacts your sleep

zh: 屏幕使用如何影响你的就寝时间
en: How screen use affects your bedtime
How often work keeps you up late

zh: 你在临睡前锻炼的频率
en: How often you exercise close to bedtime
How much pain interferes with sleep

zh: 是否出现打鼾或呼吸暂停
en: Whether snoring or breathing pauses occur

zh: 截止时间后摄入咖啡因
截止时间后喝咖啡、茶或能量饮料
en: Coffee, tea, or energy drinks after your cutoff

zh: 晚上使用手机、平板或电脑
en: Phone, tablet, or computer late in the evening
Any alcohol consumed close to bedtime

zh: 醒来后 30 分钟内获得自然光或明亮光照
en: Got natural or bright light within 30 minutes of waking
Checked the clock repeatedly during the night

zh: 使用白噪音、风扇或环境音
en: Used white noise, fan, or ambient sound

zh: 详细记录每晚的结构化睡眠日记
en: A structured sleep diary to track each night in detail.

zh: 通过晨光、咖啡摄入时间和晚间习惯，七天计划稳定你的昼夜节律。
en: A 7-day program to stabilize your circadian rhythm through morning light, caffeine timing, and evening habits.

zh: 半夜醒来时该做什么。选择你的状态并获得逐步指导。
en: What to do when you wake up in the middle of the night. Choose your state and get step-by-step guidance.

zh: 咖啡因的时间安排与腺苷阻断
可视化你的睡眠趋势和模式随时间的变化。
en: Visualize your sleep trends and patterns over time.

zh: 晨光与昼夜节律的固定
起床后 30 分钟内的强光是对你体内时钟最强的信号。
en: Bright light within 30 minutes of waking is the single strongest signal for your internal clock.

zh: 下丘脑视交叉上核（SCN）利用视网膜中 ipRGC 细胞检测到的光来同步你的昼夜节律。晨光可以提前你的生物钟，使你晚上更容易入睡。即使在阴天在户外呆 10-15 分钟，也能提供足够的照度来产生可测量的效果。
en: The suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN) uses light detected by ipRGC cells in the retina to synchronize your circadian rhythm. Morning light advances your clock, making it easier to fall asleep at night. Even 10-15 minutes outdoors on a cloudy day provides enough lux to make a measurable difference.

zh: 醒后30分钟内去户外。前10分钟不要戴太阳镜。
en: Get outside within 30 minutes of waking. No sunglasses for the first 10 minutes.

zh: Czeisler CA 等. 人类昼夜节律起搏器的稳定性、精确性及近24小时周期. 科学 (1999).
en: Czeisler CA, et al. Stability, precision, and near-24-hour period of the human circadian pacemaker. Science (1999).

zh: Duffy JF, Czeisler CA. 光对人类昼夜生理的影响. 睡眠医学临床 (2009).
en: Duffy JF, Czeisler CA. Effect of light on human circadian physiology. Sleep Med Clin (2009).

zh: Blume C 等. 光对人类昼夜节律、睡眠及情绪的影响. 睡眠学 (2019).
en: Blume C, et al. Effects of light on human circadian rhythms, sleep and mood. Somnologie (2019).

zh: 咖啡因通过阻断腺苷受体起作用。它的半衰期为3-7小时，这意味着下午2点喝的咖啡到午夜仍可能影响睡眠。
en: Caffeine works by blocking adenosine receptors. Its half-life is 3-7 hours, meaning a 2pm coffee can still affect sleep at midnight.

zh: 腺苷在白天积累，产生“睡眠压力”。咖啡因暂时阻断腺苷受体，掩盖困意，但不会减少潜在的压力。CYP1A2的基因差异意味着有些人代谢咖啡因的速度比其他人慢得多。
en: Adenosine builds up during the day, creating "sleep pressure." Caffeine temporarily blocks adenosine receptors, masking sleepiness without reducing the underlying pressure. Genetic differences in CYP1A2 mean some people metabolize caffeine much slower than others.

zh: 在你平常睡觉时间前8-10小时设定个人咖啡因截止时间。
en: Set a personal caffeine cutoff 8-10 hours before your typical bedtime.

zh: Drake C, 等. 咖啡因对睡眠的影响：在入睡前0、3或6小时摄入。J Clin Sleep Med (2013).
en: Drake C, et al. Caffeine effects on sleep taken 0, 3, or 6 hours before going to bed. J Clin Sleep Med (2013).

zh: Landolt HP. 基因型差异对睡眠、警觉性及兴奋剂反应的影响。Curr Pharm Des (2008).
en: Landolt HP. Genotype-dependent differences in sleep, vigilance, and response to stimulants. Curr Pharm Des (2008).

zh: Roehrs T, Roth T. 咖啡因：睡眠与白天嗜睡。Sleep Med Rev (2008).
en: Roehrs T, Roth T. Caffeine: sleep and daytime sleepiness. Sleep Med Rev (2008).

zh: 晚间屏幕光，尤其是蓝色波长，通过激活与早晨光线响应相同的ipRGC细胞，可抑制褪黑素。
en: Evening screen light, especially blue wavelengths, can suppress melatonin by activating the same ipRGC cells that respond to morning light.

zh: ipRGC细胞中的褪黑视蛋白光敏色素对约480纳米（蓝光）最敏感。晚间暴露会使生物钟延后，从而更难入睡。然而，效果因人而异，内容刺激可能与光线本身同样重要。
en: The melanopsin photopigment in ipRGC cells is most sensitive to ~480nm (blue) light. Evening exposure shifts the circadian clock later, making it harder to fall asleep. However, the effect size varies widely between individuals, and content arousal may matter as much as the light itself.

zh: 日落后将设备切换到夜间模式。睡前30-60分钟停止使用屏幕。
en: Switch devices to night mode after sunset. Stop active screen use 30-60 minutes before bed.

zh: Chang AM 等人。夜间使用发光电子阅读器对睡眠的负面影响。《美国国家科学院院刊》(2015)。
en: Chang AM, et al. Evening use of light-emitting eReaders negatively affects sleep. PNAS (2015).

zh: Cajochen C 等人。夜间暴露于发光二极管(LED)背光的电脑屏幕影响昼夜节律生理。《应用生理学杂志》(2011)。
en: Cajochen C, et al. Evening exposure to a light-emitting diode (LED)-backlit computer screen affects circadian physiology. J Appl Physiol (2011).

zh: Exelmans L, Van den Bulck J。就寝时使用手机与成人睡眠。《社会科学与医学》(2016)。
en: Exelmans L, Van den Bulck J. Bedtime mobile phone use and sleep in adults. Soc Sci Med (2016).

zh: 最有效的认知行为疗法-失眠 (CBT-I) 技巧之一：将床与睡眠重新关联。
en: One of the most effective CBT-I techniques: re-associate the bed with sleep only.

zh: 当人们在床上清醒时间过长（担忧、工作、看节目）时，大脑会学会认为床是清醒的地方。刺激控制疗法通过规定：只有困了才上床，如果醒着超过20分钟就起床，并且床只用于睡眠，从而打破这一循环。
en: When people spend time awake in bed (worrying, working, watching shows), the brain learns that bed is a place for wakefulness. Stimulus control therapy breaks this cycle by prescribing: only go to bed when sleepy, get up if awake for 20+ minutes, and use the bed only for sleep.

zh: 如果你躺着醒着超过20分钟，就起床，在昏暗的灯光下做一些无聊的事情。
en: If you lie awake for 20+ minutes, get up and do something boring in dim light.

zh: Bootzin RR, Epstein D, Wood JM。刺激控制指导。载于：《失眠案例研究》(1991)。
en: Bootzin RR, Epstein D, Wood JM. Stimulus control instructions. In: Case Studies in Insomnia (1991).

zh: Morin CM 等人。失眠的心理与行为治疗：近期证据的更新。《睡眠》（2006年）。
en: Morin CM, et al. Psychological and behavioral treatment of insomnia: update of the recent evidence. Sleep (2006).
The power of a simple sleep diary

zh: 30秒的睡眠记录能揭示即使是详细睡眠追踪器也会错过的模式。
en: A 30-second sleep log reveals patterns that even detailed sleep trackers miss.

zh: 消费者睡眠追踪器通过运动和心率估算睡眠阶段，但它们的准确性差异很大，并且往往会高估睡眠。一个简单的日记记录上床时间、起床时间和主观休息感，提供了补充数据，揭示了追踪器无法观察到的行为模式。
en: Consumer sleep trackers estimate sleep stages from movement and heart rate, but their accuracy varies widely and they often overestimate sleep. A simple diary capturing bedtime, wake time, and subjective restfulness provides complementary data that highlights behavioral patterns trackers cannot see.

zh: 每晚只需记录3个数据点：上床时间、起床时间以及你的休息感。
en: Log just 3 data points per night: bedtime, wake time, and how rested you feel.

zh: Carney CE, 等. 共识睡眠日记：标准化前瞻性睡眠自我监测。Sleep (2012).
en: Carney CE, et al. The consensus sleep diary: standardizing prospective sleep self-monitoring. Sleep (2012).

zh: Baron KG 等人。感觉被验证了吗？消费者可穿戴睡眠技术的范围综述。《睡眠医学评论》(2018)。
en: Baron KG, et al. Feeling validated yet? A scoping review of consumer wearable sleep technology. Sleep Med Rev (2018).

zh: de Zambotti M 等人。戒指的睡眠：ŌURA 睡眠追踪器与多导睡眠图的比较。《行为睡眠医学》(2019)。
en: de Zambotti M, et al. The sleep of the ring: comparison of the ŌURA sleep tracker against polysomnography. Behav Sleep Med (2019).

zh: 睡眠周期与90分钟的传说
睡眠周期平均约为90分钟，但范围是70-120分钟，并且随着夜间的推移会有所变化。
en: Sleep cycles average about 90 minutes, but the range is 70-120 minutes, and they change across the night.

zh: NREM-REM循环确实大致遵循90分钟的节律，但夜间的第一个循环通常较短（约70分钟），且深睡眠较多，而后面的循环较长（约100-120分钟），REM睡眠较多。自然醒来通常发生在REM阶段，并且可能会让人感觉恢复精力。
en: NREM-REM cycles do follow a roughly 90-minute rhythm, but the first cycle of the night is often shorter (~70 min) with more deep sleep, while later cycles are longer (~100-120 min) with more REM. Waking up naturally often occurs from REM and can feel restorative.

zh: 把90分钟的时间段作为一个大致参考，而不是严格的规则。起床时间的一致性更重要。
en: Use 90-minute windows as a rough guide, not a rigid rule. Consistency of wake time matters more.

zh: Feinberg I, Floyd TC。人类睡眠周期的夜间系统性趋势。Psychophysiology (1979)。
en: Feinberg I, Floyd TC. Systematic trends across the night in human sleep cycles. Psychophysiology (1979).

zh: Carskadon MA, Dement WC。正常人类睡眠概述。载于：《睡眠医学的原理与实践》(2011)。
en: Carskadon MA, Dement WC. Normal human sleep: an overview. In: Principles and Practice of Sleep Medicine (2011).

zh: Achermann P, Borbély AA。睡眠稳态与睡眠调节模型。J Biol Rhythms (1999)。
en: Achermann P, Borbély AA. Sleep homeostasis and models of sleep regulation. J Biol Rhythms (1999).

zh: 睡前进行简短的结构化写作练习可以减少睡前认知激活。
en: A brief structured writing exercise before bed can reduce pre-sleep cognitive arousal.

zh: 睡前认知激活——担忧、计划、回放事件——是入睡困难的主要驱动力。晚上较早安排结构化的“担忧时间”，再加上简短的床边卸载练习（写下最主要的担忧并进行温和的重新框架），可以减少延迟入睡的心理激活。
en: Pre-sleep cognitive arousal—worrying, planning, replaying events—is a primary driver of sleep-onset insomnia. Structured "worry time" earlier in the evening plus a brief bedside unloading exercise (writing down the top concern and a gentle reframe) reduces the mental activation that delays sleep.

zh: 在关灯之前，写下你最担忧的事情，以及一种更温和的看待方式。
en: Write down your top worry and one gentler way to see it before turning off the light.

zh: Harvey AG。失眠的认知模型。《行为研究与治疗》（2002年）。
en: Harvey AG. A cognitive model of insomnia. Behav Res Ther (2002).

zh: Espie CA 等. 注意-意图-努力路径在心理生理性失眠发展中的作用. 睡眠医学评论 (2006).
en: Espie CA, et al. The attention-intention-effort pathway in the development of psychophysiologic insomnia. Sleep Med Rev (2006).

zh: 温度、噪音和光线是影响睡眠质量的三大环境因素。
en: Temperature, noise, and light are the three main environmental factors affecting sleep quality.

zh: 理想的睡眠卧室温度为18-20°C（65-68°F）。核心体温必须下降约1°C才能启动并维持睡眠。过热的房间会阻止这一温度下降。超过40分贝的噪音即使不完全醒来也可能引起觉醒。
en: The ideal bedroom temperature for sleep is 18-20°C (65-68°F). Core body temperature must drop by about 1°C to initiate and maintain sleep. A room that is too warm prevents this drop. Noise above 40dB can cause arousals even without full awakening.

zh: 保持卧室凉爽、黑暗和安静. 尝试18-20°C的温度.
en: Keep the bedroom cool, dark, and quiet. Try a temperature of 18-20°C.

zh: Okamoto-Mizuno K, Mizuno K. 热环境对睡眠和昼夜节律的影响。J Physiol Anthropol (2012).
en: Okamoto-Mizuno K, Mizuno K. Effects of thermal environment on sleep and circadian rhythm. J Physiol Anthropol (2012).

zh: Muzet A. 环境噪音、睡眠与健康。Sleep Med Rev (2007).
en: Muzet A. Environmental noise, sleep and health. Sleep Med Rev (2007).

zh: van Maanen A, 等. 光疗对睡眠问题的影响。Sleep Med Rev (2016).
en: van Maanen A, et al. The effects of light therapy on sleep problems. Sleep Med Rev (2016).
Core body temperature and sleep onset

zh: 需要核心体温下降约1°C才能启动和维持睡眠。
en: A drop in core body temperature of about 1°C is required to initiate and maintain sleep.

zh: 身体的体温调节系统与睡眠调节密切相关。手脚的血管扩张（这就是为什么温暖的手有助于入睡）有助于散热。在睡前1-2小时洗温水澡有悖论地起到帮助作用，因为它将血液引向皮肤表面，触发体温反弹下降。
en: The body's thermoregulatory system is closely linked to sleep regulation. Vasodilation in hands and feet (which is why warm hands help sleep onset) facilitates heat loss. A warm bath 1-2 hours before bed paradoxically helps by drawing blood to the skin surface, triggering a rebound temperature drop.

zh: 在睡前1-2小时尝试洗温水澡或淋浴。保持卧室略凉。
en: Try a warm bath or shower 1-2 hours before bed. Keep the bedroom slightly cool.

zh: Kräuchi K 等人。温暖的双脚促进睡眠的快速开始。《自然》（1999年）。
en: Kräuchi K, et al. Warm feet promote the rapid onset of sleep. Nature (1999).

zh: Raymann RJ 等人。皮肤温度与入睡潜伏期。《生理行为》（2007年）。
en: Raymann RJ, et al. Skin temperature and sleep-onset latency. Physiol Behav (2007).

zh: 午睡：策略性使用与时间安排
20 分钟以下的短午睡可以提高警觉性，不会引起睡眠惯性或干扰夜间睡眠。
en: Short naps under 20 minutes can boost alertness without causing sleep inertia or disrupting nighttime sleep.

zh: 理想的午睡时间为 10-20 分钟（“强效小睡”），可以停留在较浅的 NREM 睡眠阶段，而不会进入深慢波睡眠。较长的午睡（30 分钟以上）可能导致睡眠惯性——醒来时昏昏欲睡——并减少稳态性睡眠压力，使晚间更难入睡。
en: The ideal nap window is 10-20 minutes (the "power nap") which stays in lighter NREM sleep stages before entering deep slow-wave sleep. Longer naps (30+ min) risk sleep inertia—grogginess on waking—and can reduce homeostatic sleep pressure, making it harder to fall asleep at night.

zh: 午睡时间保持 20 分钟以下，最好在下午 3 点前。如果你失眠，完全跳过午睡。
en: Naps under 20 minutes, before 3pm. If you have insomnia, skip naps entirely.

zh: Milner CE, Cote KA. 健康成人午睡的益处. 睡眠研究杂志 (2009).
en: Milner CE, Cote KA. Benefits of napping in healthy adults. J Sleep Res (2009).

zh: Brooks A, Lack L. 夜间睡眠受限后的小睡片刻. 睡眠 (2006).
en: Brooks A, Lack L. A brief afternoon nap following nocturnal sleep restriction. Sleep (2006).

zh: 白噪音可以通过掩盖引起微觉醒的突发环境噪音来起到帮助作用。
en: White noise can help by masking sudden environmental noises that cause micro-arousals.

zh: 白噪音提高了听觉阈值，使突发声音（关门声、交通声、邻居噪音）更难触发醒来反应。该效果在间歇性噪音环境中最为明显，而在持续噪音环境中效果较弱。
en: White noise raises the auditory threshold, making it harder for sudden sounds (door closing, traffic, neighbor noise) to trigger a waking response. The effect is most pronounced in environments with intermittent noise rather than continuous noise.

zh: 将白噪音调到舒适的音量，刚好足以掩盖背景干扰。
en: Set white noise at a comfortable volume, just loud enough to mask background disturbances.

zh: Stanchina ML 等人。白噪声对白噪声环境下ICU噪音暴露受试者睡眠的影响。《睡眠医学》（2005年）。
en: Stanchina ML, et al. The influence of white noise on sleep in subjects exposed to ICU noise. Sleep Med (2005).

zh: Forquer LM, Johnson CM。连续白噪声以减少大学生入睡潜伏期和夜间觉醒。《睡眠催眠》（2007年）。
en: Forquer LM, Johnson CM. Continuous white noise to reduce sleep latency and night wakings in college students. Sleep Hypn (2007).

zh: 一些睡眠症状在自行调理前需要医学评估。
en: Some sleep symptoms warrant medical evaluation before self-guided approaches.

zh: 大声、习惯性打鼾并伴有被目击的呼吸暂停可能提示睡眠呼吸暂停，影响10-30%的成年人，需要医学诊断。腿部不安、慢性疼痛影响睡眠，以及与情绪发作相关的睡眠障碍也需要专业评估。
en: Loud, habitual snoring with witnessed breathing pauses suggests possible sleep apnea, which affects 10-30% of adults and requires medical diagnosis. Restless legs, chronic pain disrupting sleep, and sleep disturbance tied to mood episodes also warrant professional evaluation.

zh: 如果你打鼾很大声，并且尽管睡眠时间充足仍感到不清醒，请咨询医生关于睡眠检查的建议。
en: If you snore loudly and feel unrefreshed despite adequate sleep duration, ask your doctor about a sleep study.

zh: Young T 等. 中年成年人中睡眠呼吸障碍的发生情况. 新英格兰医学杂志 (1993).
en: Young T, et al. The occurrence of sleep-disordered breathing among middle-aged adults. N Engl J Med (1993).

zh: Winkelman JW 等。不安腿综合征的临床实践指南。J Clin Sleep Med (2016)。
en: Winkelman JW, et al. Clinical practice guideline for restless legs syndrome. J Clin Sleep Med (2016).

zh: Baglioni C 等。睡眠与精神疾病：多导睡眠图研究的元分析。Psychol Bull (2016)。
en: Baglioni C, et al. Sleep and mental disorders: a meta-analysis of polysomnographic research. Psychol Bull (2016).

zh: 开始为期7天的节律重置计划
你的评估显示你的睡眠时间不规律。通过专注于固定起床时间和早晨光照的有结构的节律计划，可以稳定你的生物钟。
en: Your assessment suggests an irregular sleep schedule. A structured rhythm program focusing on consistent wake time and morning light can stabilize your circadian rhythm.

zh: 不规律的作息会削弱生物钟信号，使入睡和按时醒来更加困难。
en: Irregular schedules weaken the circadian signal, making it harder to fall asleep and wake up predictably.

zh: 建立一个简短的放松程序
即使是简单的三步睡前程序，也能显著减少入睡时间，通过向大脑传递一天即将结束的信号。
en: Even a simple 3-step pre-bed routine can significantly reduce the time it takes to fall asleep by signaling to your brain that the day is ending.

zh: 思绪纷乱和难以放松对一致的行为程序反应良好。
en: Racing thoughts and difficulty winding down respond well to a consistent behavioral routine.

zh: 优化您的咖啡因截止时间
根据您的敏感度，在通常睡眠时间前 8-10 小时设定严格的咖啡因截止，以保护您的自然睡眠压力。
en: Based on your sensitivity, set a firm caffeine cutoff 8-10 hours before your typical bedtime to protect your natural sleep pressure.

zh: 咖啡因阻断腺苷受体，掩盖大脑启动睡眠所需的睡眠压力。
en: Caffeine blocks adenosine receptors, masking the sleep pressure your brain needs to initiate sleep.

zh: 凉爽、黑暗且安静的卧室有助于身体核心温度自然下降，从而促进睡眠。
en: A cool, dark, and quiet bedroom supports the natural drop in core body temperature needed for sleep.

zh: 环境因素可能干扰生理上进入睡眠的过渡。
en: Environmental factors can interfere with the physiological transition to sleep.
Use temperature to aid sleep onset

zh: 睡前1-2小时洗个温水澡，加上凉爽的卧室，有助于触发睡眠所需的核心体温下降。
en: A warm bath 1-2 hours before bed, plus a cool bedroom, helps trigger the core temperature drop needed for sleep.

zh: 核心体温必须下降约1°C才能启动和维持睡眠。
en: Core body temperature must drop about 1°C to initiate and maintain sleep.

zh: 你的评估指出潜在的风险因素，可能需要在自我引导的方法之外，考虑专业评估。
en: Your assessment flagged potential risk factors that may benefit from professional evaluation alongside self-guided approaches.

zh: 一些睡眠症状有潜在的医学原因，最好由医疗专业人士进行评估。
en: Some sleep symptoms have underlying medical causes that are best evaluated by a healthcare professional.

zh: 继续记录——持续性比细节更重要
你的每日日志记录正在建立一个揭示模式的数据集。继续坚持——即使30秒的记录也会积累。
en: Your daily log entries are building a dataset that reveals patterns. Keep going — even 30-second entries add up.

zh: 多夜的睡眠日记数据可以揭示单晚快照无法发现的规律。
en: Sleep diary data over multiple nights reveals patterns that single-night snapshots miss.

zh: 注意晚间咖啡因摄入模式
你的记录显示有些夜晚接近睡前饮用了咖啡因。即使你能入睡，咖啡因也会减少深度睡眠。
en: Your logs show caffeine consumption close to bedtime on some nights. Even when you can fall asleep, caffeine reduces deep sleep.

zh: 即使不延迟入睡时间，截止时间后的咖啡因也会打乱睡眠结构。
en: Caffeine after the cutoff can fragment sleep architecture even without delaying sleep onset.

zh: 你的睡眠质量与晨间光照有关。尝试在醒后30分钟内到户外待10-15分钟。
en: Your sleep quality correlates with morning light exposure. Try getting outside for 10-15 minutes within 30 minutes of waking.

zh: 晨光是固定昼夜节律的最强时间信号。
en: Morning light is the strongest zeitgeber for anchoring circadian rhythm.

zh: 近期日志显示晚上使用屏幕。睡前30-60分钟切换夜间模式或放下设备可以改善睡眠质量。
en: Late screen use appears in your recent logs. Switching to night mode or putting devices away 30-60 minutes before bed can improve sleep quality.

zh: 晚间蓝光会抑制褪黑素并延迟入睡。
en: Evening blue light can suppress melatonin and delay sleep onset.

zh: 尝试进行担忧释放练习
你的数据中显示出睡前担忧或忙碌的思维模式。睡前进行两分钟的写作练习可以显著降低这种认知激活。
en: Pre-sleep worry or busy-mind patterns show in your data. A 2-minute writing exercise before bed can significantly reduce this cognitive arousal.

zh: 睡前的认知激活是入睡困难的主要原因。
en: Pre-sleep cognitive arousal is a primary driver of sleep-onset difficulty.

zh: 随手准备好夜间应急工具
en: Keep the night rescue tool handy

zh: 近期日志显示夜间醒来。事先计划好低刺激应对措施，可以更从容地处理它们。
en: Night awakenings appear in your recent logs. Having a pre-planned low-stimulation response makes it easier to handle them calmly.

zh: 对夜间醒来的计划应对可以减少焦虑和看时钟的行为，从而缩短清醒时间。
en: A planned response to night waking reduces the anxiety and clock-checking that prolong wakefulness.

zh: 你的记录显示环境因素正在影响你的睡眠。对温度、光线或噪音做一些小调整，可以带来显著改善。
en: Your logs show environmental factors are affecting your sleep. Small adjustments to temperature, light, or noise can make a meaningful difference.

zh: 卧室环境直接影响身体入睡和维持睡眠的能力。
en: The bedroom environment directly impacts the body's ability to initiate and maintain sleep.

zh: 你的数据表明白天嗜睡。如果你打盹，保持在20分钟以内并在下午3点前。如果你失眠，考虑不打盹。
en: Your data suggests daytime sleepiness. If you nap, keep it under 20 minutes and before 3pm. If you have insomnia, consider skipping naps.

zh: 打盹的时间和持续时间不同，会对夜间睡眠起到帮助或干扰作用。
en: Naps can help or hurt nighttime sleep depending on timing and duration.

zh: 早晨光照是你最强大的节律工具。
en: Morning light is your strongest rhythm tool

zh: 你的每周数据显示早晨光照不一致。在起床后30分钟内即使是优先进行10分钟的户外活动，也可以增强你的睡眠—觉醒周期。
en: Your weekly data shows inconsistent morning light. Prioritizing even 10 minutes outdoors within 30 minutes of waking can strengthen your sleep-wake cycle.

zh: 持续的晨光照射是稳定昼夜节律时间最有效的方法。
en: Consistent morning light exposure is the most effective way to stabilize circadian timing.

zh: 你的咖啡因摄入模式可能在降低睡眠质量
en: Your caffeine pattern may be reducing sleep quality

zh: 临近睡前摄入咖啡因与你每周数据中的睡眠效率下降和深度睡眠减少相关。
en: Caffeine close to bedtime correlates with lower sleep efficiency and less deep sleep in your weekly data.

zh: 即使你没有注意到入睡困难，晚间摄入咖啡因也会影响睡眠结构。
en: Late caffeine affects sleep architecture even when you don't notice difficulty falling asleep.

zh: 晚间使用屏幕正在影响你的睡眠
en: Late screen use is affecting your sleep

zh: 你的数据表明，晚间使用屏幕与入睡时间延长之间存在相关性。尝试在睡前保留30-60分钟不看屏幕的时间。
en: Your data shows a correlation between late screen use and longer time to fall asleep. Try a 30-60 minute screen-free buffer before bed.

zh: 屏幕光线和内容引发的兴奋都可能导致入睡延迟。
en: Screen light and content arousal both contribute to delayed sleep onset.

zh: 夜间醒来：准备一份应对计划
en: Night awakenings: prepare a response plan

zh: 你最近的记录显示频繁夜间醒来，提前计划好应对措施可能会有所帮助。关键点：避免查看时间，如果醒着超过20分钟，可以短暂起床。
en: Multiple night awakenings in your recent logs suggest having a pre-planned rescue response could help. The key: avoid clock-checking, and get up briefly if awake 20+ minutes.

zh: 针对夜间醒来的预先计划的应对措施可以减少因挫败感而延长清醒时间。
en: A planned response to night waking reduces the frustration that can prolong wakefulness.

zh: 睡前担忧：一个简单的写作练习可以帮助
en: Pre-sleep worry: a simple writing exercise can help

zh: 你的数据表明焦虑或思绪繁忙评分较高。睡前进行一个结构化的2分钟“卸下烦恼”练习，可以为睡眠清理心理空间。
en: Your data shows elevated worry or busy-mind ratings. A structured 2-minute "worry unload" before bed can clear mental space for sleep.

zh: 睡前的认知兴奋是入睡时间延长的最强预测因素之一。
en: Cognitive arousal before bed is one of the strongest predictors of prolonged sleep onset.

zh: 你的睡眠环境需要关注。
环境投诉（温度、噪音、光线）在多个夜晚出现。持续的卧室优化可以带来累积性益处。
en: Environmental complaints (temperature, noise, light) appear across multiple nights. Consistent bedroom optimization can yield cumulative benefits.

zh: 持续的环境问题对睡眠质量有复合的负面影响。
en: Persistent environmental issues have a compounding negative effect on sleep quality.

zh: 你的总睡眠时间显示出一定的模式
en: Your total sleep time shows a pattern

zh: 你每周的睡眠时长显示出波动。关注固定的起床时间而不是就寝时间——这是调节昼夜节律的更强锚点。
en: Your weekly sleep duration shows variability. Focus on consistent wake time rather than bedtime — this is the stronger anchor for circadian rhythm.

zh: 对于昼夜健康来说，起床时间的一致性比就寝时间的一致性更重要。
en: Wake-time consistency is more important than bedtime consistency for circadian health.

zh: 继续记录您的睡眠以获得个性化建议。
en: Continue logging your sleep to receive personalized suggestions.

zh: 构建你的个性化晚间放松流程。
en: Build your personalized evening wind-down routine.

zh: 基于证据的睡眠知识、参考资料和实用原则。
en: Evidence-based sleep knowledge, references, and practical principles.

zh: 本信息仅供教育用途，不能替代医疗建议。对于持续的睡眠问题，请咨询医疗专业人士。
en: This information is for educational purposes and does not replace medical advice. Consult a healthcare professional for persistent sleep issues.

zh: “总是在一个周期的边界醒来”——睡眠结构比固定的90分钟周期更复杂。
en: "Always wake at a cycle boundary" — sleep architecture is more complex than fixed 90-minute blocks.

zh: “仅靠睡眠卫生无法解决失眠” — 慢性失眠通常需要结构化的认知行为治疗（CBT-I）技术。
en: "Sleep hygiene alone fixes insomnia" — chronic insomnia often needs structured CBT-I techniques.

zh: 一个引导的夜间例行程序，帮助你的身心为睡眠做好准备。
en: A guided evening routine to prepare your body and mind for sleep.

zh: 睡眠评估、记录、放松与夜间应对指南。
en: Assessment, logging, wind-down, and night rescue guides.

zh: 个性化评估、计划与夜间指导。
en: Personalized assessment, plans, and nightly guidance.

zh: 用轻松的认知小游戏转移注意力、放松身心。
en: Light cognitive activities to shift focus and unwind.

zh: 转移注意力的快速认知小游戏合集。
en: Quick cognitive mini-games for focus shifting.

zh: 自我评估认知和行为模式的工具。
en: Self-assessment tools for cognitive and behavioral patterns.

zh: 舒缓音乐、音钵、竖琴、吉他、长笛等声音工具。
en: Soothing audio, singing bowls, harp, guitar, flute, and more.

zh: 精选平静循环配合呼吸灯效果。
en: Curated calming loops with breathing light effects.

zh: 演奏竖琴、钢琴、长笛、尺八、鼓垫、吉他、三角铁、拇指琴、排钟等模拟乐器。
en: Play simulated harp, piano, flute, shakuhachi, drum pad, guitar, triangle, kalimba, chimes and more.

zh: 摇晃手机混合风铃、环境声与鼓劲节拍。
en: Shake your phone to blend chimes, textures, and energizing beats.

zh: 十一种自然调频和四种钵声。
en: Eleven nature-tuned frequencies and four bowl voices.

zh: 用节奏音频提示，为限时专注打拍子。
en: Rhythmic audio cues for timed focus sessions.

zh: 敲击电子木鱼，专注又减压。
en: A digital wooden fish for mindful tapping and stress relief.

zh: 舒尔特方格、呼吸练习等注意力训练工具。
en: Schulte grid, breathing exercises, and attention training.

zh: 经典的注意力训练，记录速度与准确度。
en: Classic attention training with speed and accuracy tracking.
Guided breathing exercises with visual pacing.

zh: 静心念珠、随心沙盘和冥想工具。
en: Mindful beads, finger sand art, and meditation tools.

zh: 轻轻滑动每颗珠子，让心灵在平静的节奏中安定。
en: Gently slide each bead and settle your mind in a calming rhythm.

zh: 用手指在沙子上绘画——一个口袋大小的平静时刻。
en: Draw with your fingertip on sand — a pocket-sized moment of calm.

zh: 实用的日常工具和生活助手。
en: Practical daily utilities and lifestyle helpers.

zh: 加密、哈希与数据安全工具。
en: Encryption, hashing, and data security tools.

zh: 将日常困境变成轻松、可以反复做出的选择。
en: Turn daily dilemmas into light, replayable choices.

zh: 将日常犹豫不决变为可随机、可编辑、可复查的选择。
en: Turn everyday indecision into randomized, editable, reviewable choices.

zh: 将工具拖到此处以便一键访问。点击“管理”以选择您的快捷方式。
en: Drag tools here for one-tap access. Tap "Manage" to pick your shortcuts.

zh: 选择您希望出现在快速面板中的工具。
en: Select the tools you want to appear in the Quick panel.

zh: 建议先做一次 BOLT 测试，确认自己在第一次明确呼吸欲望出现前能稳定停留的秒数。
en: Run a BOLT check first so you know how many seconds you can comfortably stay before the first clear urge to breathe.

zh: 你最近的 BOLT 是 {lastBoltSeconds} 秒。一般建议先把 BOLT 稳定到 20 秒左右，再尝试高海拔模拟。
en: Your recent BOLT is {lastBoltSeconds} s. It is usually better to build toward roughly 20 seconds before trying altitude simulation.

zh: 你最近的 BOLT 是 {lastBoltSeconds} 秒。练习时仍然只停在舒适边界，不要硬扛。
en: Your recent BOLT is {lastBoltSeconds} s. Still stay inside comfort and do not force the hold.

zh: 这是进阶练习，会加入“长呼气 + 呼后屏息”来模拟更稀薄空气下的呼吸约束。请只在白天、静坐或安全站立时短练。
en: This advanced drill adds a long exhale plus an exhale hold to simulate a thinner-air constraint. Use it only briefly during the day while seated or standing safely.

zh: 如果出现头晕、胸闷、刺麻或恢复吸气明显失控，请立刻停止并恢复自然呼吸。
en: Stop immediately and return to natural breathing if you get dizzy, tight-chested, tingly, or lose control of the recovery breath.

zh: 下一步：放下屏幕，保持环境昏暗，直接进入休息。
en: Next: put the screen away, dim the room, and move into rest.

zh: 下一步：立刻开始下一段任务，把刚建立的节拍带进去。
en: Next: begin the next task now while the rhythm is still fresh.

zh: 下一步：恢复自然呼吸 30-60 秒，再决定是否需要再来一次短练。
en: Next: return to natural breathing for 30-60 seconds before deciding whether to repeat.

zh: 下一步：先让呼吸完全恢复安静，再决定是否继续；高海拔模拟之间宁可少做，也不要硬顶。
en: Next: let the breath fully settle before deciding whether to continue; with altitude simulation, less is better than forcing another round.

zh: 下一步：给身体留半分钟安静余量，再进入下一个动作。
en: Next: give the body half a minute of quiet space before the next activity.

zh: 本次练习 {fmtElapsed}，约完成 {cycles} 轮。{scenarioScene}
当前场景没有匹配到可用语音
en: No usable voice cue matched this scenario

zh: 你仍可使用文字提示和轻震动跟练。
en: Text prompts and haptics still work when voice is off.

zh: 优先检查可用语音，并自动判断短节拍是否适合播报。
en: Checking available cues, adapting short stages, and keeping pause stages silent by default.

zh: {shortStageSilentCount} 个短节拍自动改为静默，避免语音压拍
en: {shortStageSilentCount} short stages stay silent to protect timing

zh: 建议先使用文字和震动；如果需要语音，可检查资源包是否完整。
en: Use text and haptics for now; check the voice assets if you need audio guidance.

zh: 先做一次 BOLT 测试，再根据结果决定是该优先练轻柔鼻呼吸、稳态慢呼吸，还是可以进入更进阶的屏息练习。
en: Run one BOLT check first so you can decide whether to prioritize gentle nasal work, steady slow breathing, or more advanced hold work.

zh: 先从腹式 4-2-6-2、平息长呼 3-6 这类低刺激练习开始。
en: Start with lower-intensity drills such as Diaphragm 4-2-6-2 or Calm 3-6.

zh: 先把重点放在鼻呼吸、放松和轻柔呼气，不要追求长时间屏息或高强度空气饥饿。
en: Focus first on nasal breathing, relaxation, and gentle exhales rather than long holds or strong air hunger.

zh: 优先做低刺激练习，并把“停在第一次明确呼吸欲望前后”当作上限。
en: Stay with low-intensity drills and treat the first clear urge to breathe as the ceiling.

zh: 已经可以做稳态慢呼吸和短屏息，但仍应把重点放在安静、鼻吸鼻呼与稳定节律上。
en: You can start using steady slow breathing and short holds, but the priority is still quiet nasal rhythm rather than hard breath-hold work.

zh: 先把 BOLT 稳到 20 秒左右，再考虑高海拔模拟。
en: Build toward roughly 20 seconds before considering altitude simulation.

zh: 你通常已经能承受轻到中等的空气饥饿，可以尝试更明确的节律控制和短时进阶练习。
en: You can usually tolerate mild to moderate air hunger now, which opens the door to clearer pacing work and short advanced drills.

zh: 可以少量尝试高海拔模拟，但恢复吸气仍要安静、可控。
en: You can sample altitude simulation briefly, but the recovery inhale still needs to stay calm and controlled.

zh: 你已经有不错的空气饥饿耐受度，可以把短时高海拔模拟、经典 4-7-8 等更进阶节律作为补充，而不是主训练。
en: You have a solid tolerance to air hunger now, so brief altitude simulation and advanced rhythms like Classic 4-7-8 can work as supplemental drills rather than the main practice.

zh: 继续把鼻呼吸、低刺激恢复和高强度短练搭配使用，不要把每次都练到极限。
en: Keep combining nasal recovery work with short advanced drills, and avoid pushing every session to the limit.

zh: 基础原则先看鼻呼吸与轻柔呼吸，嘴巴更适合吃饭而不是日常换气。
en: Start with nasal and gentle breathing. The mouth is better for eating than for routine ventilation.

zh: 呼吸要安静、平顺、像水流一样连续，不要用力“深吸一大口”。
en: Keep the breath quiet, smooth, and continuous like flowing water instead of forcing a giant inhale.

zh: BOLT 和屏息都停在第一次明确呼吸欲望附近，不做最大憋气测试。
en: For both BOLT and breath holds, stop around the first clear urge to breathe rather than testing a maximal hold.

zh: 用腹部带动节律，肩膀不要跟着抬起；如果一开始不习惯，就先让动作小一点。
en: Let the belly drive the rhythm and keep the shoulders out of it; make the motion smaller if you are just learning.

zh: 把计数感放在节律一致，而不是吸得更大；练完后立刻进入下一段专注任务。
en: Keep the count consistent instead of making the breath bigger, then move straight into the next focus task.

zh: 睡前模式宁可小口、安静，也不要把自己练清醒；如果越练越精神，就退回 4-6。
en: At bedtime, smaller and quieter is better than waking yourself up; step back to 4-6 if the practice makes you more alert.

zh: 把它当作 1 到 2 分钟的短练，练完先恢复自然呼吸 30 到 60 秒，再决定要不要继续。
en: Treat it as a 1-2 minute drill, then return to natural breathing for 30-60 seconds before deciding whether to continue.

zh: 高海拔模拟只停在“明确想呼吸但还能稳住”的边界；恢复吸气必须安静，不能猛吸。
en: In altitude simulation, stop at the edge where the urge to breathe is clear but still controlled, and keep the recovery inhale quiet rather than sharp.

zh: 如果某一段开始费力、发紧或想追求更大口，先把幅度减小，再继续跟节律。
en: If any phase starts to feel effortful or tight, shrink the breath before trying to continue the rhythm.

zh: 展开查看研究依据、身体要点、适用时机和节拍说明。
en: Expand for research basis, body focus, when to use, and cycle flow.

zh: 先坐稳 30 到 60 秒，让呼吸恢复安静，再开始测试。
en: Sit quietly for 30-60 seconds first so the breath settles before you test.

zh: 用鼻子轻轻小吸、轻轻小呼，然后开始计时并捏住鼻子。
en: Take a small inhale and small exhale through the nose, then start timing and pinch the nose.

zh: 在第一次明确想呼吸时就停止，不做最大憋气挑战。
en: Stop at the first clear urge to breathe rather than turning this into a maximal-hold challenge.

zh: 测试后用安静鼻呼吸恢复；如果恢复时想猛吸，说明这次憋得太久了。
en: Recover with quiet nasal breathing. If you need to gasp on recovery, you held too long.

zh: 测的是第一次明确呼吸欲望前的舒适停留，不是拼最长憋气。
en: This measures your comfortable pause before the first clear urge to breathe, not the longest possible hold.

zh: 默认折叠显示摘要，展开后查看步骤、结果解读与推荐练习。
en: Collapsed by default for a compact summary. Expand for steps, interpretation, and drill recommendations.

zh: BOLT 常被用来粗略判断你当前对空气饥饿的耐受度，以及更适合做轻柔练习还是进阶屏息。
en: BOLT is often used as a rough read on your current tolerance to air hunger and whether you should emphasize gentle work or more advanced breath holds.

zh: 当前结果不建议直接进入高海拔模拟，先把鼻呼吸和安静恢复练稳。
en: This score does not suggest going straight into altitude simulation yet. Build nasal breathing and calm recovery first.

zh: 本段剩 {remainStage} 秒 · 第 {rounds} 轮 · 下一步 {nextStageLabel}
默认开启。关闭后会跳过所有屏息步骤，只保留吸气/呼气/停顿。
en: On by default. Turn this off to skip all hold phases and keep only inhale, exhale, and pause.

zh: 关闭后只保留主要呼吸步骤，更适合连续跟练；停顿阶段也不会播报语音。
en: When off, the loop keeps only the main breathing phases for smoother repetition, and pause stages stay silent.

zh: 优先下载并缓存云端语音；语音会跟随吸气/呼气/屏息阶段，停顿阶段默认保持静音。
en: Cloud cues are downloaded and cached first. Voice follows inhale, exhale, and hold phases, while pause stays silent by default.

zh: 显示当前动作、身体提示和倒计时；如果想闭眼练习，可以只保留语音与震动。
en: Show the current action, body prompt, and countdown. Turn this off for eyes-closed practice.

zh: 阶段切换时给轻微触感，适合不盯着屏幕也能跟练。
en: Adds subtle pulses on stage changes so you can follow without staring at the screen.

zh: 针对移动端优化：修复乱码、重做窄屏布局、改进语音播报与短节拍适配，并补充更有依据的训练场景。
en: Optimized for mobile: cleaned copy, improved narrow-screen layout, better cue timing, and more evidence-aware breathing scenarios.

zh: 不要在驾驶、骑行或任何需要持续警觉的场景中使用。若出现头晕、胸闷、刺痛或明显不适，请立刻停止并恢复自然呼吸。睡前与长呼气模式应以舒适为先，不把自己练到缺氧感。
en: Do not use while driving or in any situation that requires continuous alertness. Stop immediately if you feel dizzy, tight-chested, tingly, or clearly uncomfortable. Keep bedtime and long-exhale work comfortably below the point of air hunger.

zh: 呼吸语音指导目前仅支持中文。界面可以保持您当前的语言，但语音提示将以中文播放。
en: Breathing voice guidance is currently recorded in Chinese only. The interface can stay in your current language, but spoken cues will play in Chinese.

zh: 生成本地 RSA/ECC 密钥，完成签名验签，并用 RSA-OAEP 处理小文本加解密。
en: Generate local RSA/ECC keys, sign and verify messages, and use RSA-OAEP for small-text encryption.

zh: 先生成或粘贴密钥，再进行签名、验签或 RSA 小文本加解密。
en: Generate or paste keys before signing, verifying, or using RSA small-text encryption.

zh: 按任务切换密钥生成、签名验签或 RSA 小文本加密。
en: Switch between key generation, signing and verification, or RSA small-text encryption.

zh: 密钥只在本地生成并以模块专用 JSON 文本展示。
en: Keys are generated locally and shown as module-specific JSON text.

zh: 私钥用于生成签名，公钥与签名文本用于验证消息是否匹配。
en: Use the private key to sign, then verify the message with the public key and signature text.

zh: 使用 RSA-OAEP-SHA256 处理短文本；长内容请使用文本加密信封。
en: Use RSA-OAEP-SHA256 for short text; use text encryption envelopes for longer content.

zh: 公钥可直接复制；私钥默认隐藏，只在确认保存时显示。
en: Public keys can be copied directly. Private keys are hidden by default and shown only when you confirm storage.

zh: 私钥已默认隐藏。只有在准备离线保存到安全位置时再显示；显示或复制后请避免截屏、剪贴板同步和共享屏幕。
en: Private key is hidden by default. Reveal it only when you are ready to store it in a secure offline location; avoid screenshots, clipboard sync, and screen sharing after revealing or copying.

zh: 复制私钥会把明文私钥写入系统剪贴板；请尽快粘贴到安全存储，并在平台允许时清理剪贴板历史。
en: Copying the private key writes the plain key to the system clipboard. Paste it into secure storage promptly and clear clipboard history when the platform allows it.

en: Key pair generated. Public key fingerprint: {fingerprint}.

en: This is the original text restored from encrypted media. You can copy it now; file export remains available in the result panel.

en: 32 bytes up to the module limit; 4096 bytes is typical.

en: Key file length must be between 32 bytes and 1 MB.

已生成 {size} 随机密钥文件，指纹 {hash}。
en: Generated a {size} random key file. Fingerprint: {hash}.

en: Image media is invalid or unsupported.

en: Image media dimensions are too large.

en: Encrypted envelope is too large for media encoding.

en: Audio media must be mono PCM16 WAV.

en: Damage simulation requires a naturalized PNG generated by this page.

en: Only HTTPS image URLs are supported.

en: Network image URL cannot point to localhost or a private network.

en: Network image has too many redirects.

zh: 网络响应不是 PNG 图片。
en: Network response is not a PNG image.

zh: 网络图片超过大小限制。
en: Network image exceeds the size limit.

zh: 安全性来自 v5 加密信封；媒体排列只是可校验的无损承载层。
en: Security comes from the v5 encrypted envelope; media arrangement is only a verifiable lossless carrier.

zh: 还原需要同一口令和同一组密钥文件。
en: Restoration requires the same passphrase and the same key-file set.

zh: 可留空，但建议与密钥文件组合使用
en: Can be empty, but pairing with key files is recommended

zh: 限制只作用于当前页面会话；触发后会随机覆写页面内缓存的明文、媒体、输出和密钥材料。
en: Limits apply only to this page session. When triggered the page random-overwrites cached plaintext media output and key material.

zh: 0 表示不限；1-99 次失败后清除页面状态。
en: 0 means unlimited; 1-99 failed attempts clear page state.

zh: 触发后覆写并删除选中媒体
en: Overwrite and delete selected media when triggered

zh: 仅在平台提供真实可写路径时尝试；Web、只读副本或系统托管文件会降级为页面内存清理。
en: Only attempted when the platform provides a real writable path. Web read-only copies and system-managed files fall back to in-page cleanup.

zh: 导出后请保留原始 PNG/WAV 格式，不要重新压缩或转码。
en: After export, keep the original PNG/WAV format and do not recompress or transcode it.

zh: 可将当前加密 PNG 上传到 Uguu 公共临时空间。链接是公开地址，服务策略和可达性可能变化。
en: You can upload the current encrypted PNG to Uguu public temporary storage. The link is public and service policy or reachability may change.

en: Preview the current encrypted WAV carrier audio.

en: Current plain content is {size}; it will be wrapped in an encrypted envelope first.

en: Choose a PNG or WAV generated by this module, then restore it with the passphrase and key files.

zh: 创建会生成新的媒体文件；还原只读取本模块生成的 PNG/WAV。
en: Encode creates a new media file; restore only reads PNG/WAV files generated by this module.

en: Enter text or choose a local file; the output media will be larger than the encrypted envelope.
