输入 HTTPS PNG 地址，或选择本模块生成的本地 PNG/WAV。
en: Enter an HTTPS PNG URL or choose a local PNG/WAV generated by this module.

zh: 网络 PNG 图片地址
PNG 更容易查看色块；WAV 用采样值频谱承载同一加密信封。
en: PNG is easier to inspect as color blocks; WAV carries the same encrypted envelope as sample-value spectrum data.

zh: PNG 以 RGB 色块无损保存加密载荷；重新压成 JPEG 会破坏还原。
en: PNG stores the encrypted payload losslessly in RGB blocks; recompressing as JPEG will break restoration.

zh: WAV 以单声道 PCM16 采样保存加密载荷；转为 MP3/AAC 会破坏还原。
en: WAV stores the encrypted payload as mono PCM16 samples; transcoding to MP3/AAC will break restoration.

zh: 面向本地高性能的多算法文件加密工具，输出可导出的 .vsc 加密信封文件。
en: A local high-performance multi-algorithm file encryption tool that outputs exportable .vsc encrypted envelope files.

zh: 加密生成 .vsc 自描述信封文件；解密从信封文件自动读取算法、级联与校验信息。
en: Encryption creates a self-describing .vsc envelope file; decryption reads algorithm, cascade, and verification metadata from that envelope file.

zh: 选择本地明文文件，输出为带认证元数据的 .vsc 加密信封文件。
en: Choose a local plaintext file; output is a .vsc encrypted envelope file with authenticated metadata.

zh: 选择 .vsc 加密信封文件；算法、级联、MAC 和签名信息会自动识别。
en: Choose a .vsc encrypted envelope file; algorithm, cascade, MAC, and signature metadata are detected automatically.

zh: 可使用口令、一个密钥文件或多个无序组合密钥文件共同派生主密钥。
en: Use a passphrase, one key file, or multiple order-insensitive key files to derive the master key.

zh: 每一轮独立派生密钥，级联顺序写入受认证信封，解密无需手选算法。
en: Each round derives an independent key; cascade metadata is authenticated so decrypt does not require manual algorithm selection.

zh: 点击收起配置。当前摘要会保留在上方，解密时不会显示这些加密侧提示。
en: Tap to collapse settings. The summary stays above; decrypt mode does not show these encryption-side hints.

zh: 点击展开加密配置，可调整算法、派生密钥长度、完整性校验和限制策略。
en: Tap to expand encryption settings for algorithms, derived key size, integrity checks, and limit rules.

zh: 加密时配置当前页面会话限制；触发后会清除内存中的明文、密钥材料和输出缓存。
en: Configure limits for the current page session while encrypting; when triggered, plaintext, key material, and output cache are cleared from memory.

zh: 注意：若设置最大错误/解密次数并开启随机覆写，触发限制后源文件可能被尽力覆写并删除；不需要该行为时请保持次数为 0 或关闭覆写。
en: Warning: if max errors/decrypts and random overwrite are enabled, hitting a limit may overwrite and delete the source file on a best-effort basis. Keep limits at 0 or disable overwrite if you do not want that.

zh: 触发限制时尽力随机覆写源文件
en: Best-effort random overwrite source on limit

zh: 仅当本地路径可用时尝试随机覆写并删除；浏览器或受限平台只清除页面缓存。
en: Attempts random overwrite and delete only when a local path is available; browsers or restricted platforms clear only page cache.

zh: 导出前可核对文件名、大小和 SHA-256 指纹。
en: Review file name, size, and SHA-256 fingerprint before export.

zh: 处理完成后会在这里显示输出文件指纹。
en: The output file fingerprint appears here after processing.

zh: 请先选择要处理的文件。
加密完成，.vsc 信封文件大小 {size}。
已达到本次会话的最大解密次数，页面内敏感状态已清除。
en: The session decrypt limit was reached; in-page sensitive state has been cleared.

zh: 正在解密并校验 .vsc 信封文件...
错误次数达到上限，页面内敏感状态已清除。
en: The error limit was reached; in-page sensitive state has been cleared.

zh: 已触发限制，页面状态已清除，并已尽力随机覆写删除源文件。
en: Limit triggered; page state was cleared and the source file was overwritten and deleted on a best-effort basis.

zh: 计算文本或文件的 MD5、SHA、SHA3、BLAKE2b 与 Whirlpool 摘要，并与可信来源提供的期望摘要比对。
en: Calculate MD5, SHA, SHA3, BLAKE2b, and Whirlpool digests for text or files and compare them with expected digests from a trusted source.

zh: 输入文本或选择文件后即可计算摘要。
en: Enter text or choose a file to calculate its digest.

zh: 选择直接输入文本，或从本地选择一个文件计算摘要。
en: Choose direct text input or select a local file to calculate a digest.

zh: 选择需要计算的摘要算法；MD5/SHA-1 仅适合兼容校验。
en: Choose the digest algorithm; MD5 and SHA-1 are for compatibility checks only.

zh: 可选：粘贴已知摘要，结果会同时按 Hex 和 Base64 比对。
en: Optional: paste a known digest; the result is compared as Hex and Base64.

zh: 支持 Hex 或 Base64，空格和换行会被忽略。
en: Hex or Base64 is supported; spaces and line breaks are ignored.

zh: 同时显示 Hex 和 Base64 形式，便于复制到外部系统。
en: Shows both Hex and Base64 forms for external systems.

zh: 使用共享密钥为文本或文件生成消息认证码，并可粘贴摘要做常量时间格式校验。
en: Generate a message authentication code for text or files with a shared secret, then paste a digest for constant-time format-aware verification.

zh: 输入消息和共享密钥后生成 HMAC；普通散列不具备认证语义。
en: Enter a message and shared secret to generate HMAC; plain hashes do not provide authentication.

zh: 当前输入大小 {size}，可生成或校验认证码。
en: Current input size is {size}; ready to generate or verify the authentication code.

zh: 可直接输入短文本，也可选择本地文件计算 HMAC。
en: Enter short text directly or choose a local file for HMAC.

zh: HMAC 需要双方持有同一密钥；不要把密钥和消息一起发送。
en: HMAC requires both sides to hold the same secret; do not send the secret with the message.

zh: 密钥只保存在当前页面状态中，清除或离开页面后不持久化。
en: The secret stays only in current page state and is not persisted after clearing or leaving the page.

zh: SHA-256 适合默认认证；SHA-1 仅用于兼容旧系统。
en: SHA-256 is the default authentication choice; SHA-1 is only for legacy compatibility.

zh: 可粘贴对方提供的 Hex 或 Base64 HMAC，生成后自动比对。
en: Paste a Hex or Base64 HMAC from another party; it is compared after generation.

zh: 支持 Hex 或 Base64；留空则只生成。
en: Supports Hex or Base64; leave empty to only generate.

zh: 复制前核对算法、输入大小和摘要格式。
en: Review algorithm, input size, and digest format before copying.

zh: 生成后会在这里显示 Hex 和 Base64 HMAC。
en: Hex and Base64 HMAC appear here after generation.

zh: 面向隐写、加密、解密、密钥与校验的安全工具中心；当前先迁入媒体隐写子模块。
en: A security hub for steganography, encryption, decryption, keys, and verification; media steganography is the first migrated module.

zh: 子模块以独立卡片进入，便于后续扩展大量加密解密工具。
en: Submodules open from standalone cards, leaving room for many future crypto tools.

zh: 加密网站/渠道、账号、密码、提示和备注；只允许导入导出加密 vault 文件。
en: Encrypt website/channel, account, password, hint, and notes; import and export encrypted vault files only.

zh: 离线批量生成高强度密码和口令短语，适合配合加密信封或 key file 使用。
en: Generate strong password batches and passphrases offline for encrypted envelopes or key files.

zh: 实验性本地低敏隐藏。支持 PNG、WAV/PCM 与带既有 free padding 的 ISO BMFF；旧版兼容已移除。
en: Experimental local low-sensitivity hiding. Supports PNG WAV/PCM and ISO BMFF with existing free padding; legacy compatibility has been removed.

zh: 高性能本地文件加密，输出带认证元数据的 .vsc 信封文件，支持多密钥文件与算法级联。
en: High-performance local file encryption that outputs .vsc envelope files with authenticated metadata, multiple key files, and cipher cascades.

zh: 复用文件加密算法族处理文本内容，生成可复制、可粘贴的 Base64 加密信封。
en: Use the file encryption algorithm set for text content and produce copyable Base64 envelopes.

zh: 将文本或文件加密后生成可还原的 PNG 色块图或 WAV 频谱音频。
en: Encrypt text or files into restorable PNG color-block images or WAV spectrum audio.

zh: 本地生成或校验 TOTP/HOTP 一次性验证码，不保存账户令牌。
en: Generate or check TOTP/HOTP one-time codes locally without storing account tokens.

zh: 对文本或文件生成常见散列摘要，并做公开摘要比对；来源认证请使用签名或 HMAC。
en: Generate common hash digests for text or files and compare public digests; use signatures or HMAC for source authentication.

zh: 为文本或文件生成 HMAC，并校验对方提供的 Hex/Base64 认证码。
en: Generate HMAC for text or files and verify Hex/Base64 authentication codes from another party.

zh: 生成、派生和组合独立密钥文件，用于文件加密模块的多因子密钥材料。
en: Generate, derive, and combine standalone key files for multi-factor key material in file encryption.

zh: 把密钥、助记文本、恢复口令或加盐密码定义拆成阈值分片，并在本地恢复。
en: Split keys, mnemonic text, recovery passphrases, or salted password definitions into threshold shares and recover them locally.

zh: 管理 RSA-2048 与 ECC P-256 密钥，支持签名验签和 RSA 小文本加解密。
en: Manage RSA-2048 and ECC P-256 keys with signing, verification, and RSA small-text encryption.

zh: 解锁 .hc/.tc 或无扩展名容器，在 App 内只读浏览导出，也可创建新容器。
en: Unlock .hc/.tc or extensionless containers for read-only in-app browsing and export or create a new container.

zh: 文本加密复用文件加密的 v5 信封；RSA 仅适合小文本，长内容请优先使用对称加密信封。
en: Text encryption reuses the file encryption v5 envelope; RSA is only for small text, so use symmetric envelopes for longer content.

zh: 独立生成、口令派生和无序组合密钥文件，供文件加密模块叠加使用。
en: Generate, passphrase-derive, and order-insensitively combine standalone key files for the file encryption module.

zh: 选择生成方式后创建或组合密钥文件。
en: Choose a generation mode to create or combine a key file.

zh: 选择随机生成、口令派生或把多个现有密钥文件组合为一个新材料。
en: Choose random generation, passphrase derivation, or combine existing key files into new material.

zh: 使用安全随机源生成不可复现的二进制密钥文件。
en: Generate a non-reproducible binary key file with a secure random source.

zh: 使用口令、盐和 KDF 强度派生可复现密钥文件，适合与随机密钥文件组合。
en: Derive a reproducible key file from passphrase, salt, and KDF strength; useful together with random key files.

zh: 用于可复现派生，请单独安全保存
en: Used for reproducible derivation; store it separately and securely

zh: 同一口令和盐会派生同一密钥文件。
en: The same passphrase and salt derive the same key file.

zh: 多个密钥文件会按名称、长度和指纹规范化排序，导入顺序不会影响结果。
en: Multiple key files are normalized by name, length, and fingerprint, so import order does not change the result.

zh: 导出前核对文件名、大小和 SHA-256 指纹；密钥内容不会显示。
en: Review file name, size, and SHA-256 fingerprint before export; key content is not displayed.

zh: 生成或组合后会在这里显示密钥文件指纹。
en: The key file fingerprint appears here after generation or combine.

zh: 随机密钥文件已生成，大小 {size}，指纹 {hash}。
en: Random key file generated. Size: {size}. Fingerprint: {hash}.

zh: 本地计算一次性验证码，支持 Base32 密钥、TOTP 时间步和 HOTP 计数器。
en: Calculate one-time codes locally with Base32 secrets, TOTP time steps, and HOTP counters.

zh: 输入 Base32 密钥后计算当前时间步或指定计数器。
en: Enter a Base32 secret to calculate the current time step or a chosen counter.

zh: 已计算计数器 {counter} 的验证码。
可粘贴认证器密钥，也可生成新的随机密钥用于迁移演练。
en: Paste an authenticator secret or generate a new random secret for migration practice.

zh: 支持空格、短横线和 Base32 padding；不会写入本地存储。
en: Spaces, hyphens, and Base32 padding are accepted; nothing is written to local storage.

zh: TOTP 使用当前时间步；HOTP 使用手动计数器。
en: TOTP uses the current time step; HOTP uses a manual counter.
Common value is 30; allowed range is 10-300.

zh: HOTP 每次使用后通常递增。
en: HOTP usually increments after each use.

zh: 大多数认证器默认使用 SHA-1；只有服务端明确支持时才改用 SHA-256/SHA-512。
en: Most authenticators use SHA-1 by default; use SHA-256/SHA-512 only when the service explicitly supports them.

zh: 结果是当前输入的本地计算值，不代表账户已绑定或可登录。
en: The result is calculated locally from current input and does not mean the account is enrolled or login-ready.

zh: 计算后会在这里显示验证码。
en: The code appears here after calculation.

zh: 已生成随机 Base32 密钥。
离线批量生成随机密码，也可生成口令短语并估算熵强度；结果不写入本地存储。
en: Generate random password batches offline or create passphrases with entropy estimates; results are not written to local storage.

zh: 设置字符集后生成一次性结果；页面不会保存历史记录。
en: Configure character sets and generate one-time results; this page keeps no history.

zh: 已生成 {count} 条结果，首条估算熵约 {entropy} bits。
en: Generated {count} results; first estimate is about {entropy} bits of entropy.

zh: 密码适合系统字段；口令短语适合手动输入和记忆。
en: Passwords fit system fields; passphrases are easier to type and remember manually.

zh: 至少保留一种字符集；可追加自定义字符集，默认排除容易混淆的字符。
en: Keep at least one character set; you can add a custom set and ambiguous characters are excluded by default.

zh: 可追加项目要求的专用字符；留空则只使用勾选字符集。
en: Add project-specific characters; leave empty to use only selected sets.

zh: 默认填入 0Ool1I| 等易混淆字符；可按场景增删。
en: Defaults to ambiguous characters such as 0Ool1I|; edit for the target system.

zh: 从内置离线词表随机抽词；词表本身不代表助记词标准。
en: Randomly draws from the built-in offline word list; this is not a mnemonic seed standard.

zh: 复制后请放入密码管理器或加密存储，离开页面前按需清除。
en: Move copied values into a password manager or encrypted storage and clear this page when done.

zh: 点击生成后会在这里显示批量结果。
en: Generated batches appear here after you tap Generate.

zh: 本地加密保存账号记录；选择保险库后输入对应凭据解锁。
en: Store account records in a local encrypted vault; select a vault and unlock it with the matching credentials.

zh: 选择保险库并输入密码即可解锁；更多说明已收进右侧指南。
en: Select a vault and enter its password to unlock; details are collected in the guide on the right.

zh: 已解锁 {count} 条记录；密码按需单条解密。
en: Unlocked {count} records; passwords decrypt one record at a time.

zh: 选择本地保险库；输入对应凭据后进入可用内容。
en: Select a local vault; matching credentials open the available contents.

zh: 还没有本地保险库。先创建一个新保险库，或导入加密 vault 文件。
en: No local vaults yet. Create a new vault or import an encrypted vault file.

zh: 仅保存不会暴露密码的自定义提示，例如线索词或记忆规则。
en: Save only a hint that does not reveal the password, such as a cue word or memory rule.

zh: 开启后删除本保险库前必须验证密码；关闭后仍会二次确认。
en: When enabled, deleting this vault requires password verification; when disabled, deletion still asks for confirmation.

zh: 新增账号需要主密码确认
en: Require master password before adding accounts

zh: 关闭后，当前解锁会话会临时保留主密码以便新增账号，直到锁定或超时。
en: When off, the unlocked session temporarily keeps the master password for adding accounts until lock or timeout.

zh: 修改账号需要主密码确认
en: Require master password before editing accounts

zh: 关闭后，当前解锁会话会临时保留主密码以便修改账号信息。
en: When off, the unlocked session temporarily keeps the master password for editing account records.

zh: 删除账号需要主密码确认
en: Require master password before deleting accounts

zh: 关闭后，删除账号仍会弹出删除确认，但不额外要求主密码。
en: When off, deleting accounts still asks for deletion confirmation but skips the extra master password prompt.

zh: 选择保险库后输入对应凭据解锁。
en: Select a vault, then enter matching credentials to unlock it.

zh: 输入对应凭据解锁保险库。
en: Enter matching credentials to unlock the vault.

zh: 未导入密钥文件。没有绑定密钥文件的保险库可仅用主密码解锁。
en: No key file imported. Vaults without a bound key file can be unlocked with the master password only.

zh: 在同一面板中选择操作、搜索账号并查看记录。
en: Choose actions, search accounts, and review records in one panel.

zh: 当前保险库、账号搜索和记录操作集中在这里。
en: The active vault, account search, and record actions are grouped here.

zh: 空搜索默认不显示条目；输入后可筛选并获取账号信息。
en: An empty search shows no records by default; type to filter and retrieve account information.

zh: 索引已解锁 {count} 条；密码仍保持加密，直到单条获取。
en: {count} indexes are unlocked; passwords remain encrypted until fetched individually.

zh: 还没有记录。新条目会立即加密写入本地 vault。
en: No records yet. New items are encrypted into the local vault immediately.

zh: 默认隐藏完整条目列表。输入搜索词，或点击显示全部。
en: The full record list is hidden by default. Enter a search term or tap Show all.

zh: 没有匹配当前搜索的记录。
en: No records match the current search.

zh: 重命名“{name}”前，请验证主密码。
en: Verify the primary password before renaming "{name}".

zh: 用于确认你有权修改这个本地保险库；不会写入文件。
en: Used to confirm that you can modify this local vault; it is not written to the file.

zh: 删除“{name}”？这会删除本地加密 vault 文件，恢复只能依赖你另存的备份。
en: Delete "{name}"? This removes the local encrypted vault file; recovery requires a separate backup.

zh: 删除保险库前需要验证密码。
en: Verify the password before deleting the vault.

zh: 两次输入的主密码不一致。
en: The two master password entries do not match.

zh: 当前{kind}未达到本地强度建议，估算强度约 {bits} bit。较弱密码更容易被离线猜解；继续保存前请确认这是你的明确选择。
en: The current {kind} does not meet the local strength recommendation. Estimated strength is about {bits} bits. Weaker passwords are easier to guess offline; confirm this is your explicit choice before saving.

zh: 连续解锁失败过多，请等待 {seconds} 秒后再试。
en: Too many failed unlock attempts; wait {seconds} seconds before trying again.

zh: 请完成系统生物识别以继续访问密码库。
en: Authenticate with system biometrics to continue accessing the password vault.

zh: 已迁移旧记录元数据并重新保存保险库。
en: Legacy record metadata was migrated and the vault was saved again.

zh: 已解锁并载入 {count} 条记录。
请先完成一次系统生物识别以启用二次确认。
en: Authenticate once with system biometrics to enable second confirmation.

zh: 此设备未提供可用的系统生物识别，或尚未录入指纹/人脸。
en: No usable system biometrics are available on this device, or no fingerprint/face is enrolled.

zh: 生物识别未通过，操作已取消。
en: Biometric authentication failed; the operation was cancelled.

zh: 仅用于本次操作；60 秒后、锁定、后台或离开页面时会清除。
en: Used only for this operation; it is cleared after 60 seconds, lock, backgrounding, or leaving the page.

zh: 删除“{name}”？保存后需要依赖其他备份恢复。
en: Delete "{name}"? After saving, recovery requires another backup.

zh: 记录已删除并保存加密 vault。
en: Record deleted and encrypted vault saved.

zh: 已启用生物识别二次确认。
主密码已修改，真实记录已重新加密。
en: Master password changed and primary records re-encrypted.

zh: 导入完成，已载入 {count} 条记录。
密码已临时显示；关闭弹窗后不会保存在页面缓存中。
en: Password was shown once; after closing the dialog it is not kept in the page cache.

zh: 密码已复制；若剪贴板仍是本次内容，将在 {seconds} 秒后自动清空。
en: Password copied; if the clipboard still matches this value, it will be cleared after {seconds} seconds.

zh: 系统剪贴板可能被输入法、历史记录、同步剪贴板、辅助功能或其他应用读取。确认后会复制密码，并在 {seconds} 秒后尽力清空未变化的剪贴板。
en: The system clipboard may be read by keyboards, clipboard history, sync services, accessibility tools, or other apps. If you continue, the password is copied and the unchanged clipboard is cleared after {seconds} seconds when possible.

zh: 已锁定并清空页面明文列表。
en: Locked and cleared the in-page plaintext list.

zh: 仅用于本次同步备用入口；不会写入主保险库会话或持久化文件。
en: Used only to sync the alternate entry this time; it is not stored in the primary vault session or persisted file.

zh: 主密码强度不足：建议使用更长的短语，或混合大小写、数字和符号。
en: The master password is too weak: use a longer passphrase or mix upper/lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols.

zh: 替换规则的原字符和替换字符数量必须一致。
en: The substitution rule must map the same number of characters.

zh: 请至少输入网站/渠道或账号。
en: Enter at least a website/channel or an account.

zh: 请输入需要保存的密码。
记录文本过长，请拆分或缩短后再保存。
en: Record text is too long; split or shorten it before saving.

zh: 该记录超过 vault 条目大小限制。
en: This record is too large for the vault.

zh: vault 文件过大或记录数量过多。
en: The vault file is too large or has too many records.

zh: 请输入有效的保险库名称。
已存在同名保险库，请换一个名称。
en: A vault with this name already exists. Choose another name.

zh: 安全设置取值无效，请重新选择清理或锁定时间。
en: The safety setting value is invalid. Choose the cleanup or lock timeout again.

zh: 密钥文件无效，或与当前保险库绑定的密钥文件不匹配。
en: The key file is invalid or does not match the key file bound to this vault.

zh: 备用入口最大解锁次数无效。
en: The alternate entry unlock limit is invalid.

zh: vault 文件结构无效或已损坏。
en: The vault file structure is invalid or damaged.

zh: 不支持该 vault 文件版本。
en: This vault file version is unsupported.

zh: 记录无法解密，请检查密码、规则或文件完整性。
en: The record cannot be decrypted; check the password, rule, or file integrity.

zh: 解锁失败，请检查密码、密钥文件或文件完整性。
en: Unlock failed; check the password, key file, or file integrity.

zh: 密码验证失败，请检查密码、密钥文件或文件完整性。
en: Password verification failed; check the password, key file, or file integrity.

zh: 操作失败，请检查输入或文件状态。
en: The operation failed; check the input or file state.

zh: 先选择保险库并输入对应凭据；匹配后会打开可用内容。
en: Select a vault and enter matching credentials; matching credentials open the available contents.

zh: 同一个保险库入口可按不同凭据进入对应内容；请确保不同凭据不要相同或混用。
en: The same vault entry can open the matching contents for different credentials; keep those credentials distinct and do not mix them.

zh: 如果创建时绑定了独立密钥文件，解锁、导入和主密码变更时都需要同一密钥文件。
en: If an independent key file was bound at creation, the same key file is required for unlock, import, and master password changes.

zh: 迁移只导出加密原始文件；可再通过文件加密、隐写或临时空间传递，不提供明文导出。
en: Migration exports only the encrypted raw file; you can pass it through file encryption, steganography, or temporary storage, and plaintext export is not provided.

zh: 当前保险库的默认强度、凭据和主密码管理集中在这里。
en: Default strength, credential, and master password management for the current vault are collected here.

zh: 当前保险库不支持修改设置。
en: This vault does not support changing settings.

zh: 默认强度只影响新记录；编辑已有记录会保留原记录强度。
en: Default strength affects only new records; editing an existing record preserves its original strength.

zh: 开启后，移动端在解锁、显示或复制密码等敏感操作前会调用系统指纹或人脸识别；主密码仍然必须输入。
en: When enabled on mobile, the system fingerprint or face check is required before unlocking, showing, or copying passwords. The master password is still required.

zh: 备用入口同步账号索引，但保存随机占位密码；通过备用入口进入时不能编辑原记录。
en: The alternate entry syncs account indexes but stores random placeholder passwords; content opened through it cannot edit original records.

zh: 已启用；保持启用时无需重新输入。
en: Already enabled; no re-entry is needed while keeping it enabled.

zh: 启用时必填；请使用与当前密码不同的凭据。
en: Required when enabling; use credentials that differ from the current password.

zh: 备用入口最大解锁次数
填 0 表示不触发清空；达到次数后会清空原记录。
en: Use 0 to disable purging; reaching the limit clears original records.

zh: 修改主密码会重新加密真实保险库记录；当前绑定的密钥文件保持不变。
en: Changing the master password re-encrypts primary records; the currently bound key file is kept.

zh: {stages} 层级联 · {cipherBits}-bit AEAD 密钥 · {materialBits}-bit 派生材料
关闭时保留原密码；开启后输入新密码。仅修改账号信息时不会解密原密码。
en: Leave this off to keep the existing password; turn it on to enter a new password. Editing account details does not decrypt the existing password.

zh: 本次新增记录可单独选择强度；不会改变保险库默认设置。
en: This new record can use its own strength; it does not change the vault default.

zh: 剪贴板与设备安全提示
手机剪贴板、输入法、系统同步和设备环境不可控；可在实际使用的密码基础上额外使用不保存的人脑规则，例如前缀、中缀、后缀、简单替换、记忆码表或自定义规则。例：密码为 prefix123，记录中只保存 123，prefix 由你统一记忆。这样不能替代设备安全，只是聊胜于无。
en: Mobile clipboards, keyboards, system sync, and device environments are outside this vault's control. You can optionally add a non-saved human-memory rule on top of the password you use, such as a prefix, infix, suffix, simple substitution, memory code table, or custom rule. Example: if the password is prefix123, save only 123 and remember prefix yourself. This does not replace device security, but it is better than nothing.

zh: 把文本秘密或加盐密码定义拆分为阈值分片，或用足够分片恢复；分片请分开保存。
en: Split a text secret or salted password definition into threshold shares or recover it from enough shares; store shares separately.

zh: 已生成 {shares} 个分片，任意 {threshold} 个可恢复。
输入文本秘密或定义加盐密码并设置阈值，或粘贴足够分片恢复。
en: Enter a text secret or define a salted password with a threshold, or paste enough shares to recover.

zh: 分片用于分散保管；恢复需要达到阈值数量且分片未损坏。
en: Split for distributed custody; recovery requires enough intact shares.

zh: 本轮 UI 处理文本秘密和加盐密码定义；二进制密钥可后续接入密钥文件管理。
en: This UI handles text secrets and salted password definitions; binary keys can be wired through key-file management later.

zh: 不要在不可信屏幕或日志中展示真实密钥。
en: Do not display real secrets on untrusted screens or logs.

zh: 仅用于本地派生 vspwd1 定义，不写入分片文本。
en: Used only to derive the local vspwd1 definition and not written into share text.

zh: 默认随机生成，可按需要替换。
生成分片前会把密码和盐派生为 vspwd1 定义；恢复结果不是原始密码。
en: Before splitting the password and salt derive a vspwd1 definition. Recovery returns that definition not the original password.
Must be at least the threshold and at most 16.

zh: 每行粘贴一个 vss1 分片；重复、损坏或阈值不足会被拒绝。
en: Paste one vss1 share per line; duplicate, damaged, or insufficient shares are rejected.

zh: 至少粘贴达到阈值数量的分片。
en: Paste at least the threshold number of shares.

zh: 请分别保存分片；不要把所有分片放在同一位置。
en: Store shares separately; do not keep every share in the same place.

zh: 执行分片或恢复后会在这里显示结果。
en: Results appear here after splitting or recovery.

zh: 实验性低隐蔽媒体隐藏；新写入支持 PNG、WAV/PCM 与带既有 free padding 的 ISO BMFF
en: Experimental low-visibility media hiding. New writes support PNG WAV/PCM and ISO BMFF with existing free padding

zh: 显式写入表层与深层两份内容；表层口令只还原表层内容。
en: Explicitly writes cover and hidden content; the cover passphrase reveals only the cover layer.

zh: 双层模式会写入表层与深层两份载荷。请保存原始载体；修改双层内容时应重新生成，不要重复写入同一隐写文件。
en: Dual-layer mode writes cover and hidden payloads. Keep the original carrier; regenerate from it instead of writing into an existing stego file.

zh: 防覆盖优先模式会写入可见占用标记，但该标记可被伪造，只能作为提示；它不适合强隐蔽场景。
en: Guarded mode writes a visible occupancy marker, but the marker is forgeable and only a hint; it is not suitable for strong concealment.

zh: 默认可否认模式不公开占用，也无法防止载体被重新写入或损坏；它只保证篡改检测和密文安全。
en: Default deniable mode does not publish occupancy and cannot prevent the carrier from being rewritten or damaged; it only provides tamper detection and ciphertext security.

zh: 允许单次覆盖现有载荷
en: Allow one-time overwrite of existing payload

zh: 确认后只对下一次写入生效；它会跳过同凭据可读载荷的覆盖保护。
en: After confirmation it applies only to the next write and skips protection for payloads readable with the current credential.

zh: .vssig 是明文哈希 sidecar，可发现拿错文件或意外改动；不能认证不可信来源。
en: .vssig is a plaintext hash sidecar for wrong-file or accidental-change checks; it does not authenticate untrusted sources.

zh: 关闭默认值。开启后会在应用文档目录保存 mixed/sha256/md5、大小、文件名、路径和时间。
en: Off by default. When enabled, the app documents directory stores mixed/sha256/md5, size, file name, path, and time.

zh: 这些选项会在载体外留下本机或 sidecar 痕迹，可能证明本设备生成或校验过隐写载体。Deniable 场景请保持关闭。
en: These options leave local or sidecar traces outside the carrier and may show this device generated or checked stego media. Keep them off for deniable use.

zh: 自由级联会按下方顺序逐层加密，每层独立派生所选长度的密钥材料。
en: Custom cascade encrypts in the order below, deriving independent key material for every stage.

zh: 当前: {workspaceLabel} / {modeLabel} / {mediaLabel}。密钥文件可与口令叠加使用。
en: Current: {workspaceLabel} / {modeLabel} / {mediaLabel}. A key file can be combined with the passphrase.

zh: 新写入支持图片 PNG、音频 WAV/PCM，以及具备既有 free padding 的 ISO BMFF 音频/视频；常见压缩格式可选择但没有安全后端时会拒绝写入。所有写入强制 AEAD，加密载荷不抗压缩、转码或平台二次处理。
en: New writes support PNG images WAV/PCM audio and ISO BMFF audio/video with existing free padding. Common compressed formats can be selected but are rejected without a safe backend. All writes require AEAD; encrypted payloads do not survive compression transcoding or platform processing.

zh: 选择一个媒体文件，并输入需要隐藏的文本。
en: Pick a media file and enter the text to hide.

zh: 选择之前生成的隐写媒体，并输入对应口令。
en: Pick a generated stego media file and enter its passphrase.

zh: 使用表层口令还原时只显示这段内容。
en: Only this content is shown when revealing with the cover passphrase.

zh: 请输入写入时使用的口令和密钥文件。
en: Use the passphrase and key file from embedding.

zh: 口令或密钥文件至少提供一个，还原时必须一致。
en: Use a passphrase or key file; the same inputs are required when revealing.

zh: 隐写写入必须使用 AEAD 加密；明文和仅签名模式已禁用。
en: Steganography writes require AEAD encryption; plaintext and signature-only modes are disabled.

zh: 表层口令必须与深层口令不同；表层不使用当前密钥文件。
en: Must differ from the hidden passphrase. The cover layer does not use the selected key file.

zh: 最高强度写入必须启用并选择 key file。这样口令之外还需要独立密钥材料。
en: Extreme-strength writes must enable and select a key file. This requires independent key material in addition to the passphrase.

zh: 选择载体和要隐藏的文件，加密后的文件数据会写入图片、音频或视频。
en: Pick a carrier and a file; encrypted file bytes are embedded into image, audio, or video.

zh: 选择之前生成的隐写媒体，使用相同口令和密钥文件还原文件。
en: Pick generated stego media and reveal the file with the same passphrase and key file.

zh: 口令可与密钥文件叠加使用，解密时必须一致。
en: Can be combined with a key file and must match for decryption.

zh: 表层口令只还原表层文件，并且不使用当前密钥文件。
en: The cover passphrase reveals only the cover file and does not use the selected key file.

zh: 选择任意文件并计算摘要，用于校验文件完整性或记录指纹。
en: Pick any file and calculate a digest for integrity checks.

zh: 执行写入或还原后，这里会显示载荷信息和文本结果。
en: After embedding or revealing, payload metrics and text appear here.

zh: 已生成可导出的隐写媒体。
en: A stego media file is ready to export.
Text has been revealed from the media.

zh: 执行写入或还原后，这里会显示载荷、算法和导出状态。
en: After embedding or revealing, payload metrics and algorithm details appear here.

zh: 已从媒体还原文件内容，可导出保存。
en: The hidden file has been revealed and can be exported.

zh: 可选导入 .vssig 完整性指纹，先比对载体再还原；它不能防止载体和 .vssig 同时被替换。
en: Optionally import a .vssig integrity fingerprint before reveal; it cannot stop the carrier and .vssig being replaced together.

zh: 预检已通过；生成前可核对容量、输出大小和层级。
en: Preflight passed. Review capacity, output size, and layers before export.

zh: 双层写入会生成表层与深层两份载荷；不同口令会还原不同层。
en: Dual-layer writing creates cover and hidden payloads; different passphrases reveal different layers.

zh: 计算后会显示十六进制和 Base64 摘要。
en: Hex and Base64 digests appear after calculation.

zh: 音频和视频当前显示文件状态，导出后可用系统播放器打开。
en: Audio and video show file state here; exported files can be opened in system players.

zh: 左侧原图，右侧隐写 PNG。
en: Source image on the left, stego PNG on the right.

zh: 本工具只在本地处理文件，不上传媒体。
en: This tool processes files locally and does not upload media.

zh: 当前媒体方案是本地实验工具：PNG 使用随机像素 LSB，WAV 使用低密度样本 LSB，ISO BMFF 仅使用已有 free padding，不追加容器数据。
en: The current media methods are local experimental tools. PNG uses randomized pixel LSB WAV uses low-density sample LSB and ISO BMFF only uses existing free padding without appending container data.

zh: 不抗专业统计检测、取证、压缩、转码、缩放、降噪或平台二次处理。音视频写入仅在 WAV/PCM，或 ISO BMFF 载体已有足够 free padding 时工作。
en: It does not resist professional statistical detection forensic review compression transcoding resizing denoising or platform processing. Audio/video writes only work on WAV/PCM or on ISO BMFF carriers with enough existing free padding.

zh: 开启后，所选文件会按稳定规则排序后参与派生。
en: When enabled, selected files are sorted and mixed into key derivation.

zh: 本机记录提示：该载体匹配本设备明确记录过的隐写文件 {name}。
en: Local record notice: this carrier matches a stego file explicitly recorded on this device: {name}.

zh: 建议至少 256 字节，可输入 32 到 1048576。
en: Recommended: at least 256 bytes. Range: 32 to 1048576.

zh: 密钥文件长度必须是数字。
en: Key file length must be a number.

zh: 浏览器下载已触发，请查看下载列表。
en: Browser download started. Check your downloads.

zh: 下一次写入会跳过当前凭据可读载荷的覆盖保护。公开 Guarded 标记可被伪造，不能作为可信占用证明。写入结束后该授权会自动关闭。
en: The next write will skip overwrite protection for payloads readable with the current credential. Public Guarded markers are forgeable and are not trusted occupancy proof. This permission turns off after the write.

zh: 已生成隐写媒体，请导出结果文件。
en: Stego media is ready. Export the result file.

zh: 已还原文本，请复制需要保存的数据。
en: Text has been revealed. Copy the data you need to keep.

zh: 已还原文件，请导出保存。
en: The hidden file has been revealed. Export it to save.

zh: 浏览器下载已触发，请查看下载列表。载体已从内存卸载。
en: Browser download started. Check your downloads. The carrier has been unloaded from memory.

zh: 文件已导出，载体已从内存卸载。
en: The file was exported and the carrier has been unloaded from memory.

zh: 指纹已复制，可自行离线保存。
en: Fingerprint copied. You can store it offline yourself.

zh: 完整性指纹不匹配。该载体可能拿错、被替换或已意外改动。
en: Integrity fingerprint mismatch. This carrier may be the wrong file, replaced, or accidentally changed.

zh: 当前平台没有可清除的本机 Vault。
en: This platform has no local vault to clear.

zh: 清除本机 Vault 失败：{error}
载荷超过当前 ISO BMFF 既有 free padding 容量。当前可用 {p0}，当前设置需要 {p1}。请减少内容，或换用保留更大 free padding 的原始媒体；文件仍需不超过 {p2}。
en: The payload exceeds this ISO BMFF existing free-padding capacity. Available: {p0}; current settings need {p1}. Reduce the content or use original media with larger retained free padding; the file must stay under {p2}.

zh: 载荷超过当前 WAV/PCM 音频容量。当前最大 {p0}，当前设置需要 {p1}。请减少内容，或换用更长的未压缩 WAV 音频；建议载体至少 {p2}，文件不超过 {p3}。
en: The payload exceeds this WAV/PCM audio capacity. Max: {p0}; current settings need {p1}. Reduce the content or use a longer uncompressed WAV file; suggested carrier size is at least {p2} and under {p3}.

zh: 载荷超过当前图片容量。当前图片 {width}x{height}，每层最大 {p2}；表层需要 {p3}，深层需要 {p4}。请减少内容，或换用至少 {side} x {side} 像素、总像素不超过 {maxImagePixels}、文件不超过 {p7} 的图片。
en: The payload exceeds this image capacity. Current image: {width}x{height}, max per layer: {p2}; cover needs {p3}, hidden needs {p4}. Reduce the content or use an image of at least {side} x {side} pixels, no more than {maxImagePixels} total pixels, and under {p7}.

zh: 载荷超过当前图片容量。当前图片 {width}x{height}，最大 {p2}；当前设置需要预留 {p3}。请减少内容，或换用至少 {side} x {side} 像素、总像素不超过 {maxImagePixels}、文件不超过 {p6} 的图片。
en: The payload exceeds this image capacity. Current image: {width}x{height}, max: {p2}; current settings need {p3}. Reduce the content or use an image of at least {side} x {side} pixels, no more than {maxImagePixels} total pixels, and under {p6}.

zh: 还原失败。仅会触发本机临时重试节流，不会修改载体或源文件。
en: Reveal failed. Only a local temporary retry throttle may apply; the carrier and source file are not modified.

zh: 当前文件还原已锁定，约 {minutes} 分钟后可重试。
en: Reveal for the current file is locked. Try again in about {minutes} minute(s).
No hidden payload information was found.

zh: 安全性: 明文。不会加密 payload，生成前会再次确认；任何拿到载体的人都可能还原内容。
en: Safety: plaintext. Payloads are not encrypted and generation asks for confirmation; anyone with the carrier may recover the content.

zh: 安全性: 弱，仅用于旧载荷还原；新加密已移除。
en: Safety: weak, reveal-only for legacy payloads. New encryption has been removed.

zh: 安全性: 弱，仅用于 RC4 旧载荷还原；新加密已移除。
en: Safety: weak, reveal-only for legacy RC4 payloads. New encryption has been removed.

zh: 安全性: 强+。使用 scrypt 2^16 起步、随机填充、独立派生密钥材料和认证校验。
en: Safety: strong+. Uses scrypt from 2^16, random padding, independent key material, and authentication.

zh: 安全性: 强。默认 256-bit 以上密钥材料，使用随机盐、随机填充和认证校验。
en: Safety: strong. Uses at least 256-bit key material, random salt, random padding, and authentication.

zh: 该校验只证明包封内数据未被同口令体系篡改。它不是外部身份签名。
en: This check only proves the package data was not changed within the same passphrase system. It is not an external identity signature.

zh: RSA/ECDSA 校验密钥由同一口令派生且公钥随包封携带。它只作为附加完整性检查。
en: RSA/ECDSA check keys are derived from the same passphrase and the public key travels inside the envelope. This is only an added integrity check.

zh: 高安全隐写写入需要 key file。请启用 key file 后再继续。
en: High-security steganography writes require a key file. Enable a key file before continuing.

zh: 当前 WAV/PCM 可用的非静音样本不足。请换用更长、动态更丰富、未压缩的 WAV。
en: This WAV/PCM file does not have enough usable non-silent samples. Use a longer uncompressed WAV with richer dynamics.

zh: 压缩音频码流暂不能安全写入。请使用 WAV/PCM，或带有既有 free padding 的 ISO BMFF 音频。
en: Compressed audio bitstreams cannot be written safely. Use WAV/PCM audio or ISO BMFF audio with existing free padding.

zh: 压缩或复杂视频容器暂不能安全写入。请使用带有既有 free padding 的 ISO BMFF 视频。
en: Compressed or complex video containers cannot be written safely. Use ISO BMFF video with existing free padding.

zh: 当前 ISO BMFF 载体没有足够既有 free padding。为避免追加可疑容器数据，请换用保留更大 padding 的原始媒体。
en: This ISO BMFF carrier does not have enough existing free padding. To avoid appending suspicious container data use original media with larger retained padding.

zh: 该音频格式暂不能安全写入。请使用 WAV/PCM，或带有既有 free padding 的 ISO BMFF 音频。
en: This audio format cannot be written safely yet. Use WAV/PCM audio or ISO BMFF audio with existing free padding.

zh: 该视频格式暂不能安全写入。请使用带有既有 free padding 的 ISO BMFF 视频。
en: This video format cannot be written safely yet. Use ISO BMFF video with existing free padding.

zh: 该载体启用了防盲覆盖标记。只有确认要替换时才开启显式覆盖。
en: This carrier is guarded against blind overwrite. Enable explicit overwrite only if you intend to replace it.

zh: 当前凭据可读取该载体中的既有载荷。为防误覆盖，默认已拒绝；如确需替换请开启显式覆盖。
en: The current credential can read an existing payload in this carrier. To prevent accidental overwrite, writing was refused; enable explicit overwrite only if replacing it intentionally.

zh: 旧版隐写兼容已正式移除，请使用当前版本重新生成载体。
en: Legacy steganography compatibility has been removed. Regenerate the carrier with the current version.

en: Fingerprint file is invalid. Choose a .vssig file exported by this tool or copied fingerprint text.
Input file is too large. Limit: {limit}.
Source media is too large. Limit: {limit}.
Image file is too large. Limit: {limit}.

zh: 图片像素尺寸过大，最大 {pixels} 像素。
en: Image dimensions are too large. Maximum: {pixels} pixels.

zh: 该算法暂未接入可靠加密后端。
en: This algorithm is not connected to a reliable crypto backend yet.

zh: 隐藏文本超过当前图片容量。
en: The hidden text exceeds the current image capacity.

zh: 直接加密或解密文本内容，输出可复制的 Base64 v5 加密信封。
en: Encrypt or decrypt text content directly and copy the Base64 v5 envelope.

zh: 输入明文可生成加密信封，或粘贴 Base64 信封进行解密。
en: Enter plain text to create an encrypted envelope, or paste a Base64 envelope to decrypt.

zh: 选择生成新信封，或解开已有 Base64 v5 信封。
en: Choose whether to create a new envelope or open an existing Base64 v5 envelope.

zh: 输入需要保护的 UTF-8 文本。
en: Enter the UTF-8 text you want to protect.

zh: 粘贴由本模块生成的 Base64 v5 加密信封。
en: Paste a Base64 v5 encrypted envelope generated by this module.

zh: 算法、KDF 强度、密钥位宽和校验方式与文件加密模块保持一致。
en: Algorithms, KDF strength, key width, and integrity checks match the file encryption module.

zh: 同一口令与密钥文件组合必须在加密和解密时保持一致。
en: Use the same passphrase and key file combination for encryption and decryption.

zh: 加密模式输出 Base64 信封；解密模式输出 UTF-8 明文。
en: Encrypt mode outputs a Base64 envelope; decrypt mode outputs UTF-8 plain text.

zh: 已生成 {size} 的 Base64 加密信封。
en: Generated a Base64 encrypted envelope of {size}.

zh: 已解密出 {size} 的明文文本。
移动端优先的 VeraCrypt 容器解密、浏览、导出与创建工具。
en: Mobile-first VeraCrypt container tool for decrypting browsing exporting and creating containers.

zh: 选择本机可访问的 VeraCrypt 文件容器。移动端需要平台返回可 seek 的文件路径。
en: Choose a locally accessible VeraCrypt file container. Mobile platforms must provide a seekable file path.

zh: 选择容器后按需解锁头部、解密数据区并打开 App 内文件浏览，不把大型容器整体载入内存。
en: After choosing a container, unlock the header, decrypt the data area, and open in-app file browsing as needed without loading large containers fully into memory.

zh: 输入口令、PIM 和 keyfile 后可解锁容器头、探测数据区，并在 App 内打开只读文件浏览导出文件。
en: Enter passphrase, PIM, and keyfile to unlock the container header, probe the data area, and open read-only in-app file browsing for export.

zh: 选择一个或多个普通文件，使用当前口令/PIM/keyfile 生成 VeraCrypt 容器；不会挂载系统盘。
en: Choose one or more regular files and create a VeraCrypt container using the current passphrase/PIM/keyfile; no system drive is mounted.

zh: 尚未选择要写入容器的文件。
en: No source files selected for the container.

zh: 已选择 {count} 个源文件，合计 {size}。
已按上限读取 {bytes}/{limit} 字节用于指纹，未全量载入 keyfile。
en: Hashed the capped {bytes}/{limit} bytes for the fingerprint; the keyfile was not fully loaded.

zh: 已读取 {bytes} 字节用于指纹，未触及上限 {limit} 字节。
en: Hashed {bytes} bytes for the fingerprint, below the {limit}-byte limit.

zh: 主头验证成功后，可只读解密数据区开头摘要，或在下方打开文件浏览导出文件；不挂载、不写入原容器。
en: After the header verifies, decrypt a bounded data-area summary read-only, or open file browsing below to export files; the original container is not mounted or written.

zh: 仅解密 512 字节主头并校验 CRC；不保存口令，不挂载，不读取卷内文件。
en: Only the 512-byte primary header is decrypted and CRC-checked; the passphrase is not saved, the volume is not mounted, and files inside are not read.

zh: 按 VeraCrypt 文件卷布局展示主头、隐藏卷头、标准备份头和隐藏备份头窗口。
en: Shows primary, hidden, standard backup, and hidden backup header windows according to the VeraCrypt file-volume layout.

zh: 当前平台没有返回可 seek 的文件路径。为避免读取完整大容器，本阶段不会继续检查。
en: This platform did not return a seekable file path. To avoid reading a full large container, inspection stops here.

zh: 部分源文件没有可读取路径，已跳过；请改选本地文件。
en: Some source files have no readable path and were skipped; choose local files instead.

zh: 请先输入用于新容器的口令。
en: Enter a passphrase for the new container first.

zh: 当前平台没有返回可 seek 的 keyfile 路径，因此未读取 keyfile。
en: This platform did not return a seekable keyfile path, so the keyfile was not read.

zh: 显示通过 magic 与 CRC 验证后的只读卷头元数据。
en: Shows read-only header metadata only after magic and CRC validation.

zh: 头部声明存在隐藏卷大小
en: Header declares a hidden volume size

zh: 显示从已验证主头提取的 AES-XTS 数据区 key 所解密的有限首段摘要。
en: Shows a bounded leading-sample summary decrypted with the AES-XTS data-area key extracted from the verified primary header.

zh: 疑似 FAT 启动扇区
从 {start} 开始，共 {count} 个单元
移动端不会把 VeraCrypt 挂载成系统盘；浏览和导出只在 App 内只读执行，创建容器会另存新文件。
en: Mobile does not mount VeraCrypt as a system drive; browsing and export run read-only in-app and container creation saves a new file.

zh: 解锁成功后，可在 App 内浏览 FAT 目录并导出单个文件；不会挂载系统盘，不会写入容器。
en: After unlocking, browse the FAT directory in-app and export a single file; no system drive is mounted and the container is never written.

zh: 此操作只解密卷内容用于只读浏览；不会创建、修改或删除容器内任何文件。
en: This only decrypts volume content for read-only browsing; it never creates, modifies, or deletes any file inside the container.

zh: 至少需要 2 个有效选项才能随机。
en: At least 2 valid options are required.

zh: 骰子模式至少需要 3 个选项；每颗骰子会分配 3 到 12 面。
en: Dice mode needs at least 3 options; each die gets 3 to 12 faces.

zh: 硬币模式只使用两面，因此需要正好 2 个有效选项。
en: Coin mode has exactly two sides, so it needs exactly 2 options.

zh: 全部权重为 0 时会自动退回均匀随机；建议至少给一个选项正权重。
en: If all weights are 0, the draw falls back to uniform random.

zh: 联合分布的权重 × 条件概率全为 0 时会退回均匀随机。
en: If every joint mass is 0, the draw falls back to uniform random.

zh: 随机适合低风险、可回退、差异不大的选择。
en: Random choice fits low-stakes, reversible choices.

zh: 每个选项概率相同，适合“都差不多，只想结束犹豫”的场景。
en: Every option has the same chance. Use it when all choices are close enough.

zh: 权重越高越容易被抽中，适合保留一点偏好但不完全按分数排序。
en: Higher weights get more chances. It keeps preference without turning the result into a strict ranking.

zh: 用权重 × 条件概率形成联合质量，多轮抽取后按出现次数收口。
en: Use weight × condition probability as joint mass, then draw multiple rounds and pick the strongest repeat.

zh: 至少 3 个选项才能生成骰子。
en: Need at least 3 options for dice.

zh: 每颗骰子 3 到 12 面，按选项数量自动分配。
en: Each die gets 3 to 12 faces based on option count.

zh: 落在 D{resultDiceIndex} 第 {resultDiceFaceIndex} 面
硬币需要正好 2 个选项。
把随机变成一个可调助手
先选随机方式，再就地调整选项、权重、轮次或骰子硬币数量，最后用转盘、骰子或硬币完成低风险选择。
en: Choose the method, adjust options and parameters in place, then draw with a wheel, dice, or coins for low-stakes choices.

zh: 先调好候选池，再开始随机。
当前转盘会直接按所选随机方式计算概率；如果切到加权，扇区面积会跟随权重变化。
en: The wheel uses the current probability model. In weighted mode, segment size follows weight.

zh: 选项会均匀分配到骰子上，每颗 3 到 12 面；结果仍在全部选项中均匀抽取。
en: Options are split across dice with 3 to 12 faces each; the final draw remains uniform across all options.

zh: 硬币只支持两面均匀；多枚硬币按多数面收口，数量保持奇数以避免平局。
en: Coins support exactly two uniform sides. Multiple coins use majority, kept odd to avoid ties.

zh: 权重用于加权随机；联合分布会使用“权重 × 条件概率”。空名称不会进入候选池。
en: Weights power weighted random. Joint mode uses weight × condition probability. Empty names are ignored.

zh: 按权重 × 条件概率多轮抽取
en: Draw multiple rounds by weight × condition probability

zh: 支持均匀、加权和联合分布
en: Supports uniform, weighted, and joint modes

zh: 均匀随机；每颗 3 到 12 面
en: Uniform random; each die has 3 to 12 faces
Two uniform sides, with multiple coins

zh: 先核实「{focusName}」最可能改变结论的一条事实，再回到模型对照。
en: Verify the one fact most likely to change {focusName}, then return to the model comparison.

zh: 先核实最可能改变结论的一条事实，再回到模型对照。
en: Verify the one fact most likely to change the conclusion, then return to the model comparison.

zh: 围绕「{reportConsensusWinnerName}」先做一个最小可回退动作，并记录实际结果。
en: Take one small reversible action around {reportConsensusWinnerName}, and record what happens.

zh: 先补全可选项或重新校准关键评分，再决定是否进入执行。
en: Add viable options or recalibrate the key scores before moving into execution.

zh: 只查一条信息：「{focusName}」的成功条件、失败代价或信息差中，哪一项最可能推翻结论。
en: Research one fact only: which success condition, downside, or info gap could overturn {focusName}?

zh: 只查一条信息：成功条件、失败代价或信息差中，哪一项最可能推翻结论。
en: Research one fact only: which success condition, downside, or info gap could overturn the conclusion?

zh: 把当前概率、风险和收益依据写下来，避免事后只凭记忆复盘。
en: Write down the basis for the current odds, risk, and upside so review is not based on memory alone.

zh: 看完本轮守门线后不再新增变量，今天先执行第一步。
en: After this guardrail pass, stop adding variables and take the first step today.

zh: 补到 1 条关键事实，或到今晚 22:00 停止查证并重新看报告。
en: Stop after one key fact, or at 22:00 tonight, then review the report again.

zh: 最多再补 2 条证据；若两种推荐模型仍支持同一方向，就停止分析。
en: Add at most two more pieces of evidence; if two recommended lenses still agree, stop analyzing.

zh: 在下一个关键节点复盘：实际风险、信息差和可回退性是否如预期。
en: Review at the next key milestone: did risk, info gaps, and reversibility match the forecast?

zh: 执行后 24 小时或完成第一步后复盘一次。
en: Review once 24 hours after execution or after the first step is complete.

zh: 假设三个月后失败，最可能是信息不足、下行风险过大或不可回退环节失控；先写一个预防动作。
en: Assume this failed three months from now. The likely cause is missing information, excess downside, or poor reversibility; write one preventive action.

zh: 假设结果不如预期，最可能是哪条关键假设错了？先准备一个替代动作。
en: Assume the result disappoints. Which key assumption was probably wrong? Prepare one fallback action.

zh: 假设明天发现不值得做，最可能是哪项成本被低估？
en: Assume tomorrow shows this was not worth doing. Which cost was most likely underestimated?

zh: 把问题、可选项、风险和信息差拆开，用多模型交叉验证结论。
en: Separate the question, options, risks, and info gaps, then cross-check the conclusion.

zh: 情境会影响你更该先看随机、加权、情景分析还是安全线优先。
en: The context changes which lens should lead: random, weighted, scenario, or guardrails.

zh: 先用推荐模型收口，再按需切换交叉验证。
en: Start with recommended lenses, then cross-check as needed.
Close the most important info gap

zh: 优先补 {reportActiveWinnerOption} 的关键条件
低风险场景可以交给随机
en: Let randomness end a low-stakes tie

zh: 当前信息价值偏高，尤其适合先查一条最可能改变结论的事实。
en: The value of information is currently high, so first research the one fact most likely to change the answer.

zh: 信息价值 {reportInfoSignalImpactScore}。如果现在必须定，先看 {activeWinnerOption}；如果还能等等，先补信息更划算。
en: Information value is {reportInfoSignalImpactScore}. If you must decide now, start with {activeWinnerOption}; if not, more research is worth it.

zh: 成功/执行/把握填 0-1；收益、风险、投入、可回退、后悔、信息差填 0-10。
en: Use 0-1 for success, execution, and confidence. Use 0-10 for the other fields.

zh: 随机镜头不做质量排序，只负责帮你结束低风险犹豫。
en: Random mode does not rank quality. It only ends low-stakes dithering.

zh: 随机镜头不做质量排序；如果你想看更稳的结论，可以参考跨方法共识：{consensusWinnerName}。
en: Random mode does not rank quality. For a steadier read, check the cross-method consensus: {consensusWinnerName}.

zh: 高风险场景先看安全门槛，再谈收益。完整清单已下沉到弹窗。
en: For high-stakes calls, check guardrails before upside. Open the full checklist when needed.

zh: 最终拍板前，快速扫一遍偏差、噪声和复盘条件。
en: Before committing, scan bias, noise, and review conditions.

zh: 医疗、法律、财务等问题请把本模块当作整理思路的辅助，不要作为单一依据。
en: For medical, legal, or financial calls, use this only to organize thinking, not as the sole basis.

zh: 有效成功率 {p0} · 期望收益 {p1} · 期望损失 {p2}
联合成功率 {p0} · 下行暴露 {p1}
已实现潜力 {p0} · 后悔暴露 {p1} · 机会成本 {p2}
已过 {p0}/4 道守门线 · 同档综合 {p1}
随机镜头不做质量排序。
en: Random mode does not rank quality.

zh: 适合低风险、可回退、差别不大的日常选择。
en: Best for low-stakes, reversible choices with tiny differences.

zh: 每个选项概率相同，目的是尽快结束犹豫。
en: Each option gets the same chance. The goal is to end dithering fast.

zh: 不要把随机当成高风险决策的依据。
en: Do not use random choice for high-stakes decisions.

zh: 把价值、成功率、可回退性、风险和信息差放到同一把尺子上比较。
en: Compare value, success odds, reversibility, risk, and info gaps on one ruler.

zh: 正向项加权 - 风险/投入/后悔/信息差惩罚。
en: Weighted positives minus penalties for risk, effort, regret, and info gaps.

zh: 它适合排序，不代表绝对正确。
en: Useful for ranking, not for claiming certainty.

zh: 适合结果不确定、但可以估一个大致成功率的选择。
en: Best for uncertain outcomes when you can estimate rough odds.

zh: 成功概率 × 收益 - 失败暴露 - 投入成本。
en: Success probability × upside - downside exposure - effort cost.

zh: 输入概率来自你的判断，先做独立估值再讨论。
en: Your inputs are still judgments, so estimate independently first.

zh: 当结果需要“判断对 + 执行到位 + 条件真的成立”时，用更保守的乘法。
en: Use a conservative product when success needs multiple things to line up.

zh: 成功概率 × 执行概率 × 把握度，再扣掉下行暴露。
en: Success probability × execution probability × confidence, then subtract downside exposure.

zh: 适合多条件联动，不适合把彼此强相关的事件硬拆开。
en: Great for multi-step dependence, weaker when the events are strongly correlated.

zh: 把乐观、基准、悲观三种情景同时摆出来，避免只盯着最好结果。
en: Blend optimistic, base, and pessimistic scenarios so you do not stare only at the upside.

zh: 乐观 + 基准 + 悲观按不确定性加权汇总。
en: A weighted blend of optimistic, base, and pessimistic cases.

zh: 高不确定时要让悲观情景真正进场。
en: When uncertainty is high, let the pessimistic case carry real weight.

zh: 适合容易事后反复想“早知道就选另一个”的选择。
en: Useful when you are likely to revisit the decision and ask what you should have chosen.

zh: 已实现潜力 + 可回退补偿 - 后悔暴露 - 机会成本。
en: Realized upside plus reversibility buffer minus regret exposure and opportunity cost.

zh: 它是在校正情绪，不是在预测命运。
en: This lens corrects emotion; it does not predict destiny.

zh: 先看是否过最低门槛，再在过关选项里比较优先级。
en: Check minimum standards first, then rank only the options that clear them.

zh: 先判定信心、风险、可回退性、信息差是否过线，再用综合分做同档比较。
en: Check confidence, downside, reversibility, and info gaps first, then break ties with a composite score.

zh: 高风险场景先看安全线，再谈收益。
en: In high-stakes situations, protect the floor before chasing upside.

zh: 把过于极端的期望值往均值拉回，减少过度自信。
en: Shrink extreme forecasts back toward the mean to curb overconfidence.

zh: 平均值 + 把握度 × (原始预期 - 平均值)。
en: Average score + confidence × (raw forecast - average forecast).

zh: 它不是机器学习，只是把极端判断收一点。
en: This is not machine learning; it is a disciplined pull back from extremes.

zh: 真正高质量的决策，先判断是什么类型，再决定用哪种计算镜头。
en: High-quality decisions start by identifying the type of decision before choosing the math lens.

zh: 低风险且可回退：直接快决
en: Low stakes and reversible: decide fast

zh: 餐厅、周末安排、轻量购买这类问题，重点不是“最优”，而是别把精力耗在犹豫上。随机或加权因素通常就够。
en: For restaurants, weekend plans, or lightweight purchases, the point is not perfection. Random choice or weighted factors are usually enough.

zh: 高风险或难回头：先设安全门槛
en: High stakes or hard to undo: set guardrails first

zh: 如果一旦做错很难补救，先看风险、把握度、信息差和可回退性是否过线，再比较收益。
en: When mistakes are costly to unwind, check risk, confidence, info gaps, and reversibility before chasing upside.

zh: 高不确定：一定要把悲观情景拉进来
en: High uncertainty: bring in the pessimistic case

zh: 当你知道自己不知道很多时，单一分数不够，要同时看联合概率、情景分析和信息价值。
en: When you know you do not know enough, a single score is not enough. Use joint probability, scenarios, and information value together.

zh: 来自斯坦福决策质量框架，是这个子模块最重要的骨架。
en: Taken from the Stanford decision-quality framework. This is the backbone of the module.

zh: 先明确你在决定什么、时间范围是什么、哪些约束不能破。问题框错了，再精细计算也会偏。
en: Clarify what is being decided, the time horizon, and which constraints are non-negotiable. A bad frame corrupts later analysis.

zh: 至少造出 2 到 3 个可选项
en: Generate at least 2 to 3 viable options

zh: 很多糟糕决策不是在坏选项里选，而是根本没有认真生成备选。先扩展，再收口。
en: Many bad decisions happen because the option set was poor, not because comparison failed. Expand first, then narrow.

zh: 不是信息越多越好，而是越接近关键不确定因素越好。信息差高时，先问“哪条信息最可能改变结论”。
en: More information is not always better. Focus on the facts that are closest to the real uncertainty. Ask which missing fact could actually change the choice.

zh: 收益、成本、时间、体力、风险、体面、长期空间，哪些最重要，最好先写下来，再评分。
en: List what matters most before you score: upside, cost, time, energy, risk, reputation, or long-term room to grow.

zh: 不要只说“我感觉”。把概率、假设、门槛和为什么输给别的方案讲清楚，之后才知道该修哪一步。
en: Do not stop at “it feels right.” Make the probabilities, assumptions, thresholds, and tradeoffs visible so the decision can be reviewed later.
A decision must end in action

zh: 没有下一步动作的“决策”，往往只是延迟焦虑。决定后至少写下第一步、截止点和复盘时间。
en: A decision with no next action is usually just postponed anxiety. End with a first step, a stop point, and a review moment.

zh: 把“确定/不确定”的情绪语言，转成更可比较的概率语言。
en: Translate emotional certainty into probability language that can actually be compared.

zh: 把“我觉得会成”改成“我估计成功率 0.65 左右”。粗略也没关系，关键是强迫自己显式表达不确定性。
en: Replace “I think it will work” with something like “I estimate the success chance around 0.65.” Rough is fine. Explicit beats vague.

zh: 多条件同时成立时，用乘法更保守
en: Use multiplication when several conditions must hold

zh: 如果一个结果依赖多个环节都不掉链子，联合概率通常比单一主观概率更诚实。
en: When success depends on several links all holding together, joint probability is usually more honest than one broad guess.

zh: 高不确定时，把极端判断往均值拉回
en: Pull extreme forecasts back toward the mean

zh: 当证据不足但你给了很高或很低的预期，先做一次校准预测，防止过度自信或过度悲观。
en: If evidence is thin but your forecast is extreme, run a calibrated forecast to reduce overconfidence or over-pessimism.

zh: 新证据来了，就更新，不要硬扛
贝叶斯思维的核心不是公式，而是接受“我之前估错了，现在该改”。
en: The core of Bayesian thinking is not the formula. It is the willingness to say, “I estimated badly before, and now I will update.”

zh: 避免被锚点、沉没成本、故事感和群体噪声带跑。
en: Avoid getting dragged around by anchors, sunk costs, compelling stories, or group noise.

zh: 先独立估，再交流，防锚定
一旦先看到别人给的数或强烈意见，你自己的判断很容易被拖走。先写，再看。
en: Once you see someone else’s number or strong opinion, your own judgment drifts. Write yours down first.

zh: 沉没成本不是继续投入的理由
en: Sunk cost is not a reason to continue

zh: 已经花掉、且回不来的时间和钱，不该决定下一步。下一步只看未来成本和未来回报。
en: Past time and money that cannot be recovered should not govern the next step. Look only at future cost and future value.

zh: 用统一尺度逐项比较，降低噪声
en: Use a common scale to reduce noise

zh: 对每个选项都用同一组字段、同一组尺度、同一顺序去评估，比“想到什么算什么”稳定得多。
en: Using the same fields, scales, and order across options is much more stable than improvising criteria as you go.

zh: 故事好听，不等于证据够强
en: A good story is not strong evidence

zh: 确认偏差、后见之明和幸存者偏差都会让故事显得过于圆满。回到数据、概率和基准率。
en: Confirmation bias, hindsight, and survivorship bias all make stories seem more convincing than they are. Go back to numbers, probabilities, and base rates.

zh: 何时继续查，何时直接做
en: When to research more and when to move

zh: 信息价值不是无限的，分析也需要停表点。
en: Information has value, but analysis still needs a stop point.

zh: 如果一条信息最可能改结论，就先去补它
en: Collect the one fact most likely to change the answer

zh: 不是“继续搜一搜”这么模糊，而是明确要补什么信息、什么时候补到停止。
en: Do not just “do more research.” Define which missing fact matters and when the search stops.

zh: 设停止规则，防止无限分析
例如“今晚 10 点前补完 3 条证据就定”“连续两轮结果一致就执行”。没有停止规则，焦虑会冒充认真。
en: Examples: “I decide after three pieces of evidence” or “I act once two rounds agree.” Without a stop rule, anxiety pretends to be diligence.

zh: 高风险先做一次预演式失败复盘
en: Run a premortem for high-stakes choices

zh: 假设三个月后这件事失败了，最可能是因为什么。把最容易翻车的环节提前写出来。
en: Imagine the choice has failed three months from now. What most likely caused it? Write down the plausible failure modes now.

zh: 医疗、法律、金融仍需专业判断
en: Medical, legal, and financial calls still need experts

zh: 这个模块适合辅助日常与一般工作生活决策，不替代医生、律师、理财顾问或正式风控流程。
en: This module supports everyday and general work-life decisions. It does not replace doctors, lawyers, financial advisers, or formal risk controls.

zh: 先独立打分，再看别人意见
锚定通常发生在讨论开始前。先写自己的概率、风险和收益，再去听外部意见。
en: Anchoring happens before the conversation even starts. Write your own probabilities, risks, and payoffs before hearing outside views.

zh: 不要为沉没成本追加投入
en: Do not double down on sunk cost

zh: 已经花出去的时间、金钱和面子，不是继续的理由。下一步只看未来代价与未来价值。
en: Past time, money, or ego are not reasons to continue. The next move should be based only on future cost and future value.

zh: 用同一套字段比较所有选项
en: Use the same fields for every option

zh: 噪声常来自“这个方案看重努力，另一个方案却看重结果”。统一标准比争论更能降噪。
en: Noise often comes from shifting standards midstream. Consistent fields reduce noise better than more argument.

zh: 高不确定时，优先看基准率和均值回归
en: Use base rates when uncertainty is high

zh: 当你没有足够案例支撑极端判断时，先用校准预测把预期拉回中间，再看证据是否足以推离均值。
en: If you do not have enough evidence for an extreme forecast, pull it toward the middle first and then ask whether the evidence is strong enough to move away from the mean.

zh: 先补最可能改变结论的那条信息
en: Research the fact most likely to change the answer

zh: 如果要继续查，不要散着查。先找那条最可能把胜负翻过去的信息，再决定是否值得继续。
en: If you do more research, do not do it randomly. Target the single fact most likely to flip the choice first.

zh: 高风险决策先做一次预演式复盘
en: Run a premortem for high stakes

zh: 假设结果失败了，最可能会输在哪一步。把这一步写出来，通常比继续堆更多信息更有用。
en: Assume the decision fails. Where is it most likely to break? Writing that down is often more useful than endlessly gathering more information.

zh: 跨方法分歧大时，回到价值排序
en: Return to value ranking when methods disagree

zh: 不同方法若给出不同答案，通常不是模型错了，而是你真正看重的东西还没排清楚。
en: When the methods disagree, the problem is often not the math. It is that your true priorities have not been ranked clearly yet.

zh: 现在就要定时，先写下停止规则
en: If you must decide now, define a stopping rule

zh: 例如“看完这轮排名和守门线就执行，不再开新变量”。在时间压力下，边分析边扩题只会放大噪声。
en: For example: “Once I finish this ranking and guardrail pass, I act and stop opening new variables.” Under time pressure, expanding the question only amplifies noise.

zh: 按问题、可选项、情境和校准四步收口；高级表格按需展开。
en: Narrow the question, options, context, and scoring. Open the table only when needed.

zh: 一句话说明当前要决定的事，避免在范围外来回摇摆。
en: Use one sentence so the decision does not keep drifting.

zh: 例如：今晚要不要推进这个方案？
en: Example: should I move forward with this plan tonight?

zh: 保留 2 到 4 个真实可做的选择；单方案时先补一个保守备选。
en: Keep 2 to 4 viable options; add a conservative fallback if needed.

zh: 风险、信息差和可回头性决定优先用哪种模型。
en: Stakes, info gaps, and reversibility decide the leading lens.
Score one option at a time

zh: 先回答最影响结论的四项；完整校准可稍后展开。
en: Answer the four highest-impact fields first; expand the rest later.

zh: 它成功的可能性有多高？
如果顺利，收益/价值有多大？
en: If it works, how valuable is it?
If it goes badly, how costly is it?
How much effort does it take?

zh: 你对这些估计有多有把握？

en: How much regret exposure is there?
How large is the info gap?

zh: 建议先补一条关键信息
en: Gather one key missing fact first

zh: 建议先补 {highlightName} 的关键信息
en: Gather one missing fact for {highlightName} first

zh: 推荐优先查看：{recommended}。下面的报告会把所有模型放在一起对照。
en: Recommended lenses: {recommended}. The report below compares every model side by side.

zh: 需要精细复盘时再展开；问答流会同步这些字段。
en: Open for detailed review; the guided flow updates the same fields.

zh: 先看结论、稳定度和信息价值；完整模型对照放到弹窗里。
en: Scan the conclusion, stability, and information value first. Open the full model comparison when needed.

zh: 推荐模型优先展开；其余模型用于发现分歧和校验盲点。
en: Recommended models open first; the rest expose disagreement and blind spots.

zh: 把模型结论变成下一步、停止规则、复盘条件和失败预演。
en: Turn the model result into a next step, stop rule, review trigger, and premortem.

zh: 写成今天或明天能执行的一句话。
en: Write one action you can take today or tomorrow.

zh: 只写最可能改变结论的一条信息。
en: Name the one fact most likely to change the answer.

zh: 例如到某个时间、补够几条证据或两种模型一致就停止。
en: Use a time, evidence count, or model agreement as the stop point.

zh: 写清什么时候检查结果是否符合预期。
en: Define when to check whether reality matched the forecast.

zh: 假设失败了，最可能输在哪一步？
en: Assume it failed. Where did it most likely break?

zh: 用加权因素先排出优先级。
en: Rank options with weighted factors first.

zh: 低风险、可回头、差别不大时尽快结束犹豫。
en: End dithering when the choice is low-stakes and reversible.

zh: 先检查安全门槛，再谈收益。
让情景分析和信息价值优先。
当前信息价值为 {reportInfoSignalImpactScore}，先查一条最可能改变结论的事实。
en: Information value is {reportInfoSignalImpactScore}. Check the one fact most likely to change the conclusion.

zh: 当前信息价值为 {reportInfoSignalImpactScore}，优先核实 {highlight} 的关键假设。
en: Information value is {reportInfoSignalImpactScore}. Verify the key assumption behind {highlight} first.

zh: 有 {reportConsensusSupportCount}/{reportConsensusMethodCount} 个质量模型支持该方向；下一步写清执行动作和复盘条件。
en: {reportConsensusSupportCount}/{reportConsensusMethodCount} quality models support that direction. Next, define the action and review trigger.

zh: 先补充方案或重新校准概率、风险、投入和信息差，再看报告。
en: Add options or recalibrate probability, risk, effort, and info gaps, then review the report again.

zh: 当前继续查证有价值，落地草案会优先生成“只补一条关键信息”的任务，避免无限搜索。
en: More research is currently valuable, so the draft starts with one targeted evidence task instead of open-ended searching.

zh: 不要停在“我决定了”。生成草案后，至少留下下一步动作、停止规则和复盘触发。
en: Do not stop at “I decided.” Generate the draft, then keep a next action, stop rule, and review trigger.

zh: 当前结论还不稳，先把下一步写成小动作，再回到选项或评分校准。
en: The conclusion is still unstable. Make the next step small, then revisit options or scoring.

zh: 随机模型不判断质量，只在低风险、可回头、差别很小时负责停止消耗。
en: Random choice does not judge quality. It only stops low-stakes, reversible dithering.

zh: 把收益、成功率、把握度和可回头性加总，再扣除风险、投入、后悔和信息差。
en: Adds upside, odds, confidence, and reversibility, then subtracts risk, effort, regret, and info gaps.

zh: {winner} 的综合拉力暂时最高，适合当作常规主结论。
en: {winner} currently has the strongest composite pull.

zh: 用概率折算收益和损失，适合能粗略估计成功率的选择。
en: Converts gains and losses through probability when odds can be roughly estimated.

zh: {winner} 在概率折算后的净收益更高。
en: {winner} has the stronger probability-adjusted net value.

zh: 把“判断对、执行到位、有把握”连乘，适合多条件同时成立才算成功的场景。
en: Multiplies judgment, execution, and confidence for decisions that need several conditions to line up.

zh: {winner} 在多条件同时成立时仍保留较好胜率。
en: {winner} keeps the better chance when multiple conditions must align.

zh: 同时看乐观、基准、悲观三种情景，避免只盯着最好结果。
en: Blends optimistic, base, and pessimistic cases so the upside does not dominate.

zh: {winner} 在乐观、基准和悲观混合后更稳。
en: {winner} is stronger after blending optimistic, base, and pessimistic cases.

zh: 检查未来后悔、机会成本和可回头缓冲。
en: Checks future regret, opportunity cost, and reversibility buffers.

zh: {winner} 的后悔暴露和机会成本更可控。
en: {winner} has more manageable regret and opportunity-cost exposure.

zh: 先看把握、风险、可回头和信息差是否过线，再做排序。
en: Checks confidence, downside, reversibility, and info gaps before ranking.

zh: {winner} 在安全线优先下排在前面，适合高风险场景优先参考。
en: {winner} leads under guardrails, which matters most in higher-stakes contexts.

zh: 把过于极端的预期往均值拉回，用来削弱过度自信。
en: Pulls extreme forecasts toward the mean to reduce overconfidence.

zh: {winner} 在校准极端预期后仍然占优。
en: {winner} still leads after extreme expectations are calibrated.

zh: 适用：餐厅、轻量安排、可撤销小选择；不适用：高风险或难回头事项。
en: Use for restaurants, light plans, or reversible small choices. Avoid it for high-stakes calls.

zh: 适用：需要在多个因素之间做清晰权衡的常规选择。
en: Best when several factors need a transparent tradeoff.

zh: 适用：收益和风险可粗略量化，且概率不是纯猜。
en: Best when value and risk can be roughly quantified and the odds are not pure guesses.

zh: 适用：成功依赖多个环节同时成立，例如判断、资源、执行都要到位。
en: Best when success depends on multiple links such as judgment, resources, and execution.

zh: 适用：不确定性高，且最坏情景真的可能改变选择。
en: Best when uncertainty is high and the pessimistic case could change the choice.

zh: 适用：你很在意事后复盘、错失机会或长期后悔。
en: Best when future review, missed opportunity, or regret matters.

zh: 适用：高风险、难回头、时间紧或需要先守住基本盘。
en: Best when stakes are high, reversal is hard, time is tight, or the floor must be protected.

zh: 适用：你怀疑自己被乐观、悲观或锚定带偏。
en: Best when optimism, pessimism, or anchoring may be pulling estimates too far.

zh: 分差很小，适合补信息或用低风险随机收口。
en: The margin is tiny; gather more information or use random choice if stakes are low.

zh: 分差存在但不厚，建议看其他模型是否同意。
en: The lead exists but is not thick; check whether other models agree.

zh: 分差较清晰，可以进入行动条件检查。
en: The lead is clear enough to move into action checks.

zh: 按顺序看就能快速上手
先选一个模块看，再往下读对应说明，会比一口气塞满全部信息更好消化。
en: Pick one guide module first and then read the matching notes below.

zh: 这个食谱集在当前筛选下没有可选菜品。可以放宽筛选、向集合加入菜谱，或切回内置菜谱。
en: This recipe set has no dishes under the current filters. Relax filters, add recipes to the set, or switch back to built-in recipes.

zh: 当前筛选条件有点严，没有找到合适菜品。可以放宽高级设置、换厨具，或在管理里新增你的个人菜谱。
en: The current filters are too strict. Relax advanced settings, switch tools, or add your own recipe in Manage.

zh: 这个餐段已经没有可选菜品，可以在管理里恢复内置菜或新增个人食谱。
en: No dishes left for this meal. Restore built-ins or add a personal recipe in Manage.

zh: 这个餐段和厨具组合下暂时没有菜品，可以换一个厨具、恢复隐藏菜，或补充你的个人食谱。
en: No dishes match this meal and tool yet. Try another tool, restore hidden dishes, or add a personal recipe.

zh: 完全匹配的食材优先进入候选池，再加入高度重叠的菜谱丰富选择。
en: Exact ingredient matches lead the pool, then strong overlaps are added for variety.

zh: 完全匹配的食材优先进入候选池。
en: Exact ingredient matches lead the pool.

zh: 暂无完全匹配，候选池优先保留食材高度重叠的菜谱。
en: No exact match yet, so the pool prefers strong ingredient overlaps.

zh: 暂无高度重叠，候选池保留至少匹配一种食材的菜谱。
en: No strong overlap yet, so the pool keeps recipes that match at least one ingredient.

zh: 还没有食材命中，筛选后的完整候选池保持可用。
en: No ingredient hit yet, so the full filtered pool stays available.

zh: 菜谱摘要已经准备好，点开菜名时再展示完整做法。
en: Recipe summaries are ready. Full instructions open when you view a dish.

zh: 首次使用需要准备菜谱库，完成后下次打开会更快。
en: Prepare the recipe library once; future openings will be faster.

zh: 最近一次同步有异常，当前会继续使用本地可用菜谱库。
en: The latest sync reported an error. The page will keep using the local library that is already available.

zh: 可以按现有材料、荤素结构和常见排除项把菜谱库进一步收口，并支持把食材与排除项拆成可增删的列表。
en: Refine the recipe pool by available ingredients, profile, and common avoid filters with editable token lists.

zh: 系统会先找全命中，再找高重叠，最后保留至少命中一项材料的相关菜谱，避免随机池被压成只剩一道菜。
en: The system tries exact matches first, then strong overlaps, then recipes that hit at least one ingredient to avoid collapsing to a single result.

zh: 支持一次输入多个食材，添加后会变成可删除的标签。匹配时会先看全交集，再看高重叠，最后保留相关合集。
en: Add multiple ingredients at once. Matching prefers exact overlap first, then strong overlap, then broader related recipes.

zh: 例如：鸡蛋、番茄、豆腐、土豆
en: For example: egg, tomato, tofu, potato

zh: 用于快速排除常见忌口与过敏原；命中后该菜会被移出当前候选。
en: Quickly exclude common avoid items and allergens from the current pool.

zh: 适合补充香菜、鱼腥草、蒜、姜、葱等个性化忌口。会同时检查常见忌口标签和食材关键词。
en: Use this for personal avoid items such as cilantro, houttuynia, garlic, ginger, or scallion.

zh: 一句话推荐 / 口味特点
详细介绍 / 适合什么时候做
为什么这样搭 / 适合哪天穿
执行边界 / 为什么做
核心单品 / 搭配组成（每行一个）
开始条件 / 准备（每行一个）
材料 / 条件（每行一个）
穿法步骤 / 出门检查
技巧 / 备注（每行一条）
替换方案 / 保养提醒
退出条件 / 注意事项
附加标签（例如家常、下饭、减脂）
en: Tags, for example home-style, rice-friendly, or light

zh: 附加标签（会自动并入风格特征）
en: Tags, automatically merged into style traits

zh: 附加标签（例如低阻力、户外、重启）
en: Tags, for example low-friction, outdoor, or restart

zh: 标签（用顿号、逗号或空格分隔）
en: Tags, separated by commas or spaces

zh: 先从你真实拥有的单品出发：能明天就穿、能替换、能重复出现的搭配，才值得放进我的衣柜。
en: Start from pieces you actually own. A useful outfit is wearable tomorrow, easy to substitute, and worth repeating.

zh: 保存时会自动从菜名、食材、备注和主餐段推断餐段重叠、食材关键词、做法类型和常见排除项。
en: Saving automatically infers overlapping meals, ingredient keywords, dish types, and common avoid terms from the title, materials, notes, and primary meal.

zh: 行动要写成低摩擦、可结束的事件：什么时候开始、做到哪一步算完成、什么情况可以停。
en: Save actions as low-friction, finishable events: when to start, what counts as done, and when to stop.

zh: 写成“核心单品 + 下装 + 鞋/外套”，以后更容易复用。
en: Use “key piece + bottom + shoes/outer layer” so it is easy to reuse.

zh: 写成动词开头的小动作，例如“散步 12 分钟”“整理桌面一小块”。
en: Start with a verb, such as “walk for 12 minutes” or “clear one desk zone”.

zh: 说明这套适合哪种日程、天气或心情，不必写成评价。
en: Name the day, weather, or mood this outfit solves.

zh: 写“注意力涣散时”“饭后不想坐着时”“睡前想收口时”这类入口。
en: Name the entry point, such as distracted, after a meal, or before bed.

zh: 可写比例、颜色、材质、行动便利和当天场景。
en: Mention proportion, color, fabric, mobility, and scene.

zh: 说明目标、完成标准和退出条件，不把行动写成无限任务。
en: State the goal, done condition, and exit rule so it does not become endless.

zh: 优先写真实拥有的单品；没有同款时写可替代颜色、版型或面料。
en: Use real closet pieces first; add substitutes by color, shape, or fabric.

zh: 例如：计时器 8 分钟、无需换衣、只需要手机备忘录。
en: For example: 8-minute timer, no outfit change, notes app only.

zh: 建议写：先确定内外层，再看比例，最后检查鞋包和天气。
en: Try: layer first, then proportion, then shoes, bag, and weather.

zh: 第一步必须足够小；最后一步写“到点停止或记录下一步”。
en: Make step one tiny; end with stop on time or record next step.

zh: 记录容易忘的点：裤长、鞋底、防晒、保暖、易皱或洗护。
en: Record easy-to-forget details: hem, traction, sun, warmth, wrinkles, care.

zh: 写明身体不舒服、天气不合适、时间被打断时可以如何替代。
en: Note substitutions when body, weather, or time is not suitable.

zh: 性别和年龄只是参考标签，按你自己的穿着习惯选就好。
en: Gender and age are reference tags only; choose by your real habits.

zh: 先写真实单品，再写替代方案。
en: Start with real pieces, then note substitutes.

zh: 先解决温度和行动，再处理风格亮点。
en: Solve weather and movement before styling accents.

zh: 用性别和年龄做参考，不把它们当规则。
en: Use gender and age as references, not rules.

zh: 可以多选；不选则只保存为个人菜谱，不加入任何集合。
en: Select one or more sets. Leave all unchecked to save only as a personal recipe.

zh: 建议至少选一个自己的衣柜。这样随机时可以直接从真实衣橱里抽取，而不是只看内置参考。
en: Choose at least one wardrobe when possible, so random picks can come from your real closet instead of only the built-in reference.

zh: 建议至少选一个行动集。之后随机会先按行动集收口，再从里面抽取具体行动。
en: Choose at least one action set when possible. Random picks will draw from the selected set.

zh: 「{collectionTitle}」只会删除这个集合，不会删除集合里的个人菜谱或内置菜谱。
en: "{collectionTitle}" will be removed as a set. Recipes inside it will not be deleted.

zh: 「{collectionTitle}」只会删除这个衣橱，不会删除衣橱里的个人搭配或内置穿搭。
en: "{collectionTitle}" will be removed as a wardrobe. Outfits inside it will not be deleted.

zh: 「{collectionTitle}」只会删除这个集合，不会删除集合里的个人行动或内置行动。
en: "{collectionTitle}" will be removed as a set. Actions inside it will not be deleted.

zh: 「{optionTitle}」会从随机候选中隐藏，之后仍可在管理页恢复。
en: "{optionTitle}" will be hidden from random picks. You can restore it later in Manage.

zh: 展开后按当前搜索和筛选查看内置参考搭配。
en: Expand to show built-in reference outfits using the current search and filters.

zh: 展开后按当前搜索和筛选查看内置行动。
en: Expand to show built-in actions using the current search and filters.

zh: 展开后按当前搜索和筛选查看内置菜谱。
en: Expand to show built-in recipes using the current search and filters.

zh: 正在按当前筛选读取内置参考搭配。
en: Loading built-in reference outfits for the current filters.

zh: 正在按当前筛选读取内置行动。
en: Loading built-in actions for the current filters.

zh: 正在按当前筛选读取内置菜谱。
en: Loading built-in recipes for the current filters.

zh: 读取内置参考搭配时遇到问题，可稍后重试。
en: Built-in reference outfits could not be loaded. Try again later.

zh: 读取内置行动时遇到问题，可稍后重试。
en: Built-in actions could not be loaded. Try again later.

zh: 读取内置菜谱时遇到问题，可稍后重试。
en: Built-in recipes could not be loaded. Try again later.

zh: 已显示 {visible} / {total} 条；搜索和筛选仍作用于完整参考搭配库。
en: Showing {visible} of {total}; search and filters still cover the full outfit reference library.

zh: 已显示 {visible} / {total} 条；搜索和筛选仍作用于完整行动库。
en: Showing {visible} of {total}; search and filters still cover the full action library.

zh: 已显示 {visible} / {total} 条；搜索和筛选仍作用于完整菜谱库。
en: Showing {visible} of {total}; search and filters still cover the full recipe library.

zh: 可把内置搭配当模板，调整后另存为自己的真实衣柜搭配。
en: Use built-in outfits as templates, adjust them, then save real wardrobe versions of your own.

zh: 可把内置行动加入行动集，也可隐藏不适合自己的行动。
en: Add built-in actions to action sets or hide actions that do not fit you.

zh: 可隐藏不喜欢的条目，也可在原菜谱上做个人调整或另存为个人食谱。
en: Hide unwanted items, save adjustments, or copy a built-in as your own recipe.

zh: 内置条目适合作为参考模板；个人衣柜会保存在本机，并可按性别参考、年龄阶段、风格、版型和样式类型管理。
en: Built-ins are reference templates. Your wardrobe stays local and can be managed by gender reference, age stage, style, silhouette, and key pieces.

zh: 内置行动来自可下载事件库；行动集保存在本机，可把内置行动和个人行动整理成不同随机池。
en: Built-in actions come from a downloadable library. Action sets stay local and define random pools.

zh: 不喜欢会先确认再隐藏内置菜；个人调整会覆盖原菜谱参与随机；个人食谱保存在本机并参与高级筛选。
en: Disliked built-ins are hidden after confirmation, personal adjustments override built-ins, and personal recipes stay local for filtering and random picks.

zh: 删除内置条目会把它加入“不喜欢”隐藏列表；自定义条目会保存在本机。
en: Deleting a built-in item hides it. Custom items are saved locally.

zh: 当前筛选下还没有个人食谱。可以补上你常做、爱吃、想长期保存的菜。
en: No personal recipes in this filter yet. Add the dishes you actually make or want to keep.

zh: 当前筛选下还没有个人衣柜搭配。可以从真实衣柜新建一套，也可以把内置参考另存后改成自己的单品。
en: No personal wardrobe outfits in this filter yet. Create one from your real wardrobe or save a built-in reference and adapt it.

zh: 当前筛选下还没有个人行动。可以新增一个低阻力动作，或先把内置行动加入行动集。
en: No personal actions in this filter yet. Add a low-friction action or add built-ins to an action set first.

zh: 当前筛选下还没有自定义条目。可以补上自己的搭配、地点或行动。
en: No custom items in this filter yet. Add your own outfits, places, or actions.

zh: 当前筛选下没有内置参考搭配。可以放宽气温、场景、性别年龄或风格筛选，也可以直接新建自己的衣柜搭配。
en: No built-in reference outfits match this filter. Relax temperature, scene, gender, age, or style filters, or create your own wardrobe outfit.

zh: 当前筛选下没有内置行动。可以换一个行动方向，或先安装/刷新行动库。
en: No built-in actions match this filter. Switch action direction or install/refresh the action library.

zh: 当前筛选下没有内置菜谱，换一个分类或上下文试试。
en: No built-in recipes match this filter. Try another category or context.

zh: 请先选择一个个人食谱集。
en: Choose a personal recipe set first.

zh: 所选食谱集文件无法读取。
en: Selected recipe set file could not be read.

zh: 所选衣橱文件无法读取。
en: Selected wardrobe file could not be read.

zh: 所选行动集文件无法读取。
en: Selected action set file could not be read.

zh: 按菜名、简介关键词快速筛选
en: Search by recipe title or summary

zh: 可把常做菜、减脂餐、待尝试等集合成独立随机池。
en: Group favorites, weekday meals, or recipes to try into separate pools.

zh: 例如：一周晚餐、低油清淡、想试试
按搭配名称、真实单品、场景关键词筛选
en: Search by outfit, piece, or scene keyword

zh: 把真实会穿的通勤、周末、运动、雨天组合整理成独立衣柜。内置衣柜只做参考，你的衣柜才是日常随机的核心。
en: Group real commute, weekend, active, or rainy-day outfits into wardrobes. Built-ins are references; your wardrobe is the daily core.

zh: 例如：日常通勤、周末休闲、运动穿搭
en: For example: Daily commute, Weekend casual

zh: 按行动名称、触发场景、标签筛选
en: Search by action, trigger, or tag

zh: 把注意力重启、短出门、整理、学习、放松等行动整理成独立随机池。每次随机会先按当前行动集收口。
en: Group focus resets, quick outings, tidying, learning, and recovery actions into separate random pools.

zh: 例如：注意力重启、饭后出门、睡前收口
en: For example: Focus reset, After-meal walk

zh: 当前显示全部范围。可以按性别参考、年龄阶段、风格和版型逐步缩小。
en: Showing the full range. Narrow it by gender reference, age stage, style, and silhouette.

zh: 当前显示全部行动方向，可按行动类型逐步缩小。
en: Showing every action direction. Narrow it by action type.

zh: 当前显示全部范围，可折叠收起。
en: Showing the full range for now. Collapse this section when you are done.

zh: 这些是你基于真实衣柜保存的搭配，可编辑、删除，也会直接参与随机。
en: These outfits come from your real wardrobe and can be edited, removed, and used in random picks.

zh: 这些是你保存的个人行动，可加入不同行动集并直接参与随机。
en: Your saved actions can be edited, grouped, and used in random picks.

zh: 完全属于你的新增条目，可直接编辑和删除。
en: Your own saved items that can be edited or removed.

zh: 基于内置搭配保存的个人版本，会直接参与随机与筛选。
en: Your personal overrides of built-in outfits.

zh: 基于内置菜谱保存的个人口味版本，会直接参与随机与筛选。
en: Your personal overrides of built-in recipes.

zh: 当前筛选下还没有保存过穿搭调整。点开内置搭配即可基于原方案做个人化微调。
en: No personal adjustments in this filter yet.

zh: 当前筛选下还没有保存过个人调整。点开内置菜即可基于原菜谱做个人化微调。
en: No personal recipe adjustments in this filter yet. Open a built-in recipe to tune it from the original.

zh: 这套搭配当前已加入不喜欢列表。
en: This outfit is hidden right now.

zh: 这个行动当前已加入不喜欢列表。
en: This action is hidden right now.

zh: 这道菜当前已加入不喜欢列表。
en: This recipe is hidden right now.

zh: 正在加载更多内置搭配...
正在加载更多内置行动...
正在加载更多内置菜谱...
还有 {length} 个 {p1} 可以加载。
{categorySubtitleEn}，然后在整个集合中随机挑选。
en: {categorySubtitleEn}, then randomize across the whole set.

zh: 这个距离下暂时没有可用地点，可以在管理里恢复隐藏条目或新增你常去的地点。
en: No destinations are available in this distance tier right now. Restore hidden items or add your own frequent places.

zh: 这个距离和场景组合下暂时没有地点，可换一个场景，或在管理里补充你自己的常去点。
en: No destinations match this distance and scene yet. Try another scene or add your own place in Manage.

zh: 当前「{selectedDistanceTitleEn}」档位共有 {distanceCount} 个场所，覆盖 {sceneCoverageCount} 种场景。只想出门走走时，按距离优先随机很实用。
en: The current {selectedDistanceTitleEn} tier contains {distanceCount} places across {sceneCoverageCount} scenes. Distance-first randomizing works well when you just want to get moving.

zh: 暂时没有「{selectedDistanceTitleEn} × {selectedSceneTitleEn}」的候选，可切换场景，或在管理中添加自己的场所。
en: There are no candidates for {selectedDistanceTitleEn} × {selectedSceneTitleEn} yet. Switch the scene or add your own place in Manage.

zh: 当前「{selectedDistanceTitleEn} × {selectedSceneTitleEn}」筛选共有 {candidateCount} 个候选。详情包含地图查询，数据模型已为粗略定位和开放地理数据预留空间。
en: The current {selectedDistanceTitleEn} × {selectedSceneTitleEn} filter gives {candidateCount} candidates. Details include a map query, and the data model already leaves room for coarse location and open geo data later.

zh: 这个方向或行动集暂时没有候选。可以换一个行动集，或在管理里加入/新增行动。
en: No actions match this direction or set. Switch sets or add one in Manage.

zh: 还没有安装内置行动库。可以先下载行动库，也可以在管理里新增自己的低阻力行动。
en: The built-in action library is not installed yet. Install it or add your own action.

zh: 每次随机会基于当前行动集收口；选择内置行动库则查看全部可用行动。
en: Random picks draw from this set; built-in library shows all available actions.

zh: 已安装 {statusActionCount} 个行动；随机会结合方向、行动集和隐藏列表生成候选。
en: {statusActionCount} actions installed. Picks use direction, action set, and hidden items.

zh: 内置行动库尚未安装。下载后会写入本地 SQLite，行动内容不再硬编码在 App 里。
en: The built-in action library is not installed. It will be downloaded and installed into local SQLite.

zh: 数据源会从远端 JSON 下载，安装成功后替换本地 SQLite。若下载失败，已有本地库会保留；没有本地库时仍可使用自己的行动集。
en: The remote JSON is downloaded and installed into local SQLite. Existing local data is kept if refresh fails; personal action sets still work without the built-in library.

zh: 内置地点库已就绪（{libraryStatusPlaceCount} 条）
内置地点库已就绪，按距离和场景随机方向。你也可以在管理里补充自己常去的地点。
en: The built-in place library is ready. You can also add your own frequent places in Manage.

zh: 首次使用可下载内置地点库；下载后按距离和场景筛选随机。
en: Download the built-in place library once to randomize by distance and scene.

zh: 最近一次同步有异常，当前会继续使用本地可用地点库。
en: The latest sync reported an error. The page will keep using the local library that is already available.

zh: 地图瓦片和场所数据按需查询；App 没有中间服务器收集或留存你的定位信息，也不会批量下载地图瓦片。IP 粗略范围只使用网络出口估算城市级中心点，不请求 GPS。
en: Map tiles and place data are queried on demand. The app does not collect or store your location through an intermediary server, and it does not bulk-download map tiles. IP coarse area only estimates a city-level center from the network exit and does not request GPS.

zh: 当前半径内没有找到可用场所。可以扩大范围，或稍后再试。
en: No usable places were found in this radius. Try a larger range or come back later.

zh: 周边场所查询失败。OpenStreetMap 公共服务可能繁忙，请稍后再试。
en: Nearby place lookup failed. The public OpenStreetMap service may be busy; try again later.

zh: IP 粗略范围内没有找到可用场所。可以稍后再试，或改用设备定位查询。
en: No usable places were found in the IP coarse area. Try again later or use device location.

zh: IP 粗略范围场所查询失败。公共地图服务可能繁忙，请稍后再试。
en: IP coarse area lookup failed. The public map service may be busy; try again later.

zh: 打开 App 定位权限
系统已阻止本 App 使用定位。打开设置后，请为本 App 允许定位权限，再返回查询周边场所。
en: The system is blocking location for this app. Open settings, allow location permission, then return to find nearby places.

zh: 系统定位服务尚未开启。打开设置后，请开启定位/GPS，再返回查询周边场所。
en: System location services are off. Open settings, enable location/GPS, then return to find nearby places.

zh: 系统定位服务未开启。开启定位后再获取周边场所。
en: System location services are disabled. Enable location services and try again.

zh: 你尚未授予定位权限。授权后才能按当前位置查询周边场所。
en: Location permission was not granted. Grant it to search near your current position.

zh: 定位权限已被系统设为拒绝。请到系统设置中为本 App 开启定位权限。
en: Location permission is blocked. Enable it for this app in system settings.

zh: 无法通过网络获取 IP 粗略范围：{message}
en: Could not read an IP coarse area: {message}

zh: IP 粗略定位请求失败（{statusCode}）。
定位权限已被永久拒绝。
IP 粗略定位返回了异常响应。
en: IP coarse location returned an unexpected response.

zh: IP 粗略定位结果没有包含坐标。
en: IP coarse location did not include coordinates.

zh: 保存场所失败，请稍后再试。
en: Could not save this place. Try again later.

zh: 没有找到可用的地图应用或网页入口，请稍后再试。
en: No available map app or web map entry was found. Try again later.

zh: 拉起地图应用失败，请稍后再试。
en: Could not open the map app. Try again later.

zh: 启用后，App 会在你点击查询时读取当前位置，用来计算附近半径、距离排序和真实场所候选。默认使用模糊位置；你也可以切换为精确定位。
en: When enabled, the app reads your location only when you tap search. It uses it to calculate radius, distance order, and real nearby place candidates. Approximate location is used by default; precise location is optional.

zh: 查询只在你点击时由设备按需发起。App 没有中间服务器收集、留存或转卖你的定位数据；保存场所时也不会保存你的 GPS 坐标。
en: Lookup starts from your device only when you tap. The app does not collect, store, or sell your location through an intermediary server; your GPS coordinates are not saved when you save a place.

zh: 位置只用于当前半径查询、距离排序和地图打开。App 不经中间服务器收集位置；模糊位置会把坐标归到约 500 米网格。也可以使用 IP 粗略范围，不请求 GPS，只按网络出口估算城市级位置。
en: Location is used only for this radius lookup, distance sorting, and opening maps. The app does not collect it through an intermediary server. Approximate mode snaps coordinates to an about 500 m grid. IP coarse area does not request GPS and only estimates a city-level center from the network exit.

zh: 地图结果会与当前「去哪儿」筛选联动：{distanceTitle} · {sceneTitle}。
en: Map results can follow the current Where to go filters: {distanceTitle} · {sceneTitle}.

zh: 地图瓦片按视野动态加载；本地缓存只保存你看过的瓦片，不做区域批量下载。
en: Tiles load on demand for the visible area; local cache only stores tiles you have viewed and does not bulk-download regions.

zh: 如果地图下载失败，通常是当前网络无法访问该瓦片服务；请稍后重试或切换其它来源。
en: If map tiles fail to download, the current network may not be able to reach that tile service; retry later or switch sources.

zh: 这是 OpenStreetMap 官方公共瓦片源，可能触发公共服务限流或超时；建议只在需要核对标准样式时使用。
en: This is the official OpenStreetMap public tile server and may be rate-limited or time out; use it only when the standard style is needed.

zh: 这是 OSM 社区公共瓦片源，App 会按视野加载并缓存已看过的瓦片；请避免批量预下载。连接不稳定时可切换其他源。
en: This is an OSM community public tile source. The app loads visible tiles on demand and caches viewed tiles; avoid bulk downloading and switch sources if the connection is unstable.

zh: 减少重复加载和弱网下的白屏；可随时清空。
en: Reduces repeated loading and blank tiles on weak networks; can be cleared anytime.

zh: 结果变化后自动贴合地图
查询或切换筛选后，地图自动回到能看清当前位置和候选点的视野。
en: After lookup or filter changes, the map returns to a view that includes your center and candidates.

zh: 清空地图缓存失败，请稍后再试。
en: Could not clear the map cache. Try again later.

zh: 当前「去哪儿」筛选下没有匹配的周边场所，可关闭筛选联动查看全部结果。
