en: No nearby places match the current Where to go filters. Turn off filter focus to view all results.

zh: 获取周边后，地图中的场所会显示在这里，可一键加入你的场所清单。
en: After lookup, nearby map places appear here and can be saved into your place list.

zh: 默认地图源，使用 OSM 人道主义样式；地名和道路层级更醒目，适合作为受限网络下的优先尝试源。
en: Default tile source using the OSM humanitarian style, with more visible labels and road hierarchy for restricted networks.

zh: OSM France 社区瓦片；作为备用源保留，通常需要可访问国际网络的环境。
en: OSM France community tiles kept as a fallback; usually requires access to the international network.

zh: 德国 OSM 社区样式；通常需要可访问国际网络的环境，默认源不稳定时可手动切换。
en: German OSM community style; usually requires access to the international network and can be selected when the default source is unstable.

zh: OpenStreetMap 官方标准瓦片；通常需要可访问国际网络的环境，仅在需要核对标准样式时手动切换。
en: Official OpenStreetMap standard tiles; usually requires access to the international network and should be selected only when the standard style is needed.

zh: CARTO 真实街区样式；通常需要可访问国际网络的环境，在部分地区可能不可用。
en: CARTO street basemap that usually requires access to the international network and may be unavailable in some regions.

zh: 更克制的浅色底图，适合降低视觉噪声；通常需要可访问国际网络的环境，作为非默认备用源保留。
en: A quieter light basemap that keeps dense place markers easier to scan; usually requires access to the international network.

zh: 按餐段摇出今天想吃的菜。
en: Pick a dish by meal moment.

zh: 按温度和场景挑一套不出错的搭配。
en: Match temperature and scene to choose an outfit.

zh: 从出门、周边到远行，给自己一个方向。
en: Choose a nearby errand, local trip, or longer escape.

zh: 先选方向，也可以让方向一起随机。
en: Pick a direction, or randomize the direction too.

zh: 录入自己的选项，用转盘、骰子或硬币抽取。
en: Enter your own options and draw by wheel, dice, or coin.

zh: 用概率、期望和因子权重把纠结摊开。
en: Use probability, expected value, and factor weights.

zh: 不限定餐段，想吃什么都可以
按汤、炒、拌、烧、饭面、甜品等收口
en: Filter by soup, stir-fry, cold dish, rice, noodles, and more

zh: 按素菜、荤菜、荤素搭配、主食型收口
en: Filter by vegetarian, meat-based, mixed, or staple

zh: 保留最高频的快速排除项，其余口味放到自定义忌口里添加
en: Keep the common quick avoids and add personal ones below

zh: 不限定气温，覆盖整个衣橱
只作为版型和单品方向参考，可按自己的穿着习惯自由选择
en: A fit and styling reference only; choose by your own wardrobe habits

zh: 按生活阶段和穿着语气筛选，不把年龄当成硬限制
en: Filter by life stage and styling tone, not a hard age rule

zh: 这个搭配整体给人的气质方向
en: How the outfit reads at a glance

zh: 记录这套更偏修身、直筒、宽松还是层次
用来描述这套搭配最重要的核心单品
en: The main clothing types carrying the look

zh: 帮助你记住这套依赖的材质关键词
en: Track the fabric and touch that define the outfit

zh: 这套最值得被记住的点
先看距离，再在整组地点里随机
en: Start from distance, then randomize across all scenes
Meals, snacks, cafes, and late bites

zh: 球馆、健身、游泳和运动场地
en: Gyms, courts, pools, and active venues

zh: 博物馆、美术馆、剧场和展览
古迹、老街、遗址和旧建筑
en: Historic streets, relics, and old architecture

zh: 图书馆、自习室、书店和安静工作点
en: Libraries, study rooms, bookstores, and quiet work spots

zh: 商圈、市集、夜市和买手店
聊天、聚会、桌游和轻连接
en: Meetups, board games, and easy social time

zh: 亲子出游、长辈友好和多人同行
en: Family outings and multi-age friendly places

zh: 酒吧、夜场、夜景和夜间活动
en: Bars, night shows, views, and late activities

zh: 温泉、茶室、疗愈和慢节奏空间
en: Hot springs, tea houses, and restorative places

zh: 街景、机位、观景台和建筑
en: Street scenes, viewpoints, and photo spots

zh: 创意园、非标空间和本地特色区
en: Creative parks and locally distinctive zones

zh: 纪念馆、纪念园和城市记忆空间
en: Memorial halls, remembrance parks, and memory spaces

zh: 把注意力重新放回目标
en: Return attention to the current goal

zh: 先确定人、时间、厨具和风险，再决定菜式
en: Confirm time, tools, people, and risks before choosing a dish

zh: 先问三件事：多久、几人、能洗几口锅
en: Ask time, servings, and cleanup first

zh: 一道菜是否适合今天，不只看想不想吃，还要看可用时间、份量和收拾成本。工作日优先 30 分钟内、一锅或一盘能收口的菜；多人吃饭先确定主食、主菜、蔬菜和汤水的分工，避免最后全是重口味或全是淀粉。
en: A suitable dish depends on time, servings, and cleanup. For busy days, prefer meals that finish within 30 minutes and use one pan or one tray. For a group meal, balance starch, protein, vegetables, and liquid before cooking.

zh: 盘点材料时先分主料、配料、底味
主料决定菜名和饱腹感，配料负责颜色、口感和体积，底味来自葱姜蒜、洋葱、番茄、香菇、骨汤、酱油或香料。缺一味小配料时可以替代；缺主料或底味时，最好改菜，不要硬凑。
en: Separate main ingredients, supporting ingredients, and flavor bases. Small supporting ingredients can often be swapped, but if the main ingredient or core flavor base is missing, choosing another dish is usually safer.

zh: 先排除不能吃，再追求好吃
en: Remove unsafe options before optimizing flavor

zh: 过敏、孕期、婴幼儿、老人吞咽能力、慢病控盐控糖等情况都要先单独判断。上桌前仍要看具体食材、调味、熟度和烹调工具是否混用。
en: Allergies, pregnancy, infants, swallowing ability, and medical diets come first. Always check ingredients, seasoning, doneness, and tool separation before serving.

zh: 买得对，比临场补救更可靠
en: Good ingredients reduce the need for rescue work

zh: 蔬果看新鲜度，也看适合怎么做
en: Judge produce by freshness and cooking use

zh: 叶菜看挺度、切口和黄烂；根茎看表皮、重量和发芽霉斑；瓜果看香气、弹性和伤口。水分足、口感脆的适合快炒凉拌，成熟度高、出汁多的更适合炖、烩、酱汁或做汤。
en: For produce, check firmness, cut surfaces, bruising, sprouts, mold, aroma, and weight. Crisp produce suits quick cooking and cold dishes; riper or juicier produce works better in stews, sauces, and soups.

zh: 肉鱼海鲜先看气味、弹性和冷链
en: Check smell, texture, and cold chain

zh: 鲜肉应有正常肉香和弹性，鱼眼清亮、鱼鳃颜色正常、表面不粘手，贝类和虾蟹要看活力和异味。买回家后尽快冷藏或冷冻，生食级和熟食、凉拌菜必须分开放置。
en: Meat should smell clean and feel elastic. Fish should have clear eyes, normal gills, and non-sticky skin. Shellfish and crustaceans need freshness and no off smell. Refrigerate quickly and keep raw seafood away from ready-to-eat foods.

zh: 干货、米面、调味料看保存状态
en: Inspect dry goods and seasoning storage

zh: 米面豆类怕潮、虫和霉味，坚果芝麻怕哈喇味，香料怕受潮失香，油脂怕光照和高温。采购时少量高频比一次囤太久更稳，开封后用密封、避光、标日期来降低翻车率。
en: Dry grains, beans, nuts, spices, and oils are sensitive to moisture, rancidity, light, and heat. Buy in practical quantities, seal after opening, avoid light, and date containers.

zh: 冲、泡、刷、剥、沥，要按食材结构选择
en: Choose rinsing, soaking, brushing, peeling, and draining by structure

zh: 叶菜逐层冲洗，先去泥沙再沥水
en: Rinse leafy vegetables layer by layer

zh: 包叶菜先剥外层和损伤叶，再把叶片掰开冲洗；小叶菜和香草先挑掉黄烂，再用流动水分散冲洗。短时浸泡可作为补充，但不要把久泡当成唯一方法，沥干水分才利于快炒、凉拌和保存。
en: Remove damaged outer leaves, separate layers, rinse under running water, and drain well. Short soaking may help, but long soaking alone is not a reliable cleaning method and makes cooking watery.

zh: 根茎瓜果先刷表皮，再决定去不去皮
en: Brush firm skins before peeling decisions

zh: 土豆、胡萝卜、莲藕、南瓜、黄瓜等先刷掉泥沙和表面附着物，再按菜式决定去皮、削伤口或保留皮香。表面凹凸多、缝隙多的食材要特别注意沟槽，切开后再冲容易把水和杂质带进切面。
en: Brush root vegetables and firm-skinned produce before cutting. Pay attention to grooves and rough surfaces, then decide whether to peel based on the dish.

zh: 盐、醋、小苏打和清洁剂不是万能答案
en: Salt, vinegar, baking soda, and produce wash are not magic

zh: 家庭清洗的基本盘仍然是流动水、分层冲洗、必要时刷洗和去除外层。盐水、醋水、小苏打或清洁剂可能改变口感、残留气味或需要额外冲净，不能代替认真冲洗，也不应制造“洗过就绝对安全”的错觉。
en: The baseline remains running water, separation, brushing when needed, and removing outer layers. Salt, vinegar, baking soda, or detergents can affect texture or leave residue and do not replace careful rinsing.

zh: 刀工的核心不是炫技，而是受热一致
en: Knife work is about even cooking, not showing off
Shape should serve the cooking method

zh: 丝、片、丁、块、段、滚刀块各有用途：快炒要薄和均匀，炖煮可稍大，煎烤要接触面稳定，凉拌要入口方便。新手先做到厚薄接近，比追求花刀更重要。
en: Julienne, slices, dice, chunks, segments, and roll cuts should match the cooking method. Quick cooking needs thin and even cuts; braising can use larger pieces; pan-frying needs stable contact surfaces.

zh: 肉类先判断纹理和用途
en: Read meat grain and purpose first

zh: 炒肉丝、肉片通常逆纹切更嫩，炖肉可以保留较大块，鸡胸适合薄片或小丁，带骨肉要沿骨和筋膜下刀。冷冻到半硬状态更容易切薄片，但解冻后不可长时间放在室温等待。
en: For stir-fry, cut across the grain for tenderness. Braises can use larger pieces. Chicken breast works well as thin slices or dice. Semi-frozen meat is easier to slice, but do not leave thawed meat at room temperature for long.

zh: 案板顺序决定安全边界
推荐顺序是即食食材、蔬果、熟食、生肉、生海鲜；条件允许时生熟案板分开。若只能用一块案板，处理生肉海鲜后要洗手、清洁刀板和台面，再接触熟食或凉拌菜。
en: Prepare ready-to-eat items, produce, cooked foods, raw meat, and raw seafood in a safe order. Separate boards are best; if using one board, clean hands, knife, board, and counter after raw meat or seafood.

zh: 开火前把不可逆和等待步骤排好
en: Arrange irreversible and waiting steps before heat

zh: 先开始长等待：浸泡、腌制、预热、煮饭
豆类、干货、米饭、烤箱预热、空气炸锅预热、肉类腌制、烧水焯菜都可能占用整顿饭的时间轴。先让等待步骤开始，再切配和调酱，整体节奏会轻很多。
en: Soaking, marinating, preheating, rice cooking, and boiling water can dominate the timeline. Start them first, then cut and mix sauces.

zh: 调味和容器提前到手边
en: Place seasoning and containers within reach

zh: 炒、煎、炸、勾芡和收汁的窗口很短，开火后再找盐、盘子、漏勺和淀粉水，很容易过火。把常用调味、小碗、盘子、锅盖、厨房纸和夹子提前放好，是稳定出品的基本功。
en: Stir-frying, pan-frying, frying, thickening, and reducing move fast. Put seasoning, bowls, plates, lids, paper towels, and tongs within reach before heat.

zh: 按下锅时间分盘，不按食材类别乱堆
同一类蔬菜也可能下锅时间不同：胡萝卜、土豆、豆角先入，青菜叶、葱花、香菜后放；肉片先滑散，易熟海鲜后下。按时间分盘，能避免一锅里同时出现夹生和过熟。
en: Group ingredients by when they enter the pan, not merely by type. Firm vegetables go early, tender leaves and herbs go late, and seafood often needs less time than meat.

zh: 咸、酸、甜、鲜、香、辣要分层建立
en: Build salt, acid, sweetness, umami, aroma, and heat in layers

zh: 盐、生抽、酱、汤底负责底味，醋、柠檬、糖、胡椒、香油、葱蒜、香草负责收口。汤、炖、焖和酱汁类不要一开始压得太咸，因为水分蒸发后味道会继续变重。
en: Salt, soy sauce, pastes, and stock form the base. Acid, sugar, pepper, sesame oil, aromatics, and herbs finish the dish. Avoid heavy early seasoning in soups, braises, and sauces because reduction concentrates flavor.

zh: 咸了补体积，淡了补层次
en: Fix salt with volume and blandness with layers

zh: 过咸优先加无盐主料、水、汤或淀粉类稀释，不要只靠糖遮盖；太淡则先判断是盐不够、香气不足、酸度不足还是油脂不足。少量多次，比一次猛加更容易救。
en: For over-salting, add unsalted volume, water, stock, or starch rather than only sugar. For blandness, identify whether salt, aroma, acid, or fat is missing and adjust gradually.

zh: 香气有先后：爆香、同煮、出锅香不同
葱姜蒜、洋葱、香料适合低到中火出香；香菜、葱花、柠檬皮、香油、部分辣椒油更适合出锅前后加入。香气材料放错时间，轻则无味，重则焦苦。
en: Scallion, ginger, garlic, onion, and spices usually bloom over low to medium heat. Herbs, scallion greens, citrus zest, sesame oil, and some chili oils work better near the end.

zh: 看状态，不迷信固定分钟数
en: Read the food state instead of trusting minutes blindly

zh: 预热不是把锅烧到冒烟
en: Preheating does not mean smoking hot

zh: 煎炒需要锅体热起来，但大量白烟通常说明油温过高或锅中残留物在焦化。判断预热可看油纹、听轻微滋声、试少量食材边缘反应；不粘锅尤其避免长时间空烧。
en: Preheating means the pan is ready, not smoking aggressively. Watch oil movement, listen for a gentle sizzle, and test a small piece. Avoid prolonged dry heating, especially with nonstick pans.

zh: 锅气来自高温、少量、干爽和快速翻动
en: Wok aroma needs heat, small batches, dryness, and speed

zh: 快炒想香，食材要沥干，锅中不要堆太满，调味汁不要一次倒太多。家庭灶火力有限时，宁可分批炒，也不要一锅挤到变成煮菜。
en: Good stir-fry aroma needs dry ingredients, enough heat, small batches, and fast movement. On a home stove, cook in batches rather than crowding the pan into steaming.

zh: 状态信号比时间更可靠
看颜色、出水、回缩、定型、冒泡、油水分离、筷子穿透感和中心温度。不同锅具、分量、火力和食材含水量都会改变分钟数，菜谱时间只能当起点。
en: Watch color, moisture release, shrinkage, structure, bubbling, separation, texture, and center temperature. Pan, batch size, stove power, and water content all change timing.

zh: 焯水、腌制、上浆、勾芡、收汁要知道目的
en: Know why you blanch, marinate, velvet, thicken, and reduce

zh: 焯水用于去味、定色、缩短后续时间
en: Blanching removes odor, sets color, and shortens cooking

zh: 绿叶菜短焯后过凉可保色，排骨和部分内脏冷水下锅更利于带出血沫，豆角、笋、草酸高或有涩味的食材常需要预处理。焯水后要沥干，否则炒菜会变水。
en: Blanch leafy greens briefly for color, start bones or offal in cold water for scum removal, and pre-treat beans, shoots, or astringent ingredients when needed. Drain well before stir-frying.

zh: 腌制和上浆是控水、入味、保护口感
en: Marinating and velveting control water, flavor, and texture

zh: 肉片先少量盐或酱油打底，再按需要加淀粉、蛋清或油形成保护层。腌制不是越久越好，薄片快炒通常十几分钟即可，酸性材料太久会改变肉质。
en: Use a little salt or soy sauce first, then starch, egg white, or oil if needed for a protective layer. Longer is not always better; thin stir-fry slices often need only minutes, and acid can change texture.

zh: 勾芡和收汁都在管理水分
en: Thickening and reducing are water management

zh: 水淀粉要先搅匀，薄芡适合包裹，厚芡适合挂汁；收汁靠蒸发浓缩，火太小会拖时间，火太大容易焦底。先尝味再收汁，因为收浓后咸甜酸都会变明显。
en: Stir starch slurry before adding it. Light thickening coats, heavy thickening clings. Reduction concentrates flavor, so taste before reducing and control heat to avoid scorching.

zh: 炒、煮、炖、蒸、煎、炸、烤、凉拌各有关键点
en: Each method has a few controlling variables

zh: 炒和煎：控制水分与接触面
en: Stir-fry and pan-fry control moisture and contact

zh: 炒菜食材要干爽、下锅顺序清楚、调味汁少量快入；煎东西要给表面定型时间，不要一直翻。粘锅时先判断锅温、油量、水分和是否太早移动。
en: For stir-fry, keep ingredients dry, order clear, and sauce limited. For pan-fry, allow the surface to set before moving. Sticking often comes from temperature, oil, moisture, or moving too early.

zh: 煮、炖、焖、煲：液体决定质地
en: Boil, stew, braise, and simmer depend on liquid

zh: 清汤要稳火少搅，浓汤可靠煸炒、乳化或淀粉质食材增加厚度；炖肉要让胶原和纤维慢慢转化，焖菜则要控制液体刚好够熟而不糊底。
en: Clear soups need gentle heat and little agitation. Thick soups rely on browning, emulsification, or starchy ingredients. Braises need time for collagen and fibers; covered simmering needs just enough liquid.

zh: 蒸、炸、凉拌：一个看蒸汽，一个看油温，一个看沥干
en: Steam, fry, and cold dishes each have one main variable

zh: 蒸菜要水开上汽后计时，盘中不要积太多水；炸物要分清低温浸熟、中温定型、高温复炸；凉拌的关键是食材熟度、沥水和最后调味，不要让菜泡在水里。
en: For steaming, count after strong steam appears and avoid excess plate water. Frying uses different oil temperatures for cooking, setting, and crisping. Cold dishes need proper doneness, draining, and final seasoning.

zh: 主食和烘焙更依赖比例、吸水和温度
en: Staples and baking depend heavily on ratios, hydration, and temperature

zh: 米饭、粥、焖饭先看米水比和吸水
en: Rice, congee, and rice cooker meals start with water ratio

zh: 新米、陈米、糙米、糯米吸水不同；焖饭还会从蔬菜、肉和调味汁得到额外水分。做电饭煲饭时，先保证米熟，再追求配料丰富，油脂和酱汁不要多到影响米粒吸水。
en: Fresh rice, aged rice, brown rice, and glutinous rice absorb water differently. Rice cooker meals also get liquid from vegetables, meat, and sauce. Get the rice cooked first, then increase complexity.

zh: 面条粉类重视出锅时机
en: Noodles and starches depend on timing

zh: 面条离火后仍会继续吸水变软，炒面和拌面通常要比直接吃略早捞；粉丝、米粉、年糕、意面都要按粗细和后续烹调留余地，避免先煮到满熟再二次加热。
en: Noodles keep absorbing water after draining. For stir-fry or tossed noodles, drain slightly early. Vermicelli, rice noodles, rice cakes, and pasta all need room for later cooking.
For baking, measure before relying on feel

zh: 面包、蛋糕、派塔、饼干和许多甜点对克重、温度、搅拌程度和冷却时间敏感。先量好粉、液体、糖、油脂、鸡蛋和膨松剂；烤箱温差大时，用状态和探针温度辅助判断。
en: Bread, cake, tart, cookies, and desserts are sensitive to weight, temperature, mixing, and cooling. Measure dry goods, liquids, sugar, fat, eggs, and leaveners first, then judge by state and temperature.

zh: 做完后的处理决定下一顿是否省心
en: Post-cooking handling determines how easy the next meal is
Cool cooked food quickly and portion it

zh: 大量热汤热饭不要整锅长时间放在室温，分浅盒、留缝散热、降温后冷藏更稳。生熟、荤素、汤汁和干爽菜分开装，能减少串味、出水和复热失败。
en: Do not leave a large hot pot at room temperature for long. Portion into shallow containers, let steam escape, then refrigerate. Separate raw and cooked items, strong flavors, liquids, and dry dishes.

zh: 复热要补水或补脆，不是一律加热到烫
en: Reheat by restoring moisture or crispness

zh: 米饭、面条、炖菜常需要少量水或汤；炸物、烤物更适合烤箱或空气炸锅恢复表面；绿叶菜和海鲜不耐反复加热，最好少量做、尽快吃。
en: Rice, noodles, and stews often need a little water or stock. Fried and baked foods regain texture better in an oven or air fryer. Leafy greens and seafood do not tolerate repeated reheating well.

zh: 剩米饭适合炒饭、粥、饭团；炖肉可变浇头、夹馍、面码；烤蔬菜可进沙拉、浓汤或意面。复用时补新鲜蔬菜和酸香，会比单纯反复加热更好吃。
en: Leftover rice can become fried rice, congee, or rice balls. Braised meat can top noodles or sandwiches. Roasted vegetables can become salad, soup, or pasta. Add freshness and acid when reusing leftovers.

zh: 先找变量，再决定补救方式
en: Find the variable before choosing the rescue

zh: 出水太多：通常是盐早、锅挤、火弱或没沥干
en: Too watery usually means early salt, crowding, weak heat, or poor draining

zh: 蔬菜出水严重时可先盛出多余汤汁再回锅收口，或改成汤、烩、盖饭。下次减少提前撒盐，食材沥干，分批下锅，并把调味汁留到食材断生后再加。
en: If a dish gets watery, remove excess liquid and reduce, or turn it into soup, stew, or rice topping. Next time, salt later, drain better, cook in batches, and add sauce after the food starts cooking through.

zh: 外焦内生：火太急或尺寸不匹配
en: Burnt outside and raw inside means heat or size mismatch

zh: 先降火、加盖、少量补水或转烤箱完成内部熟化。下次把食材切小或切薄，厚块先煎定型再低温焖熟，不要全程大火硬冲。
en: Lower heat, cover, add a little liquid, or finish in the oven. Next time, cut smaller or thinner, sear for structure, then finish gently instead of using high heat throughout.

zh: 肉老、菜软、味闷：多半是时间和顺序错了
en: Tough meat, limp vegetables, and dull flavor often come from timing

zh: 瘦肉过久会柴，海鲜过火会缩，绿叶菜久煮会黄软，香草久煮会失香。先把易老、易熟、易失香的材料后置，复杂菜拆成预处理、主烹调、出锅香三段更稳。
en: Lean meat dries out, seafood shrinks, leafy greens turn dull, and herbs lose aroma when overcooked. Put delicate items later and split complex dishes into prep, main cooking, and finishing aroma.

zh: 先把常穿公式和自己的风格方向收清楚
en: Start from repeatable basics and your real style direction

zh: 基础款是衣橱的主语，不是无聊的替身
en: Basics are the sentence, not a boring placeholder

zh: 真正高频、耐用的穿搭，不靠一次次追新，而靠白衬衫、干净针织、直筒裤、轻外套、稳妥鞋履这些能反复重组的主力单品。先把大部分衣橱交给稳定基础款，再给颜色、图案和个性单品留一点位置，随机推荐才更容易命中你真的会穿的答案。
en: The strongest shared lesson is that repeatable outfits come from stable core pieces first, then a smaller layer of personality and accents.

zh: 风格不是标签堆叠，而是你真实的日常比例
en: Style is the ratio of your real life

zh: 风格先回答“你常去哪里、想呈现什么、身体愿意穿什么”。如果你大多数时间在通勤、开会、久坐和短途出行之间切换，利落通勤、极简基础通常比强戏剧化更好用；如果你常在校园、咖啡店、散步和周末慢生活之间切换，松弛休闲和柔和搭配会更自然。先承认生活半径，风格才不会悬空。
en: Style works best when it reflects your actual routines, social settings, and what your body is willing to wear all day.

zh: 合身、长度和腰线，比“流行元素”更先决定体面度
en: Fit, length, and waist definition matter before trend detail

zh: 先看肩线、裤长、后背，再看正面
en: Check shoulders, hem, and back view first

zh: 合身永远先于复杂设计。肩线掉太多、裤脚堆太厚、后背绷紧或松垮，都会让再好的衣服显得没精神。挑衣服时先看能不能走路、坐下、抬手，再看镜子里的正面效果；正面漂亮但活动受限的衣服，实际穿着频率往往会很低。
en: Fit starts with movement, shoulder line, hem length, and how the garment behaves from the back, not only the front mirror angle.

zh: 上下量感要分工，不要同时抢戏
en: Let top and bottom split the visual work

zh: 常见的稳妥公式是：宽松上装配利落下装，修身上装配有量感下装；想显精神，就让腰线、裤线或鞋面承担收口任务。高腰、短外套、纵向线条、露脚踝或清晰鞋口，通常比一味堆层数更有效。
en: Reliable proportion comes from letting either the top or the bottom carry volume while the other side stays clearer and cleaner.

zh: 先判断时间、地点、角色和今天的日程
en: Judge time, place, role, and today’s agenda first

zh: 职场穿衣先看行业、职位、日程三件事
en: For work, start with industry, role, and agenda

zh: 职场穿衣先看环境和角色。创意行业、技术岗位、行政支持、管理层、对外见客户的穿法不必完全一样。问自己三个问题：今天会不会久坐？会不会频繁见人？会不会在室内外来回切换？答案会决定你该不该加外套、穿不穿明显配饰、鞋子要不要更正式。
en: Workwear choices should react to industry, seniority, and what the day actually demands, especially meetings, sitting time, and indoor-outdoor switching.

zh: 约会、周末、运动和雨天各有第一优先级
en: Every scene has its first priority

zh: 约会先守“柔和 + 一个记忆点”；周末先守“舒服 + 不邋遢”；运动先守“排汗 + 活动范围”；雨天先守“防滑 + 快干 + 不拖地”。这类场景里，体感和行动便利要先于拍照效果。真正好看的搭配，是你不需要一直分神去照顾它。
en: Dates, weekends, exercise, and rain all have different first priorities. Comfort and mobility should be solved before aesthetics start competing.

zh: 颜色控制节奏，材质决定高级感和季节感
en: Color sets rhythm while fabric sets polish and seasonality

zh: 先用中性色稳住，再决定要不要加亮点
en: Anchor with neutrals before adding color

zh: 配色可以先走一条稳妥路线：用黑、白、灰、海军蓝、卡其、深棕这类中性色打底，再加一个小面积提气色。安全做法是一主色、一中性色、一亮点；想再大胆一些，也先从低饱和配色、同色系深浅变化和“黑色带彩色”开始练习。
en: A practical route into color is to stabilize the outfit with neutrals first, then add a small accent instead of starting with several loud tones.

zh: 材质会直接决定“看起来贵不贵、轻不轻松”
en: Fabric decides whether the look feels polished or cheap

zh: 挺括面料更容易撑起职业感，柔软材质更容易制造亲和感，垂感面料更适合热天和约会，棉麻更适合微热到炎热，羊毛与针织则更适合冷天层次。配色一样时，材质差异往往比颜色本身更能拉开质感差距。
en: Structure, drape, and texture often change the perceived quality of an outfit more than color alone.

zh: 温度、体感、风雨和温差要一起看
en: Read temperature, feels-like, rain, wind, and swing together

zh: 三层原则比“一件扛到底”更稳
en: The three-layer rule beats one heavy item

zh: 低温和换季场景里，最实用的公式还是内层舒适排汗、中层负责保暖、外层负责挡风防雨。体感温度和昼夜温差比气温数字更接近日常真实感受，所以页面默认会按天气体感推荐档位，但你仍可以手动覆盖。要点不是穿得最多，而是让你随时能加、能减、能走动。
en: Layering is mainly about adjustability: stay comfortable now, but keep room to react to wind, rain, and daily temperature swing.

zh: 高温、低温、降雨各有收尾检查表
en: Heat, cold, and rain each need a final checklist

zh: 高温重点看防晒、补水、面料散热和空调房温差；低温重点看颈部、手部、脚踝和鞋底抓地；雨天重点看裤脚长度、鞋面、防滑和备用干物。出门前只花半分钟做这一步，往往比临时补救更省心。
en: For heat, check ventilation and sun protection. For cold, cover the small exposed zones. For rain, control hem length, traction, and backup dry items.

zh: 鞋和配件是收口，不是抢主题
en: Shoes and accessories finish the look instead of stealing it

zh: 鞋子决定完成度，包和腰带负责统一
en: Shoes finish the outfit, bag and belt unify it

zh: 鞋子常常决定一套搭配是否完整。通勤和正式场景先保证鞋面整洁、线条清楚、适合久走；包、腰带、表和首饰则尽量配合同一语气，不需要每样都出彩，只要整体不散。想省力时，优先把鞋和包选稳。
en: Shoes often reveal the most about whether an outfit feels intentional, while bag and belt keep the whole look speaking in one tone.

zh: 配饰要么补气色，要么补比例，不要只是“多一个”
en: Accessories should fix color or proportion

zh: 围巾、耳饰、项链、帽子、方巾、腕表最适合承担两种任务：一是给脸部和上半身提气，二是把视线拉向你想强调的位置。若一套搭配已经有明显图案、鲜艳颜色或复杂面料，配饰就减法处理；若整体过于平，可以用一件小配件做记忆点。
en: Accessories work best when they either lift color near the face or guide the eye toward the area you want to emphasize.

zh: 衣橱越清楚，随机推荐越接近你真会穿的答案
en: A clearer wardrobe makes recommendations more realistic

zh: 按常穿频率和场景保留，不按愧疚感保留
en: Keep by frequency and scene, not by guilt

zh: 衣橱管理重在质胜于量。整理衣橱时，先留下最合身、最常穿、最好搭、最能代表你当前生活的核心款；低频、难打理、总需要“等一个合适场合”的衣服，要么转入备用，要么尽快清理。你在管理页里标注的风格、版型和样式类型，本质上就是帮自己建立这套衣橱索引。
en: Edit the closet around what fits, gets worn, and actually supports your current life. The guided traits in management are there to make that inventory visible.

zh: 在家练穿搭，比出门前临时拼更有效
en: Practice at home before needing the outfit

zh: 不要把所有试错都放在出门前五分钟。可以把高频场景的几套组合提前试好、拍照、记录优缺点，再把最常穿的搭配录入管理页。久而久之，页面里的随机结果会越来越接近你的个人衣橱，而不是一组抽象建议。
en: Testing combinations ahead of time builds a personal outfit library, which makes both daily choice and wardrobe management dramatically more useful.

zh: 先把时间和半径收口，再谈目的地
en: Bound the time and radius before choosing the place

zh: 出门、周边、远行不是强度，而是边界
en: Step out, nearby, and travel are boundaries

zh: “出门”适合 30 分钟到 1 小时的低门槛切换，“周边”适合同城半日，“远行”则意味着你愿意为这次外出留出完整行程。先确定你愿意给这件事多少时间，地点才不会无限膨胀。
en: Step out is for a low-friction 30-to-60-minute change, nearby fits a local half day, and travel means you are willing to turn the outing into a full plan.

zh: 当纠结来自“想出门但不知道去哪儿”，先用距离把范围缩到可执行，再用饮食、娱乐、运动、文化等场景把结果拉向你当前真正需要的体验。
en: When the problem is “I want to go out but do not know where,” reduce the radius first, then use scenes like food, sports, or culture to shape the mood you actually need.

zh: 先认清你是想吃、想玩、想动，还是想安静
en: Name the kind of outing you actually want

zh: 问题不是去哪儿，而是现在缺什么
en: The issue is what you lack right now

zh: 饮食类解决的是”补一顿”与”找个能坐下来的地方”，娱乐类解决新鲜感，运动类解决身体唤醒，学习类解决专注环境，放松类则解决恢复感。先识别缺口，比盲抽地名更准。
en: Food solves hunger or the need for a place to sit, entertainment gives novelty, sports wake up the body, study gives focus, and relax scenes restore energy.

zh: 同行对象会改写最优解
en: Who goes with you changes the best answer

zh: 一个人适合低沟通成本的点位，两三个人适合能边走边聊或能临时换计划的地点，带长辈和小孩则优先看无障碍、洗手间、休息位和就餐衔接。
en: Solo trips work best with low-communication destinations, small groups need flexible places, and multi-age outings should prioritize accessibility, seating, and restroom support.

zh: 先看营业、通勤、预约和替代点
en: Check opening hours, transit, booking, and backups

zh: 先搜关键词，不要先认一家店
en: Search by keyword before committing to one place

zh: 这一版详情页会给出地图搜索词。先用关键词搜一组候选，再按评分、步行时间、营业时间和是否容易收尾来选，比一开始就锁死某一家更稳。
en: This version gives you a map query. Search the keyword first, then choose by rating, transit time, opening hours, and how easy the outing is to close out.

zh: 排队、满场、闭馆、下雨和临时取消都很常见。真正降低决策压力的方法，是在同一片区域预留一个替代点，而不是让整次外出因为一个点失败而中断。
en: Queues, closures, rain, or sold-out tickets happen often. A backup in the same area keeps the outing alive instead of collapsing the whole plan.

zh: 天气和返程可行性永远比“理想感”更重要
en: Practicality matters more than the idealized destination

zh: 户外和夜间点先看天气
en: Outdoor and night outings start with weather

zh: 公园、滨水、街景、夜景和远行类地点对天气很敏感。遇到高温、降雨、大风或夜间温差，优先准备替代的室内点，而不是硬扛。
en: Parks, waterfronts, street scenes, night views, and longer trips are weather-sensitive. In heat, rain, or wind, prepare an indoor fallback instead of forcing it.

zh: 预算要把路费一起算进去
真正的出门成本不只是门票和餐费，还包括打车、停车、地铁换乘、预约损耗和返程时间。远行类地点尤其要把“回得来”一起算清楚。
en: The real cost includes transit, parking, transfers, booking friction, and the return trip, not only the ticket or meal itself.

zh: 少带，但别漏掉关键物件
en: Carry little, but do not forget the essentials

zh: 短出门看电量，远行看补给
en: Short trips need battery, long trips need backup

zh: 出门和周边优先确保手机、电量、钥匙、纸巾和水；远行则再加证件、药品、充电线、雨具和返程所需的轻补给。
en: For step-out and nearby trips, phone, battery, keys, tissue, and water usually cover it. For travel, add ID, meds, a cable, weather gear, and small return-trip supplies.

zh: 到点就收，不把随机外出拖成负担
en: End on time instead of dragging it out

zh: 随机工具的意义是把你推出去，不是把一天压得更满。达到时间盒、完成主要体验、身体开始疲惫，或者返程窗口快关闭时，就可以安心收口。
en: The tool is meant to get you moving, not overload the day. Once the time box is reached or the main experience is done, it is okay to close the outing cleanly.

zh: 如果某件事听起来太大，就把它改成 5 分钟版本。每日抉择的价值是破冰，不是替你安排完整人生。
en: If an activity feels too large, shrink it to a five-minute version. Daily choice breaks the ice; it does not schedule your whole life.

zh: 运动、学习、整理都先做一次。完成后再选择继续、换方向或停止，避免一开始就被计划压住。
en: Move, study, or tidy for one round first. After that, choose continue, switch, or stop.

zh: 当你连大方向都不想选时，用“随机方向”。先让系统给一个方向，再从该方向里摇出具体动作。
en: When even the direction feels hard, use Random. Let the tool pick the direction and then a concrete action.

zh: 先复盘涣散内容，再决定回到目标还是换一个低阻力动作
en: Review the drift, then return to the goal or pick a smaller action

zh: 不评价地回看刚才在想什么
停 20 秒，写下刚才跑掉的内容：是在幻想结果、担心别人评价、想逃开任务，还是身体真的累了。只记录，不批评。
en: Pause for 20 seconds and name the drift: fantasy, fear of judgment, task avoidance, or real fatigue. Record it without scolding yourself.

zh: 用一句话写出“我现在原本要完成什么”。如果目标太大，改成 5 分钟版本；如果目标已经失效，就允许重新随机一个更贴近当下的行动。
en: Write one sentence for what you meant to do. If it is too large, shrink it to five minutes; if it no longer fits, reroll a better action.

zh: 先做一小段 5 到 12 分钟。到点后再决定继续、休息或换方向，避免把随机结果变成新的压力。
en: Do one 5 to 12 minute round first. When it ends, choose continue, rest, or switch.

zh: 把出门当作状态切换，而不是逃避任务
en: Use walking as a state shift, not pure avoidance

zh: 身体和环境允许时优先短出门
en: Choose a short outing when conditions allow

zh: 天气安全、身体没有明显不适、任务卡住超过 15 分钟、室内刺激变得黏滞时，优先选择 8 到 20 分钟散步。
en: If weather and body are safe, the task has been stuck for 15 minutes, and the room feels stale, pick an 8 to 20 minute walk.

zh: 路线越固定越不耗决策力。出门前只检查钥匙、手机、电量和天气；不要把散步扩展成复杂外出。
en: A fixed route costs less decision energy. Check keys, phone, battery, and weather; do not let the walk grow into a complex outing.

zh: 回到室内后立刻接一个 2 分钟动作：打开文档、洗杯子、整理桌面一角或写下一句目标，防止散步后继续漂走。
en: After returning, do one two-minute action: open the document, wash a cup, clear one desk corner, or write the goal.

zh: 降低动作体积，让开始先发生
en: Shrink the action so starting happens first

zh: 把任务缩到一个可见终点
不要写“学习英语”，写“复习 10 个词”；不要写“收拾房间”，写“只清空桌面左上角”。
en: Do not write “study English”; write “review 10 words.” Do not write “clean the room”; write “clear the top-left desk corner.”

zh: 能量低时，5 分钟不是偷懒，而是开始的小仪式。完成后如果状态变好，再自愿追加一次。
en: At low energy, five minutes is a start protocol, not laziness. Add another round only if it helps.

zh: 知道什么时候停，也知道什么时候换行动
en: Know when to stop and when to switch

zh: 随机工具只负责帮你开始和收口。到达时间盒、身体不舒服、外部条件不合适或行动明显偏题时，可以停止。
en: The randomizer helps you start and close. Stop when the time box ends, body feels wrong, conditions are poor, or the action drifts off target.

zh: 如果你换掉当前结果，记录一句原因：太晚、太吵、身体累、需要别人配合、目标不匹配。这样下次可以优化行动集。
en: When switching, keep one reason: too late, too noisy, tired body, needs another person, or mismatched goal. Use it to improve the set later.

zh: 所有选项权重相同，适合低风险、差别不大的选择。它不是科学最优，只是快速结束犹豫。
en: Every option has equal weight. Good for low-risk choices where options are similar.

zh: 用“概率 × 收益 - 风险 - 成本”粗略排序。适合把模糊直觉摊开，但输入值仍然来自你的判断。
en: Ranks by probability times value minus risk and cost. Useful for exposing assumptions, not for guaranteed truth.

zh: 当一个结果依赖多个条件同时成立时，把概率相乘会更保守，也能提醒你哪一环最需要补信息。
en: When an outcome depends on several events, multiplying probabilities gives a more conservative view and shows which link needs more information.

zh: 当预期特别乐观或悲观时，先和平均情况做比较，给极端判断留一点回拉空间。
en: When a forecast feels extremely optimistic or pessimistic, compare it with the average case and pull the estimate back a little.

zh: 当前浏览全部衣柜。内置数据适合参考，真正好用的结果会来自你逐步整理出的个人衣柜。
en: Browsing all wardrobes. Built-ins are references; the best results come from your own saved wardrobe.

zh: 当前只从这个衣柜里抽取。放进来的都应该是你真实拥有、愿意反复穿的组合。
en: Random picks now come from this wardrobe only, ideally from outfits you actually own and repeat.

zh: 当前场景暂无精确项，先从同温度搭配里随机。
en: No exact scene match yet; randomizing from the same temperature.

zh: 当前场景条目较少，已混入同温度稳妥备选，让随机更有变化。
en: This scene has only one exact match, so same-temperature backups are mixed in for more variety.

zh: 已应用 {activeTraitFilterCount} 项高级筛选。
这个衣柜在当前筛选下没有可选搭配。可以放宽筛选，或把你真实会穿的组合加入这个衣柜。
en: This wardrobe has no matching outfits. Relax filters or add a real outfit you would actually wear.

zh: 当前没有命中的搭配。可以先参考内置衣柜，也可以在管理里新建自己的真实衣柜搭配。
en: No matching outfits yet. Use built-ins as references, or add your own wardrobe outfit in Manage.

zh: 出门前检查比例、颜色、层级和场景，不遮挡主页面。
en: Check proportion, color, layers, and scene without covering the page.

zh: 已通过 {checked} / {total} 项；少于 4 项时先调整，不急着出门。
en: {checked} / {total} passed. If fewer than 4 pass, adjust before leaving.

zh: 太正式：先换鞋或包，让整体松一点。
en: Too formal: change shoes or bag first.

zh: 太松散：加腰线、换利落下装或收窄鞋口。
en: Too loose: define waist, clean up bottoms, or narrow the shoe line.

zh: 太暗沉：把亮点放在脸部附近，不要全身加色。
en: Too dull: lift color near the face instead of adding color everywhere.

zh: 天气不稳：多带薄外层，比临时硬扛更舒服。
en: Unstable weather: carry a thin layer instead of forcing the outfit.

zh: 确认体感、风、雨、空调房和室内外温差，不只看气温数字。
en: Check feels-like temperature, wind, rain, AC, and indoor-outdoor swing.

zh: 坐下、走路、抬手都不需要分心照顾衣服。
en: Sitting, walking, and raising arms should not need constant fixing.

zh: 不比今天角色更用力，也不要让重要场合显得敷衍。
en: Do not overdress for the role, but do not underplay important scenes.

zh: 上下量感有分工，腰线、裤长或鞋口至少有一个清楚收口。
en: Top and bottom share volume; waist, hem, or shoe line has a clear finish.

zh: 鞋底稳妥、包容量够用，金属色与皮革色调也互不冲突。
en: Soles are safe, bag size works, and metals or leather tones do not clash.

zh: 易皱、沾毛、防晒、保暖、备用干物和洗护限制都已考虑。
en: Wrinkles, lint, sun, warmth, dry backup, and care limits are accounted for.
White, grey, and denim blue are safest.

zh: 加米色或浅卡其会更柔和。
en: Beige or light khaki softens the look.

zh: 想提气色，把亮点放在上半身或配饰。
en: Place accents near the upper body or accessories.

zh: 全黑时注意材质层次，否则容易闷。
en: All black needs texture or it can feel flat.

zh: 黑色贴脸可能显沉，可靠领口或配饰提亮。
en: Black near the face can feel heavy; lift it with neckline or accessories.

zh: 配海军蓝、灰、卡其会干净。
en: Navy, grey, and khaki keep it clean.

zh: 白上衣适合承接彩色小配饰。
en: White tops support small colorful accents.

zh: 白裤装更适合挺括或有厚度的面料。
en: White bottoms work better in structured fabrics.

zh: 薄白下装容易透，先看光线和内搭。
en: Thin white bottoms can be sheer; check light and underlayers.

zh: 大面积白色雨天、通勤挤车要谨慎。
en: Large white areas need care on rainy or crowded commutes.

zh: 配白、浅灰、牛仔蓝有通勤感。
en: White, light grey, and denim feel work-ready.

zh: 配棕色皮鞋或腰带会更稳重。
en: Brown leather shoes or belt add steadiness.

zh: 想休闲时加条纹、帆布或小白鞋。
en: Stripes, canvas, or white sneakers make it casual.

zh: 避免和过暗黑色混在一起看不出层次。
en: Avoid mixing with very dark black without contrast.

zh: 正式场景里少用过亮荧光色破坏克制感。
en: Keep neon accents away from formal navy looks.

zh: 配白、海军蓝、黑色最省心。
en: White, navy, and black are easy anchors.

zh: 同色系可用深浅差做层次。
en: Use light-dark shifts within the same family.

zh: 加棕色、金色配件会更温和。
en: Brown or gold accessories soften it.

zh: 全身米色时，避免选与肤色过于接近的色调。
en: All beige can wash you out when it sits too close to your skin tone.

zh: 软塌面料过多会显得没精神。
en: Too many limp fabrics can look tired.

zh: 一次只保留一个主亮点。
en: Keep one main accent at a time.

zh: 把彩色放在围巾、包、鞋或上衣小面积。
en: Use color on scarf, bag, shoes, or a small top area.

zh: 用黑白灰、海军蓝或牛仔稳定它。
en: Anchor it with black, white, grey, navy, or denim.

zh: 不要多个高饱和彩色平均分布。
en: Avoid several loud colors in equal weight.

zh: 靠近脸的颜色先看气色，不只看流行。
en: Near-face color should flatter you, not only follow trends.

zh: 透气单层 + 防晒部件 + 易走鞋。
en: Breathable single layer + sun protection + walkable shoes.

zh: 材质优先棉麻、天丝、薄针织或速干。
en: Prefer cotton-linen, Tencel, thin knit, or quick-dry fabrics.

zh: 浅色不等于凉快，透气和不贴身更重要。
en: Light color is not enough; airflow and non-clingy fit matter.

zh: 空调房准备薄外层，不要靠厚面料硬扛。
en: Carry a thin layer for AC instead of wearing heavy fabric.

zh: 基础内层 + 轻外套 / 衬衫外穿 + 利落鞋。
en: Base layer + light jacket or overshirt + clean shoes.

zh: 把亮点放在颜色、鞋包或一件配饰。
en: Put the accent on color, shoes, bag, or one accessory.

zh: 早晚温差大时外层要能塞包或拿在手里。
en: If mornings and evenings swing, the outer layer must pack or carry easily.

zh: 裤长和鞋口决定整套是否清爽。
en: Hem and shoe line decide whether it feels clean.

zh: 排汗内层 + 保暖中层 + 挡风外层。
en: Moisture-managing base + warm mid-layer + wind-blocking outer.

zh: 颈部、手部、脚踝和鞋底要一起看。
en: Check neck, hands, ankles, and sole grip together.

zh: 不要只堆厚外套，中层空气层更重要。
en: Do not rely only on a thick coat; the mid-layer air gap matters.

zh: 室内久坐时外层要容易脱。
en: Outerwear should come off easily for long indoor sitting.

zh: 快干内层 + 防泼外层 + 防滑鞋。
en: Quick-dry layer + water-repellent shell + grippy shoes.

zh: 裤脚不拖地，包里留备用干物。
en: Keep hems off the ground and pack dry backup items.

zh: 长裙、阔裤和浅色麂皮雨天都要谨慎。
en: Long skirts, wide pants, and light suede need caution in rain.

zh: 伞、帽子、包口和鞋面一起防水。
en: Umbrella, hat, bag opening, and shoe upper all need weather control.

zh: 颜色和轮廓先稳，亮点小面积。
en: Keep color and shape stable; use small accents.

zh: 包容量不够导致手上东西太多。
en: Bags too small for the day.
Clean shoulder line, trouser line, and shoes.

zh: 颜色少一点，材质挺一点。
en: Use fewer colors and more structure.

zh: 配饰太张扬或喧宾夺主。
en: Accessories that are noisy or distracting.
Comfort, approachability, and one memorable point.

zh: 脸部附近可以更柔和或更提气色。
en: Near-face color can be softer or more flattering.

zh: 香水、配饰或鞋过度用力。
排汗、活动范围、鞋底支撑。
en: Sweat control, movement range, and sole support.
Outer layer should go on and off quickly.
Heavy cotton staying wet against skin.
Grip, quick-dry, and no dragging hems.
Handle bag opening, shoe upper, and hems first.

zh: 需要双手一直整理的外套。
正在读取当前天气，读取完成后会默认推荐合适的气温档位。
en: Loading weather. A suitable temperature band will be selected by default when ready.

zh: 正在等待全局天气数据，当前先查看全部气温，你也可以手动改档位。
en: Waiting for global weather data. The module shows all temperatures for now, and you can adjust it manually.

zh: 当前先查看全部气温；若天气提醒已读取天气，这里会自动用于穿搭建议。
en: Showing all temperatures for now. If startup weather has loaded, it will be used here automatically.

zh: 根据当前体感 {temperature}°C，默认推荐“{category}”档位。
en: Based on a feels-like temperature of {temperature}°C, the default suggestion is {category}.

zh: 今天温差 {range}°C，优先选可穿脱的外层。
en: The temperature swing is {range}°C today, so keep the outer layer easy to remove.

zh: 当前有降水，鞋底防滑、面料快干会更稳妥。
en: There is precipitation, so grippy soles and quick-dry fabrics are safer.

zh: 当前有降雪，保暖和抓地力要优先于轻薄造型。
en: Snow is expected, so warmth and traction matter more than light styling.

zh: 风速约 {speed} km/h，尽量带一层防风外搭。
en: Wind is around {speed} km/h, so add a wind-blocking layer.

zh: 高温时段尽量减少暴晒，补水和防晒都别省。
en: During high heat, limit sun exposure and keep hydration plus sun protection in place.

zh: 低温里别只顾上半身，颈部、手部和脚踝也要一起保暖。
en: In low temperatures, keep the neck, hands, and ankles warm too.

zh: 优先从你真实拥有、愿意反复穿的搭配里随机。
en: Prioritize outfits you actually own and repeat.

zh: 还没有自己的衣柜。先在管理里新建一套真实搭配，随机会更有用。
en: No personal wardrobe yet. Add a real outfit in Manage to make random picks useful.

zh: 按性别参考、年龄阶段、风格、版型和面料缩小范围
en: Narrow by gender reference, age stage, style, silhouette, and fabric

zh: 内置参考已就绪。你可以先借它找方向，再把真正适合自己的组合另存到我的衣柜。
en: Built-in references are ready. Use them for direction, then save your real outfits into your wardrobe.

zh: 首次使用可下载内置参考衣柜；之后建议把自己的真实搭配逐步录入。
en: Download the built-in reference once, then gradually add your real outfits.

zh: 最近一次同步有异常，当前会继续使用本地可用穿搭库。
en: The latest sync reported an error. The page will keep using the local library that is already available.

zh: 吃什么、穿什么、去哪儿、干什么、随机助手和决策助手都在同一套轻量交互里：选条件、开始随机、停止选中，再按需查看详情或管理自己的条目。
en: Eat, wear, go, do, random assistant, and decision tools share one light flow: choose conditions, randomize, stop, then inspect or manage your own entries.

zh: 将日常的犹豫转化为轻量、可编辑、可复核的选择，从吃什么、穿什么到轻量的决策计算。
en: Turn everyday indecision into light, editable, reviewable choices, from what to eat and wear to lightweight decision calculations.

zh: 用摇晃强度、方向和声部组合演奏舒缓或鼓劲的声音。
en: Use shake intensity, direction, and layered sounds to play calm or driving motion audio.

zh: 自由模式按强度组合声部；快板模式用方向翻转触发清脆木板拍击。
en: Free mode layers by intensity; Allegro mode uses direction flips for crisp wooden clapper hits.

zh: 风感 {level}% · 底噪 {floor}% · 置信度 {confidence}%。只读取短时音量轮廓，不保存录音。
en: Wind {level}% · floor {floor}% · confidence {confidence}%. Only short amplitude contours are read; no recording is saved.

zh: 开启后，开始聆听时会用麦克风捕捉微风、阵风和环境风噪，作为风铃的辅助补充。
en: When enabled, listening uses the microphone to capture breezes, gusts, and ambient wind noise as a chime supplement.

zh: 使用麦克风估算风感，只轻量补充风铃发音，不改变当前演奏模式。
en: Use the microphone to estimate wind feel and lightly supplement chime playback without changing the current play mode.

zh: 从舒缓、均衡或鼓劲组合开始，再单独调整声部。
en: Start from calm, balanced, or driving mixes, then tune each layer.

zh: 开启或降低每个声部，轻摇时柔和，强摇时更有拍点。
en: Enable or lower each layer; soft shakes stay gentle, strong shakes gain punch.

zh: 提高灵敏度会让轻微摇晃更容易发声。
en: Higher sensitivity makes smaller shakes speak sooner.

zh: 请在实体手机上使用摇晃演奏
en: Use shake play on a physical phone

zh: 当前设备没有可用的运动传感器，仍可使用预览按钮试听组合。
en: This device has no motion sensor available, but preview buttons still play the mix.

zh: 倾斜手机控制立体平台，让被风吹动的小球尽量留在台面上。
en: Tilt the phone to control a 3D platform and keep the wind-pushed ball on it.

zh: 逐步提高频率、音量和节奏复杂度；听到声音后点击。
en: Hear varied frequencies and rhythmic loudness; tap when audible.

zh: 围绕选定频率估计可听音量下限。
en: Check audible volume levels around a selected base frequency.

zh: 判断声源方向，并用空间按钮或指针标记感知位置。
en: Localize the sound direction and mark the perceived position with the slider.

zh: 请用低沉、稳定的声音持续发声，检查低频音高、幅度和稳定性。
en: Produce a low, steady hum and check low-frequency pitch, level, and stability.

zh: 请用较高的声音持续发声，观察高频音高与曲线平滑程度。
en: Produce a higher tone and observe the high-frequency pitch and curve smoothness.

zh: 保持均匀发声 5 秒以上，系统会给出持续性和波动指标。
en: Hold a steady sound for 5+ seconds and measure sustain and variation.

zh: 保持安静，测量环境噪声、峰值和相对分贝。
en: Stay quiet to measure ambient noise, peak, and relative dBFS.

zh: 小球已离开平台。最大偏移越低、保持时间越长，说明控制越稳定。
en: The ball left the platform. Lower max offset and longer hold time mean steadier control.

zh: 测试中：缓慢倾斜，别让球越过边缘
en: Running: tilt slowly and keep the ball inside the edge

zh: 准备：点击开始，把平台先回正
en: Ready: tap start and level the platform first

zh: 倾斜手机改变平台坡度，抵消开局随机风动量，球掉落即结束。
en: Tilt the phone to slope the platform, counter the random starting wind impulse, and keep the ball from falling.

zh: 当前设备无法读取运动传感器；可用滑杆调试平台倾斜。
en: This device cannot read motion sensors; use the sliders to test platform tilt.

zh:
{summary}
Goal: {goalText}. Total luck score is {p4} expectation by {p3}.
en:
{summary}
Goal: {goalText}. Total luck score is {p4} expectation by {p3}.

zh: 切换模式会结束当前观察并重置新模式。确认后需要手动点击开始。
en: Switching modes will stop the current observation and reset the new mode. Press Start manually after confirming.
Correct. Ready for the next round.
Test over. The correct count was {answer}.

zh: 正确数量是 {answer}，保持当前等级再试一次。
en: The correct count was {answer}. Try this level again.

zh: 修改小球数量设置会重置当前测试。确认后需要手动点击开始。
en: Changing ball-count settings will reset the current test. Press Start manually after confirming.

zh: 修改字符识别设置会重置当前测试。确认后需要手动点击开始。
en: Changing symbol settings will reset the current test. Press Start manually after confirming.

zh: 已开启辅助：{p0}。这次成绩适合自己复盘，不建议和无辅助成绩直接比较。
en: Assists enabled: {p0}. Treat this as practice feedback, not a clean-score comparison.

zh: 清醒的注意力来自稳定的呼吸、明确的目标和可持续的节奏。
en: Focused attention comes from steady breathing, a clear goal, and a sustainable rhythm.

zh: 把复杂任务切成几段，手指会更快找到下一个落点。
en: Split complex work into smaller steps, and your hands find the next move faster.

zh: 今晚把单词放慢一点，记忆会在安静的间隔里留下痕迹。
en: Slow the words down tonight, and memory will leave traces in the quiet gaps.

zh: 专业的输入训练不只看速度，也看错误密度、回退次数和稳定性。
en: Professional typing practice measures speed, error density, corrections, and stability.

zh: 窗外的灯光慢慢亮起，纸上的句子像小船一样靠岸。
en: Lights rose outside the window, and the sentence on paper drifted gently ashore.

zh: 遇到生词时先读完整句，再把意思、声音和场景一起存进记忆。
en: Read the whole sentence first, then store meaning, sound, and scene together.

zh: 清晨的车站正在苏醒，背包里的路线图被折成整齐的小方块。
en: The morning station woke up while the map folded into neat squares.

zh: 平静的心可以快速运转，却不觉得匆忙。
en: A calm mind can move quickly without feeling rushed.

zh: 当注意力有了舒缓的节奏，记忆也会随之变好。
en: Memory improves when attention has a gentle rhythm.

zh: 干净的代码，让快速的想法不至于变成昂贵的噪音。
en: Clean code keeps fast ideas from becoming expensive noise.

zh: 安静的车站时钟，数过每一只行李箱和每一次告别。
en: The quiet station clock counted every suitcase and every goodbye.

zh: 一个有用的词，每出现在新的语境里就会更牢固一分。
en: A useful word becomes stronger each time it appears in a new context.

zh: 列车驶过江面时，城市正好推开了窗。
en: The train crossed the river just as the city opened its windows.

zh: 专注 25 分钟，休息 5 分钟，再回顾一个小成果。
en: Focus 25 minutes, rest 5 minutes, then review one small win.

zh: Flutter 组件树：先状态，再布局，最后打磨。
en: Flutter widget tree: state first, layout second, polish last.

zh: 睡眠模式：灯光调暗，声音放轻，毫无压力。
en: Sleep mode: dim light, soft voice, zero pressure.

zh: The note said: 明天见, and the platform became quiet again.
en: The note said: see you tomorrow, and the platform became quiet again.

zh: Review "steady", 复习「稳定」, then use both in one sentence.
en: Review "steady", then use both languages in one sentence.

zh: Gate B12 opens at 08:40, 行李放左侧, coffee stays sealed.
en: Gate B12 opens at 08:40, keep luggage left, coffee sealed.

zh: 安静的专注，来自短暂的休息和小小的确认。
en: Quiet focus grows from short breaks and small checks.

zh: 夜里的单词慢慢读，清晨再回想一遍。
en: Read the night words slowly and recall them again in the morning.

zh: 小小的函数，会成为后来阅读者的亲切指引。
en: Small functions become kind guides for the next reader.

zh: 雨中的车站里，只有旧车票还记得旅程的延续。
en: At the rainy station, only the old ticket remembered the journey.

zh: 新词在例句之中，慢慢长成自己的形状。
en: New words slowly take shape inside example sentences.

zh: 清晨的港口，一艘白船静静解开缆绳出发了。
en: In the harbor morning, a white ship quietly untied and left.

zh: 头脑清醒时，每项任务有了可见的边界，进展会更顺。
en: A clear mind moves better when each task has a visible edge.

zh: 睡前写下一句舒缓的话，就能把一整天理顺。
en: Before sleep, one slow sentence can put the whole day in order.

zh: 好的日志能解释失败，而不是把屏幕塞满噪音。
en: A good log explains the failure without filling the screen with noise.

zh: 广场空了，音乐却还在街角回荡。
en: The square was empty, but the music kept turning the corner.

zh: 一个新词要有声音、画面和用法，才能真正记住。
en: A new word needs sound, image, and use before it stays.

zh: 列车早早出发，在河面上留下一道金色的线。
en: The train left early and drew a golden line over the river.

zh: 训练已结束，已生成本次报告。
en: Run ended. The report is ready.
Lives are gone. The run has ended.

zh: 判断正确，下一轮会提高记忆负荷。
en: Correct. The next round raises memory load.

zh: 判断错误，已扣除 1 次生命。
数字串复现正确，长度会继续增加。
en: Digit string matched. Length will keep growing.

zh: 数字串不一致，已扣除 1 次生命。
en: Digit string missed. One life was lost.

zh: 箭头顺序不一致，已扣除 1 次生命。
en: Arrow order missed. One life was lost.

zh: 空间序列复现正确，长度会继续增加。
en: Spatial sequence matched. Length will keep growing.

zh: 箭头顺序不一致，已扣除 1 次生命。
en: Arrow order missed. One life was lost.

zh: 点击两个相同图案即可配对；路线仅作为连接反馈显示。
en: Tap two identical tiles to clear them; the line is feedback only.

zh: 点击两个相同图案；路径中无阻挡，可借边界并最多转两次弯即可配对消除。
en: Tap two identical tiles; clear them when the route is open, can use the edge, and turns at most twice.

zh: 适合移动端临时打包和解压；可创建 ZIP、TAR、tar.gz、tar.bz2、tar.xz、gz、bz2、xz，并识别 RAR/7z 限制。
en: Useful for temporary mobile packing and extraction. Create ZIP, TAR, tar.gz, tar.bz2, tar.xz, gz, bz2, or xz archives, with clear RAR/7z limitation notices.

zh: 选择多个文件或一个文件夹，设置格式和等级后生成归档；只有 ZIP 可设置压缩算法和密码。
en: Pick multiple files or one folder, then set format and level before creating an archive. Only ZIP supports compression algorithm and password settings.

zh: 已选择多个文件，当前单文件流格式会自动输出为 {format}。
en: Multiple files are selected, so this single-file stream format will output as {format}.

zh: 可选；留空表示不使用密码。
en: Optional. Leave blank to skip password protection.

zh: 只有 ZIP 归档支持密码保护；TAR/GZip/BZip2/XZ 会生成无密码归档或压缩流。
en: Only ZIP archives support password protection. TAR/GZip/BZip2/XZ create passwordless archives or streams.

zh: 导入 ZIP、TAR、GZip、BZip2 或 XZ 后先预览条目，再解压到应用文档目录；RAR/7z 会显示限制提示。
en: Import ZIP, TAR, GZip, BZip2, or XZ, preview entries, then extract to the app documents directory. RAR/7z show limitation notices.

zh: 只有 ZIP 归档支持密码保护。
en: Only ZIP archives support password protection.

zh: Web 环境已将解压结果重新打包为 ZIP 下载：{path}
en: Web extraction was repacked as a ZIP download: {path}

zh: 所选文件无法读取内容，请换用文件提供器中的本地文件。
en: The selected files have no readable bytes. Choose local files from the file provider.

zh: 当前平台不支持直接选择文件夹，请改用多文件选择。
en: This platform cannot pick folders directly. Use multi-file selection instead.

zh: 归档生成失败，请检查文件内容和压缩配置。
en: Archive creation failed. Check the files and archive settings.

zh: ZIP 读取失败，请确认解压密码或加密方式是否受支持。
en: ZIP reading failed. Check the extract password or whether this encryption method is supported.

zh: 压缩包读取失败，文件可能损坏、加密或格式不受支持。
en: Failed to read the archive. The file may be damaged, encrypted, or unsupported.

zh: 解压失败，请检查文件内容。
en: Extraction failed. Check the archive contents.

zh: 大文件可能需要一些时间，请保持页面打开。
en: Large archives can take a while. Keep this page open.

zh: 已识别为 RAR 文件，但当前内置移动端解压器尚未启用 RAR 容器解码；请先转为 ZIP 或 TAR。
en: This is recognized as a RAR file, but the built-in mobile extractor does not enable RAR container decoding yet. Convert it to ZIP or TAR first.

zh: 已识别为 7z 文件，但当前内置移动端解压器尚未启用 7z 容器解码；请先转为 ZIP 或 TAR，或后续接入原生 7z 解码器。
en: This is recognized as a 7z file, but the built-in mobile extractor does not enable 7z container decoding yet. Convert it to ZIP or TAR, or add a native 7z decoder later.

zh: 设置内容、字体、滚动速度、颜色、横竖屏和动态效果，进入后全屏高亮显示。
en: Configure content, typography, speed, colors, orientation, and motion before showing it fullscreen.

zh: 全屏后会保持屏幕常亮，并按这里的效果展示。
en: Fullscreen keeps the screen awake and matches these effects.

zh: 基于最近一次经期和周期长度进行本地估算，适合作为生活辅助记录。
en: Estimate locally from the last period date and cycle length as a lifestyle aid.

zh: 输入最近一次经期开始日，并根据自身情况调整周期、经期和黄体期长度。
en: Enter the last period start date and adjust cycle, period, and luteal length to your situation.

zh: 按月份标记经期、卵泡期、易孕窗口、排卵日和黄体期，点击日期查看详情。
en: Marks period, follicular phase, fertile window, ovulation, and luteal phase by month. Tap a day for details.

zh: 本工具只提供周期估算和生活记录辅助，不用于避孕、诊断或治疗。
en: This tool provides cycle estimates and lifestyle tracking only. It is not for contraception, diagnosis, or treatment.

zh: 可把高强度训练改为散步、拉伸或轻量活动，优先补水和休息。
en: Consider swapping high-intensity training for walking, stretching, or light movement, and prioritize hydration and rest.

zh: 若疼痛明显加重、出血量异常或伴随发热眩晕，请及时寻求专业医疗建议。
en: Seek professional medical advice if pain becomes much worse, bleeding is unusual, or fever/dizziness appears.

zh: 能量回升时适合安排学习、训练或复杂任务，但仍以真实疲劳感为准。
en: As energy rises, it can be a good time for learning, training, or complex tasks, while still following actual fatigue cues.

zh: 记录睡眠、皮肤、食欲和情绪变化，有助于判断自己的周期节律。
en: Track sleep, skin, appetite, and mood changes to learn your own cycle rhythm.

zh: 可观察宫颈黏液、基础体温或排卵试纸等身体信号，估算结果不能单独作为依据。
en: Observe body signs such as cervical mucus, basal temperature, or ovulation tests; estimates alone should not be the only basis.

zh: 若用于备孕、避孕或用药安排，请结合医生建议和更可靠的检测方式。
en: For conception, contraception, or medication planning, combine this with clinician guidance and more reliable checks.

zh: 排卵日可能因压力、睡眠、疾病、旅行或周期不规律而前后移动。
en: Ovulation may shift with stress, sleep, illness, travel, or irregular cycles.

zh: 若出现单侧轻微不适可先记录；剧烈疼痛或异常出血不应只按周期解释。
en: Record mild one-sided discomfort if it appears; severe pain or unusual bleeding should not be explained only by the cycle.

zh: 黄体期可更关注睡眠、盐分摄入、咖啡因和情绪压力，减少经前不适触发因素。
en: In the luteal phase, pay closer attention to sleep, salt intake, caffeine, and stress to reduce premenstrual triggers.

zh: 若经前情绪、疼痛或水肿持续影响生活，建议记录连续几个周期并咨询专业人士。
en: If premenstrual mood, pain, or bloating keeps affecting life, track several cycles and consult a professional.

zh: 今天约为周期第 {day}/{length} 天，处于经期估算范围。关注疼痛、出血量和疲劳变化。
en: Today is about day {day}/{length} of the cycle and falls in the estimated period range. Track pain, flow, and fatigue.

zh: 今天约为周期第 {day}/{length} 天，通常处于经期后到易孕窗口前的恢复与能量回升阶段。
en: Today is about day {day}/{length}, usually the recovery and rising-energy phase after the period and before the fertile window.

zh: 今天约为周期第 {day}/{length} 天，接近估算排卵窗口，实际时间可能随身体状态波动。
en: Today is about day {day}/{length}, close to the estimated ovulation window. Actual timing may shift with body conditions.

zh: 今天约为周期第 {day}/{length} 天，接近估算排卵日。若用于备孕或避孕，请结合专业建议。
en: Today is about day {day}/{length}, close to the estimated ovulation day. For conception or contraception, use professional guidance.

zh: 今天约为周期第 {day}/{length} 天，通常处于排卵后的黄体期，可关注睡眠、情绪和经前不适。
en: Today is about day {day}/{length}, usually the luteal phase after ovulation. Track sleep, mood, and premenstrual symptoms.

zh: 请输入有效的身高、体重和年龄数值。
en: Enter valid height, weight, and age values.

zh: 2 岁以下通常不使用 BMI-for-age 分类，请优先参考儿保生长曲线和医生评估。
en: BMI-for-age categories are not used under age 2; use pediatric growth charts and clinician assessment.

zh: 当前按 CDC 2-19 岁 BMI-for-age 口径估算，百分位会同时考虑年龄和性别。
en: This uses CDC BMI-for-age for ages 2-19, so age and sex both affect the percentile.

zh: 当前已经很接近所选成人健康区间的中位参考值。
en: You are already very close to the midpoint of the selected adult healthy range.

zh: 若以所选成人健康区间中位为目标，约需减重 {p0} kg。
en: To return near the midpoint of the selected adult healthy range, lose about {p0} kg.

zh: 若以所选成人健康区间中位为目标，约需增重 {p0} kg。
en: To return near the midpoint of the selected adult healthy range, gain about {p0} kg.

zh: 按年龄、性别和成人/儿童青少年不同口径判断，并补充围度、健康体重和日常能量估算。
en: Uses age, sex, and adult/youth-specific standards, with waist metrics, healthy weight range, and energy estimates.

zh: 先看当前 BMI、分类口径和最关键的下一步参考。
en: Start with BMI, classification method, and the next reference point.

zh: 输入身高、体重和年龄后即可计算。
en: Enter height, weight, and age to calculate.

zh: 年龄会决定成人固定阈值或儿童青少年 BMI-for-age 百分位；腰围和臀围可留空。
en: Age selects adult fixed bands or youth BMI-for-age percentiles; waist and hip are optional.

zh: 围度和能量估算用于日常管理，不作为诊断结论。
en: Waist and energy estimates are for day-to-day tracking, not diagnosis.

zh: Mifflin-St Jeor 公式更适合成年人和较大青少年静息代谢估算；儿童、孕期、运动员、疾病恢复期或饮食控制前应使用专业评估。
en: Mifflin-St Jeor is an estimate for adults and older teens. Children, pregnancy, athletes, recovery, or dieting plans need professional assessment.

zh: 本页用于日常自查和趋势管理，不替代医生、营养师或儿保评估。
en: This page is for daily self-checks and trend tracking, not a substitute for clinical or pediatric assessment.

zh: 成人：中国参考使用 BMI < 18.5 偏瘦，18.5-23.9 正常，24-27.9 超重，28 及以上肥胖；WHO 国际参考使用 18.5、25、30、35、40 分界。儿童青少年：2-19 岁按 CDC BMI-for-age 百分位，低于 P5 偏瘦，P5-P85 健康，P85-P95 超重，P95 及以上肥胖。
en: Adults: China bands use <18.5 underweight, 18.5-23.9 healthy, 24-27.9 overweight, and >=28 obesity; WHO bands use 18.5, 25, 30, 35, and 40 cut points. Youth: ages 2-19 use CDC BMI-for-age percentiles: <P5 underweight, P5-P85 healthy, P85-P95 overweight, and >=P95 obesity.

zh: 输入表达式或切换专业面板，完成科学计算、矩阵运算和概率分布估算。
en: Enter expressions or switch professional panels for scientific math, matrix operations, and probability estimates.

zh: 函数分析失败，请检查表达式、区间或变量 x。
en: Function analysis failed. Check the expression, range, or variable x.

zh: 矩阵计算失败，请检查维度、数值和是否可逆。
en: Matrix calculation failed. Check dimensions, values, and invertibility.

zh: 概率计算失败，请检查 n、k、p、均值和标准差。
en: Probability calculation failed. Check n, k, p, mean, and standard deviation.

zh: 选择一个专业计算动作后显示结果。
en: Run a professional calculation to show a result.

zh: 支持隐式乘法、阶乘、pi/tau/phi/e/ans/mem、三角/双曲函数、root/pow/gcd/lcm/nCr/nPr 和 log(base,value)。
en: Supports implicit multiplication, factorial, pi/tau/phi/e/ans/mem, trig/hyperbolic functions, root/pow/gcd/lcm/nCr/nPr, and log(base,value).

zh: 对函数、矩阵和概率问题使用独立面板，结果按数值方法估算。
en: Use dedicated panels for functions, matrices, and probability. Results are estimated numerically.

zh: 使用 x 作为变量，例如 sin(x)/x、x^2-2。
en: Use x as the variable, for example sin(x)/x or x^2-2.

zh: 行用分号分隔，列用逗号或空格分隔，例如 1,2;3,4。
en: Separate rows with semicolons and columns with commas or spaces, for example 1,2;3,4.
Used for solving Ax=b, for example 5,6.

zh: MS 保存当前结果，MR 插入记忆值，MC 清空记忆值。
en: MS stores the current result, MR inserts memory, and MC clears memory.

zh: 参考 city_compare 的城市成本口径，在本地估算同等生活方式下的薪资换算与结余变化。
en: Compare city costs locally and estimate equivalent salary for the same lifestyle.

zh: 先选当前城市、目标城市和你手里的月薪税前，再看迁移后的结余变化。
en: Pick the current city, target city, and your gross monthly salary first.

zh: 这里决定了“同等生活水平”的口径：住哪种房、怎么吃、怎么通勤、有没有教育与娱乐支出。
en: This defines what “same lifestyle” means in the comparison.

zh: 同一套生活方式下，看当前城市、目标城市同薪资，以及目标城市维持同等结余三种结果。
en: See current city, same salary in target city, and the salary needed to keep the same buffer.

zh: 保持同等结余所需薪资
费用微调与自定义支出
如果你觉得预设基准不够贴近自己，可以按类别微调，也可以直接新增固定月支出。
en: Fine-tune baseline costs by category or add your own fixed monthly expenses.

zh: 这页适合做 offer、调动和迁居前的横向估算，不是实时房源、税务申报或工资条模拟器。
en: Use this for side-by-side offer estimates, not as a real-time tax or payroll simulator.

zh: 原始字段口径来自 `Zippland/city_compare` README 和 `public/city_data.csv`：包括社保基数、租金、房价、餐饮、通勤、教育、水电网话、健身和电影票等条目；参考项目 README 进一步说明这些数据优先参考 Numbeo 公共数据。当前页面在此基础上做本地估算，并补充简化五险一金与个税模型。
en: The raw fields come from the Zippland/city_compare README and public/city_data.csv, including social-security bases, rent, home prices, dining, transport, education, utilities, connectivity, fitness, and cinema. The README also states that the source data is primarily referenced from Numbeo public data. This page builds local estimates on top of that and adds a simplified social-security and tax model.

zh: 不只展示结果，也总结这次城市迁移里最值得盯住的差异项。
en: Not just the result: this also summarizes the key differences to watch.

zh: 这里列出参考页里的原始成本字段，便于你核对差异到底来自哪类基础价格。
en: These are the raw reference items behind the comparison.

zh: 同等生活方式目标月薪
想在 {city} 维持你现在在 {city1} 的同等生活方式和月度结余，大致需要这个税前月薪。
en: To keep the same lifestyle and monthly buffer when moving from {city1} to {city}, this is the rough gross salary you need.

zh: 搜索、匹配、复制色值和图片取色。
en: Search, match, copy color values, and sample images.

zh: 本地色卡资产暂时不可用，请检查打包资源是否完整。
en: The local palette assets are unavailable. Check whether the bundled resources are intact.

zh: 正在读取本地色卡数据。
没有找到匹配的颜色，请换一个名称、拼音、罗马音或 HEX 片段。
en: No color matched. Try another name, phonetic spelling, romaji, or hex fragment.

zh: 导入本地图片后，点击任意位置即可读取像素颜色。
en: Import a local image, then tap anywhere to read the pixel color.

zh: 这里会显示可点击取色的图片预览。
en: A tappable image preview will appear here.

zh: 点击图片任意位置取色
en: Tap anywhere on the image to sample

zh: 名称 / 拼音 / 罗马音 / HEX / ??FF??
实时方向、持机角度和磁场状态都放在首屏，方便你快速判断当前朝向是否稳定。
en: Heading, tilt, and magnetic quality stay visible on the first screen for quick orientation checks.

zh: 先看当前朝向，再看设备是否持平和磁场是否稳定。
en: Check heading first, then device tilt and magnetic stability.

zh: 磁场容易受金属、磁吸壳和桌面电器干扰，转动手机一圈通常能更快稳定。
en: Metal, magnetic cases, and electronics can disturb the field. A slow full turn often stabilizes readings faster.

zh: 如果方向持续跳动，请离开磁吸配件、笔记本、音箱或车载支架后再看结果。
en: If the dial keeps jumping, move away from magnetic accessories, laptops, speakers, or car mounts before trusting the result.

zh: 当前设备没有可用的磁力计或加速度计，所以无法提供方向结果。
en: This device does not expose the magnetometer or accelerometer needed for a compass fix.

zh: 建议在真机手机上打开此工具，桌面端和部分模拟器通常不会提供完整磁传感器。
en: Open this tool on a real phone. Desktop targets and many simulators usually do not provide a full magnetic sensor stack.

zh: 方向稳定，可以用作参考。
en: Heading is stable and ready for reference.

zh: 请尽量让手机保持水平。
en: Keep the phone as level as possible.

zh: 附近可能有磁场干扰，换个位置再试。
en: Magnetic interference may be nearby. Try another spot.

zh: 轻轻转动手机，等待传感器稳定。
en: Gently rotate the phone and wait for the sensor to settle.

zh: 秒级时间差、多单位加减、周期倒计时、目标进度和生命烛光。
en: Second-level diff, multi-unit math, period countdowns, target progress, and life candle.

zh: 同一个开始时间可在不同页签中复用，所有展示都精确到秒。
en: The same start time can be reused across tabs; all outputs are second-level.

zh: 选择开始与结束时间，结果同时展示日历拆分和总量换算。
en: Pick start and end time; see both calendar breakdown and total units.

zh: 年可输入 0.5、1.25 或 50%。整数年/月按日历推进，小数部分折算为秒。
en: Years accept 0.5, 1.25, or 50%. Whole years/months are calendar-aware; fractional parts become seconds.

zh: 适合入学、毕业、高考、期末、放假、周末或节日倒计时。
en: Useful for school entry, graduation, exams, breaks, weekends, or holidays.

zh: 今年、本月、本周、本日、本小时会每秒动态变化，低层级可折叠查看。
en: Year, month, week, day, and hour update every second; smaller units can stay collapsed.

zh: 默认预期生命使用 79 年，可按个人假设调整；这只是时间感知工具，不是医学预测。
en: Default life expectancy is 79 years and can be adjusted; this is a time-awareness tool, not medical prediction.

zh: 可填 79 或 80.5，默认使用 79 年。
图片超过 32MB，请先压缩后再导入。
en: The image is larger than 32 MB. Compress it before importing.

zh: 原图比例与机模屏幕不完全一致；若主体被裁切，可把截图适配切换为“完整显示”。
en: The source aspect differs from this screen. Switch screenshot fit to "Fit whole image" if important content is cropped.

zh: 导入本地截图，合成到原创前视机模，按需调整背景、裁切、状态栏并导出 PNG。
en: Import a local screenshot, place it in an original front-view mockup, then tune backdrop, fit, status bar, and PNG export.

zh: 正在预览当前合成效果，可继续调整机模、背景或直接导出。
en: Previewing the current composite. Tune the mockup or export it now.

zh: 下一步：导入一张截图，页面会立刻生成带壳预览。
en: Next: pick a screenshot and the mockup preview appears here.

zh: 先选机模与背景，再决定截图是填满屏幕还是完整显示。
en: Choose the mockup and backdrop, then decide whether the screenshot fills or fits the screen.

zh: 给屏幕玻璃和边框补一点棚拍反光，让成图更像真实展示图。
en: Add a subtle studio reflection so the result feels closer to a real product shot.

zh: 原图顶部被裁掉，或需要统一展示时间、电量和网络状态时再开启。
en: Enable this when the source top is cropped or when you need consistent time, battery, and network state.

zh: 开启后可单独控制时间、电量、信号、Wi-Fi 和网络制式。
en: When enabled, control time, battery, signal, Wi-Fi, and network label independently.

zh: 当前机模均为仓库内原创前视展示图层，参考主流真机的正面观感、边框节奏和 cutout 布局，但不对应任何厂商官方营销素材或精确 OEM 尺寸。
en: These mockups are original front-view showcase assets inspired by mainstream device proportions, frame rhythm, and cutout placement, not official OEM marketing materials or exact physical dimensions.

zh: 随后选择机模、背景、裁切方式和状态栏。
en: Then choose the mockup, backdrop, fit, and status bar.

zh: 把手机边缘当作标尺使用，支持手动校准；量角器可叠加相机背景辅助对角。
en: Use the phone edge as a ruler with manual calibration, plus a protractor over a camera background.

zh: 进入横屏全屏后，刻度贴近屏幕长边显示，方便用手机边缘直接量长度。
en: Open a landscape fullscreen ruler with ticks pinned to the screen edge for direct length checks.

zh: 打开后会请求相机权限，并把相机画面放在量角器刻度下方作为背景。
en: Requests camera access and places the live camera feed under the protractor scale.

zh: 先看下方 1 cm 参考条是否接近真实长度，不准时可滑动微调，再重置回系统基线。
en: Check whether the 1 cm reference below matches reality, then fine tune or reset back to the default baseline.

zh: 没有找到可用相机，仍可使用纯刻度量角器。
en: No camera was found. You can still use the protractor scale.

zh: 相机权限被拒绝，请在系统设置中开启后再试。
en: Camera access was denied. Please enable it in system settings and try again.

zh: 系统已禁止再次弹出相机授权，请手动去设置开启。
en: The system will not prompt again. Please enable camera access in settings.

zh: 相机初始化失败，已降级为纯刻度量角器。
en: Camera initialization failed. Falling back to the protractor overlay only.

zh: 当前平台不支持相机插件，已使用静态背景。
en: This platform does not support the camera plugin, so a static background is used.

zh: 量角器背景启动失败，已保留刻度层。
en: The protractor background failed to start, but the scale overlay is still available.

zh: 用定位标记两点距离，或输入目标高度后通过手机倾角粗估距离。
en: Mark two GPS points, or enter target height and estimate distance from phone tilt.

zh: 适合户外较远距离，结果依赖定位精度。
en: Useful outdoors over longer distances; results depend on GPS accuracy.

zh: 输入手机到目标底部的垂直高度，瞄准目标底部后读取粗略距离。
en: Enter vertical height from phone to target base, aim at the base, then read a rough distance.

zh: 当前平台无法读取倾角传感器。
en: This platform cannot read the tilt sensor.

zh: 定位服务未开启，请先在系统设置中打开定位。
en: Location service is off. Enable location in system settings first.

zh: 定位权限被拒绝，无法读取速度。
en: Location permission was denied, so speed cannot be read.

zh: 定位权限已被永久拒绝，请到系统设置中授权。
en: Location permission is permanently denied. Grant it in system settings.

zh: 当前位置读取失败，请重试。
en: Failed to read the current location. Try again.

zh: 请输入大于 0 的倒计时时长
触发时间需要晚于当前时间
en: Trigger time must be in the future

zh: 模拟来电最长支持 30 天内触发
en: Fake calls can be scheduled up to 30 days ahead

zh: 请至少填写来电姓名或号码
en: Enter at least a caller name or number

zh: 已开始等待，到点将全屏播放模拟来电
en: Started. The fake call will play full-screen at the trigger time

zh: 已开始前台等待，到点会在应用内全屏播放
en: Started with in-app fallback. Keep this page open for full-screen playback

zh: 点击开始后等待指定时间，到点全屏播放模拟来电、铃声和震动。
en: Tap start, wait for the selected time, then play a full-screen fake incoming call with ringtone and vibration.

zh: 来电触发和接听后的通话界面可以使用不同背景。
en: Incoming and accepted-call screens can use different backgrounds.

zh: 用于全屏来电响铃界面。
en: Used on the full-screen ringing interface.

zh: 接听后进入通话计时界面使用。
这些内容会显示在全屏来电界面上。
en: These details appear on the full-screen call UI.

zh: 选择倒计时或指定时间。开始后到点直接进入全屏来电。
en: Choose a countdown or fixed time. Once started, the call screen appears at the trigger time.

zh: Android 可在锁屏或后台尝试全屏唤起来电；其他平台使用应用内前台触发。
en: Android can try to launch full-screen from lock screen or background. Other platforms use the in-app foreground fallback.

zh: 已交给系统调度；页面保持打开时也会有应用内兜底。
en: Scheduled natively; this page also keeps an in-app fallback while open.

zh: 当前使用应用内兜底，请保持页面打开。
en: Using in-app fallback. Keep this page open.

zh: 尽量清空内容物，保持干燥整洁；玻璃、金属和尖锐物请包好再投放。
en: Empty and keep items dry where possible; wrap glass, metal, and sharp edges before disposal.

zh: 保持完整密封，优先投放到专用收集点；电池、灯管、药品不要混入普通垃圾桶。
en: Keep sealed and intact, then use designated collection points; do not mix batteries, lamps, or medicine with ordinary waste.

zh: 易腐烂的生物质生活废弃物
投放前沥干水分，去掉塑料袋、牙签、餐巾纸、包装盒等非厨余物。
en: Drain liquid first and remove bags, toothpicks, napkins, wrappers, and containers.

zh: 暂不适合回收或资源化
尽量压缩体积后投放；被污染、难清洗或复合材料通常归入干垃圾或其他垃圾。
en: Compress when possible; contaminated, hard-to-clean, or composite items are usually residual waste.

zh: 不要直接丢入普通桶，优先联系物业、社区或正规回收渠道处理。
en: Do not put it in regular bins; contact property management, community service, or certified recyclers.
No mapped category from remote data

zh: 请打开来源页面或按当地分类规则确认。
en: Open the source page or confirm with local sorting rules.

zh: 远程请求超时，请稍后重试或打开来源页面查询。
en: Remote request timed out. Try again later or open the source page.

zh: 远程数据格式变化，暂时无法解析。
en: Remote data format changed and cannot be parsed yet.

zh: 远程请求失败，请检查网络后重试。
en: Remote request failed. Check the network and retry.

zh: 请求腾讯远程分类数据，输入物品名称后实时筛选结果。
en: Fetch Tencent remote sorting data and filter by item name.

zh: 搜索远程数据，例如：纸巾、苹果核、电池
en: Search remote data, e.g. tissue, apple core, battery

zh: 输入物品名称后显示匹配结果；具体投放仍以所在城市和社区要求为准。
en: Enter an item name to show matches; local city and community rules still apply.

zh: 正在请求远程分类数据...
正在请求腾讯远程资源
已加载 {totalCount} 条远程分类记录
输入物品名称开始查询，或打开腾讯在线查询页继续查。
en: Enter an item name to search, or open Tencent online query.

zh: 可以换一个常见名称试试，或打开在线查询确认「{query}」。
en: Try another common name, or open the online query for "{query}".

zh: 当前分类筛选下没有结果，可以取消分类筛选，或打开在线查询确认「{query}」。
en: No result under this category filter. Clear it, or open the online query for "{query}".

zh: 当前页会先请求腾讯远程数据，再在应用内筛选；没命中时可换常用名称或打开来源页。
en: This page fetches Tencent remote data first, then filters locally; try common names or open the source page if missing.

zh: 分类记录来自腾讯 QQ 浏览器工具箱公开 JSON 资源，刷新按钮会重新请求。
en: Sorting records come from Tencent QQ Browser toolbox public JSON. Refresh fetches again.

zh: 远程数据按物品名称匹配，复杂描述建议拆成短词查询。
en: Remote data matches item names, so split complex descriptions into short terms.

zh: 远程结果可作参考，投放时仍以所在城市和社区最新规则为准。
en: Remote results are references; city and community rules still apply.

zh: 本页请求腾讯工具箱远程 JSON 并在应用内筛选；如果远程资源不可用，可打开来源页面继续查询。
en: This page requests Tencent toolbox remote JSON and filters in app. If unavailable, open the source page.

zh: 选择视频后拖动裁剪范围，设置帧率、宽度和质量，再生成 GIF。
en: Pick a video, drag the trim range, set FPS, width, and quality, then create a GIF.

zh: 选择本地视频文件；工具会按系统播放器能力加载预览，不会一次性读取整段视频到内存。
en: Choose a local video file. The tool loads a preview through the system player without reading the whole video into memory.

zh: 当前本地转 GIF 后端支持 Android/iOS，文件选择覆盖 MP4、MOV、M4V、WebM、3GP、AVI、MKV、WMV、MPEG 等；实际加载取决于系统播放器和抽帧能力。
en: The current local GIF backend supports Android/iOS. The picker covers MP4, MOV, M4V, WebM, 3GP, AVI, MKV, WMV, MPEG, and similar files; actual loading depends on the system player and frame extraction support.

zh: 拖动范围滑块选择要转换的片段，可用预览按钮检查播放范围。
en: Drag the range slider to choose the segment to convert. Use preview to check the playback range.

zh: 先导入视频，然后选择要转换成 GIF 的范围。
en: Import a video first, then choose the range to convert to GIF.

zh: 已识别该视频文件，但当前平台未接入视频预览和 GIF 导出后端。请在 Android 或 iOS 设备上转换。
en: The video file was recognized, but this platform does not have the video preview or GIF export backend wired. Convert it on Android or iOS.

zh: 导出会按所选范围生成 GIF；片段越长、帧率和宽度越高，文件越大。
en: Export creates a GIF from the selected range. Longer clips, higher FPS, and wider output create larger files.

zh: 无法读取该视频路径，请换一个本地视频文件。
en: Cannot read this video path. Try another local video file.

zh: 无法读取视频容器信息，请确认文件可访问且不是损坏的视频。
en: Could not read the video container information. Make sure the file is accessible and not damaged.

zh: 当前平台暂不支持本地视频转 GIF，请在 Android 或 iOS 设备上使用。
en: This platform does not support local video to GIF yet. Use an Android or iOS device.

zh: 无法读取视频时长，请换用可正常播放的视频文件。
en: Could not read the video duration. Try a video file that plays normally.

zh: 视频文件存在，但系统播放器无法解码。请换用 MP4/H.264、MOV、M4V、3GP 或平台支持的视频。
en: The video file exists, but the system player could not decode it. Try MP4/H.264, MOV, M4V, 3GP, or another platform-supported video.

zh: 视频可加载，但 GIF 抽帧失败。请缩短范围，或降低帧率、宽度和质量后重试。
en: The video loaded, but GIF frame extraction failed. Try a shorter range or lower FPS, width, and quality.

zh: 导出的 GIF 文件不存在，请重新生成后再保存。
en: The exported GIF file no longer exists. Create it again before saving.

zh: 时钟、弹幕、补光和计分等直接面向屏幕展示的工具。
en: Clock, barrage, fill light, and scoreboard tools for direct screen display.

zh: 手机状态、震动、压缩归档、提醒和模拟来电等系统辅助工具。
en: System helpers for phone status, vibration, archives, reminders, and fake calls.

zh: 尺子、指南针、水平仪、测速、放大镜、照度和测距等传感器工具。
en: Sensor tools for ruler, compass, level, speed, magnifier, light, and distance measurement.

zh: 取色、图片处理、表情包、设备外框、视频转 GIF、证件照和网页图片导出。
en: Color picking, image processing, memes, device frames, video to GIF, ID photos, and image-to-web export.

zh: 壁纸、邮编、以图搜图、垃圾分类、短链和二维码等联网或跳转工具。
en: Wallpaper, postal codes, reverse image search, recycling lookup, short links, and QR tools.

zh: 字数统计、文本转换、上下标和简易脑图等文本编辑辅助。
en: Text helpers for counting, transforms, superscript/subscript, and simple mind maps.

zh: 历史年表、元素周期表与知识图谱资料。
en: Timelines, periodic table, and knowledge reference data.

zh: 单位、科学计算、周期、工作性价比、城市薪资、房贷、日期、世界时钟、BMI、亲属称谓和 Offer 决策。
en: Unit, scientific, cycle, work-worth, city salary, mortgage, date, world clock, BMI, kinship, and offer calculators.

zh: {length} 个实用工具，按 {categories} 个精准分类整理，支持搜索、快捷入口和统一来源页。
en: {length} handy tools organized into {categories} focused categories with search, quick access, and a unified source page.

zh: 可按关键词搜索，或展开分类抽屉浏览全部工具。
en: Search by keyword or expand category drawers to browse all tools.

zh: 按工具集中查看外部链接；实际版权、可用性和服务条款以原站为准。
en: Review external links by tool; copyright, availability, and terms follow the original sites.

zh: 这里集中展示生活工具模块中声明过的外部来源，避免在各工具页分散展示。
en: This page gathers external sources declared by life tools so they are not scattered across tool pages.

zh: 来源链接用于资料核对、能力边界说明或实现形态参考；生活工具内的本地功能不默认代表原站完整能力。
en: Source links are for verification, capability boundaries, or implementation reference; local life-tool features do not imply full parity with the original sites.

zh: 该工具以提供公开资源链接和信息参考为主，详细功能可在相关来源网站使用。
en: This tool provides public resource links and information references. For detailed features, please refer to the source websites.

zh: 统一查看生活工具使用的第三方页面、公开数据与实现参考。
en: Unified list of third-party pages, public data, and implementation references used by life tools.

zh: 离线裁切照片、替换纯色背景，并按常见证件照规格导出。
en: Offline crop, plain background replacement, and common ID photo export.

zh: 先选择头像照片，再按用途调整规格、裁切位置和底色。
en: Pick a portrait first, then adjust preset, crop position, and background.

zh: 尺寸按毫米和 DPI 换算，背景替换适合纯色或接近纯色背景的照片。
en: Size is calculated from millimeters and DPI. Background replacement works best on plain backdrops.

zh: 按照片四角取样替换相近背景，不会上传照片。
en: Samples the four corners and replaces similar backdrop pixels without uploading.

zh: 生成后检查输出像素、裁切区域和换底色影响范围。
en: After generation, review pixels, crop box, and replaced backdrop coverage.

zh: 左侧原图，右侧生成结果；窄屏下自动上下排列。
en: Source on the left, generated ID photo on the right. Narrow screens stack vertically.

zh: 本工具在本地处理图片，适合日常报名、资料整理和尺寸核对。
en: This tool processes images locally for everyday forms, profile prep, and size checks.

zh: 简易换底色依赖照片四角取样，复杂背景、头发边缘和阴影可能需要先在专业修图工具中抠图；证件照规格请以具体办事机构要求为准。
en: Plain background replacement samples the four corners, so complex scenes, hair edges, and shadows may need a dedicated editor first. Always follow the target authority requirements.

zh: 本地离线压缩，支持比例、宽度和质量控制。
en: Offline local compression with ratio, width, and quality controls.

zh: 选择本地图片后可按比例或宽度进行压缩。
en: Pick a local image, then compress by ratio or target width.

zh: 默认输出 JPEG，可显著减小体积。
en: Multiple compression algorithms with optional auto-best selection.

zh: 选择图片并执行压缩后展示结果。
en: Pick an image and run compression to view results.

zh: 展示压缩后体积、比例和尺寸变化。
en: Shows output size, ratio, and dimensions.

zh: 左侧原图，右侧压缩结果。
en: Source on the left and compressed result on the right.

zh: 把本地图片封装成单文件 HTML 预览页，也可上传原图到 Uguu 获取 3 小时临时分享链接。
en: Wrap a local image into a single-file HTML page, or upload the image to Uguu for a temporary 3-hour share link.

zh: 先选择图片，再生成可离线打开的单文件网页。
en: Pick an image first, then generate an offline single-file page.

zh: 标题和替代文本会写入生成的 HTML，适合分享给浏览器直接打开。
en: Title and alt text are written into the generated HTML for browser viewing.

zh: HTML 内嵌 Base64 图片，不依赖网络；大图会让 HTML 体积明显变大。
en: The HTML embeds the image as Base64 and works offline; large images make the HTML much bigger.

zh: 上传原图到 Uguu，生成公开临时链接。请不要上传证件、隐私或敏感图片。
en: Upload the original image to Uguu for a public temporary link. Do not upload ID, private, or sensitive images.

zh: 上传后会在这里显示临时链接。
en: The temporary link will appear here after upload.

zh: 本地 HTML 不会上传图片；Uguu 分享是第三方公开临时链接，公开站 FAQ 当前声明约 3 小时后删除，并会保留活动文件数据库记录到过期。
en: Local HTML generation does not upload the image. Uguu sharing is a third-party public temporary link; its FAQ currently states deletion after about 3 hours and active-file database records until expiry.

zh: 若需要长期托管网页，请使用正式对象存储或静态站点服务；本工具更适合临时预览、转发和轻量展示。
en: For long-term hosting, use real object storage or a static-site service. This tool is meant for temporary preview, forwarding, and lightweight display.

zh: 在同一页面内快速切换压缩和扩大；扩大侧补充更轻量的插值路径与自定义倍率。
en: Switch quickly between compression and upscale with lighter interpolation paths and a custom scale input.

zh: 两个工作区相互独立，可快速来回切换。
en: The two workspaces stay independent and switch quickly.

zh: 本地插值放大与补像素扩展，用于把小图转成指定更大分辨率。
en: Local interpolation upscale and canvas expansion for larger target resolutions.

zh: 先选图，再决定是插值放大还是仅扩展画布。结果可导出为 PNG 或 JPEG。
en: Pick an image, then choose interpolation upscale or canvas-only expansion. Export as PNG or JPEG.

zh: 支持常见插值算法、指定宽高和仅补像素扩边，适合先把图做大再进入其他图像流程。
en: Use common interpolation algorithms, exact target size, or pixel-expansion canvas modes before other image workflows.

zh: 说明：当前为本地插值放大与画布扩展，不是生成式 AI 超分辨率，无法凭空恢复真实细节。
en: Note: this is local interpolation and canvas expansion, not generative AI super-resolution, so it cannot recreate true missing details.

zh: 选图并执行扩大后显示输出尺寸、体积和算法信息。
en: Pick an image and run upscale to inspect size, bytes, and algorithm info.

zh: 查看放大后的像素、体积和当前处理方式。
en: Review output pixels, file size, and active processing path.

zh: 左侧原图，右侧扩大结果。窄屏下自动改为上下排列。
en: Source on the left and upscale result on the right. On narrow screens this stacks vertically.

zh: 一屏看清水平、垂直、误差和当前持机状态，方便贴墙、摆台和快速找平。
en: See horizontal, vertical, error, and holding state on one screen for quick leveling checks.

zh: 水平模式同时看俯仰和横滚；垂直模式更适合贴墙和门框校正。
en: Level mode watches pitch and roll together; plumb mode is better for walls and door frames.

zh: 手机壳凸起、桌面软垫和手持抖动都会影响结果，建议短暂停稳后再看数字。
en: Raised cases, soft surfaces, and hand shake all affect the reading. Pause briefly before trusting the number.

zh: 绿色表示已经基本找平；黄色表示接近；仍偏差较大时请缓慢调整，不要边大幅移动边读数。
en: Green means level, yellow means close, and larger errors call for slow corrections instead of reading while moving.

zh: 当前设备没有可用加速度计，所以无法提供水平检测。
en: This device does not expose the accelerometer required for leveling.

zh: 请在手机真机上使用该功能，桌面端和多数模拟器通常不会返回可靠的重力方向。
en: Use this tool on a physical phone. Desktop targets and most simulators do not provide a reliable gravity vector.
The device is close to plumb

zh: 让气泡回到中心竖线附近
en: Bring the bubble back to the center line

zh: 俯仰和横滚都已经压到很小
en: Pitch and roll are both tightly centered

zh: 同时把俯仰和横滚往 0° 收
en: Bring both pitch and roll closer to 0°

zh: 使用设备光线传感器估算环境照度；不支持的设备会显示降级状态。
en: Estimate ambient illuminance from the device light sensor; unsupported devices show a fallback state.

zh: 数据来自系统光线传感器，适合快速判断明暗变化。
en: Data comes from the system light sensor and is best for quick brightness checks.

zh: 当前平台没有可用的环境光传感器接口。
en: This platform has no available ambient light sensor interface.

zh: 用摄像头放大小字、纹理和细节，可冻结画面便于查看。
en: Use the camera to enlarge small text, texture, and details, with freeze frame for inspection.

zh: 滑动调整变焦；需要时打开补光灯或冻结当前画面。
en: Adjust zoom with the slider; turn on torch or freeze the frame when needed.

zh: 相机初始化失败，请检查权限或设备状态。
en: Camera initialization failed. Check permission or device state.

zh: 当前设备不支持此变焦设置。
en: This zoom setting is not supported by the device.

zh: 补光灯不可用或被系统拒绝。
en: Torch is unavailable or rejected by the system.
Failed to freeze the frame. Try again.

zh: 导入本地图片，在预览区直接拖动和缩放文字图层，再按同一套参数导出真实 PNG。
en: Import a local image, drag and scale text layers directly in preview, then export a real PNG driven by the same layer model.

zh: 点选图层后可直接拖动位置、双指缩放，蓝色边框表示当前正在编辑的图层。
en: Tap a layer to edit it, drag to move, and pinch to scale. The blue frame marks the active layer.

zh: 先导入一张本地图片再开始做表情包。
en: Pick a local image to start making a meme.

zh: 顶部、底部和贴纸文案分别对应三个独立图层，后续样式和层级会作用到当前选中的图层。
en: Top, bottom, and sticker captions map to three independent layers. Style and order controls apply to the currently selected layer.

zh: 本地创建节点关系，整理想法并导出图片。
en: Create local node relations, organize ideas, and export an image.

zh: 当前选中节点会在下方操作区同步编辑，也可以进入全屏便捷模式拖拽整理。
en: The selected node is edited below, or arranged by drag in fullscreen quick mode.

zh: 完整标题在这里保留，不受画布节点宽度影响。
按住节点拖拽，松手后位置会保留。
en: Hold and drag a node; its position is kept.

zh: 请检查贷款金额、面积、单价、利率和年限，所有核心参数都需要为有效正数。
en: Check loan amount, area, unit price, rate, and term. Core values must be valid positive numbers.

zh: 支持等额本息、等额本金、按贷款额或住房面积测算，并纳入首次还款日、已还期数、提前还款和附加费用。
en: Calculate equal installment or equal principal loans by amount or housing area, with first payment date, progress, prepayment, and fees.

zh: 先选还款方式和计算方式，再录入贷款、利率、年限和首次还款时间。
en: Choose repayment and calculation modes, then enter amount, rate, term, and first payment date.

zh: 用已还期数和提前还款模拟当前剩余贷款；月费和一次性费用会进入总费用统计。
en: Use paid periods and prepayment to estimate remaining debt. Monthly and upfront fees are included in cost totals.

zh: 这里把合同口径、已经还掉的部分、剩余成本和最终日期拆开展示。
en: Contract totals, paid progress, remaining cost, and final date are separated here.

zh: 默认展示从下一期开始的前 12 期，等额本金会自然呈现逐月递减。
en: Shows the next 12 periods. Equal principal naturally decreases month by month.

zh: 本工具用于本地估算和方案比较，不替代银行合同、征信审批、税费政策或提前还款违约金规则。
en: This tool is for local estimation and comparison only. It does not replace bank contracts, credit approval, tax policy, or prepayment penalty rules.

zh: 公式按月复利和每月固定还款日测算；实际扣款可能受放款日、计息起点、LPR 调整、商贷/公积金组合、保险费、评估费和地区政策影响。
en: The formulas use monthly compounding and fixed due dates. Real payments may differ because of disbursement date, interest start date, LPR changes, mixed commercial/provident loans, insurance, appraisal fees, and local policy.

zh: 提醒时间需要晚于当前时间
en: Reminder time must be in the future

zh: 提前提醒已经早于当前时间，请缩短提前时间或改晚提醒时间
en: The lead time would fire in the past. Shorten it or choose a later reminder time.

zh: 已套用这条提醒的配置
提醒标题会显示在这里
说明、待办细节或给自己的短句会显示在这里
en: Description, action hint, or a short note appears here

zh: 用状态栏、锁屏提醒和系统日历给自己留下一条可执行的提示。
en: Leave yourself actionable prompts through notifications, lock-screen alerts, and calendar mirroring.

zh: 先确认提醒链路是否可用；不支持完整原生提醒的平台仍会保留页面列表和日历镜像。
en: Check the delivery path first. Platforms without native reminders still keep the in-app list and calendar mirror.

zh: 开启后会调度 Android 状态栏与锁屏提醒。
en: When enabled, Android status-bar and lock-screen reminders are scheduled.

zh: 当前平台以页面管理和系统日历镜像为主。
en: This platform mainly supports page-side management and calendar mirroring.

zh: 先写清楚要提醒什么，再决定何时触发、用哪种提醒强度以及是否同步到日历。
en: Write what to remember, then choose when it fires, how strong it appears, and whether it mirrors to calendar.

zh: 这里集中处理未完成提醒；过期提醒会保留，方便完成、删除或稍后提醒。
en: Unfinished reminders stay here, including triggered ones, so you can complete, delete, or snooze them.

zh: 还没有提醒。先在上方创建一个给自己的提醒。
en: No reminders yet. Create one for yourself above.

zh: 触发后保持在通知栏，直到完成、稍后提醒、删除或按设置进入应用取消。
en: Keep it in the notification shade until completed, snoozed, deleted, or dismissed by open-app behavior.

zh: 关闭后，点击通知进入应用不会自动移除常驻通知，适合需要反复看到的提醒。
en: When off, tapping the reminder opens the app without dismissing a sticky notification.

zh: 支持时会写入系统日历事件，并保留备注与提醒时间。
en: When supported, a mirrored calendar event is written with the note and reminder timing.

zh: 适合化学式、脚注、指数和小号标注。
en: Great for formulas, footnotes, exponents, and small labels.

zh: 适合化学式下标、序号尾标和低位标注。
en: Good for chemistry subscripts and lower-position markers.

zh: 适合清单编号、重点序号和按钮样式文本。
en: Useful for list markers, callouts, and numbered buttons.

zh: 适合试题序号、步骤编号和文档条目。
en: Useful for quiz numbers, step markers, and document items.

zh: 适合海报标题、视觉强调和统一排版宽度。
en: Useful for poster-like emphasis and uniform text width.

zh: 把数字和常用字符转换为上标、下标、带圈、括号编号或全角，并支持反向还原。
en: Convert digits and common symbols into superscript, subscript, circled, bracketed, or fullwidth forms with reverse normalization.

zh: 开启后会把当前模式下的标记字符尽量还原回普通文本。
en: When enabled, marked characters are normalized back into plain text where possible.

zh: 输入内容后会在这里实时显示转换结果。
en: Converted output appears here as you type.

zh: 提示: Unicode 上下标本身覆盖不完整，无法转换的字符会保留原样并计入“未覆盖字符”。
en: Tip: Unicode super/sub scripts are incomplete by nature, so unsupported characters stay unchanged and are counted above.

zh: 参考 OfferSelect 的机会录入形态，在本地完成多 Offer 评分、风险拆解和谈薪锚点。
en: Local multi-offer scoring, risk breakdown, and negotiation anchors inspired by OfferSelect.

zh: 保留参考页的标题、背景、专业和经历字段，用于生成可复制的决策摘要。
en: Keeps the reference page profile fields for the shareable decision summary.

zh: 已婉拒的机会会保留作对照，但不参与首选排序。
en: Rejected offers remain visible for reference but are excluded from the leader ranking.

zh: 字段对应参考页里的公司、薪资、福利、社保、强度、地点、优缺点，并补充本地评分所需的扣款和成本。
en: Fields map to company, salary, benefits, insurance, intensity, location, pros, and cons, with extra local scoring inputs.

zh: 权重越高，该维度越能影响排序；适合模拟“缺钱优先”“健康优先”“成长优先”等场景。
