en: Higher weight means that dimension affects ranking more.

zh: 分数来自现金、时间、健康、成长、稳定和城市适配六个维度，已婉拒项放在末尾。
en: Scores combine cash, time, health, growth, stability, and city fit.

zh: 把优势、风险和谈薪追平金额摊开看，避免只盯一个总分。
en: Review strengths, risks, and negotiation anchors instead of only one score.

zh: 仍建议核对合同主体、试用期、年终奖和社保缴纳口径。
en: Still verify contract entity, probation terms, bonus rules, and social insurance.

zh: 参考工具链提供 Offer 打分、城市对比和 AI 面试入口，均支持外部在线工具与本地内置替代。
en: The reference toolchain offers Offer scoring, city comparison, and AI interview tools, each with an external site and a built-in local alternative.

zh: 外部参考 worthjob；本地可进入工作性价比计算器继续细算。
en: External worthjob reference; local work value calculator is available.

zh: 外部参考 citycompare；本地可进入城市薪资对比工具核对生活成本。
en: External citycompare reference; local city salary compare can verify costs.

zh: 外部参考 Snap-Solver；面试或笔试风险需结合岗位流程单独判断。
en: External Snap-Solver reference; interview or assessment risk should be judged separately.

zh: 本页不上传 Offer 数据，也不替代职业、法律、税务或财务建议；请用合同、HR 书面口径和真实工资条继续核验。
en: This page does not upload offer data and is not career, legal, tax, or financial advice. Verify with contracts, written HR terms, and real payroll details.

zh: 已复制 Offer 决策摘要
添加或取消婉拒后开始比较。
en: Add or un-reject offers to compare.

zh: 按周期刷新关键设备状态，便于排查电量、屏幕和系统信息。
en: Refresh key device state periodically to inspect battery, screen, and system information.

zh: 电量、屏幕和内存信息会自动刷新。
en: Battery, screen, and memory information refresh automatically.

zh: 当前平台没有提供设备信息通道。
en: This platform does not provide the device information channel.

zh: 查询超时，请稍后重试或打开来源页面查询。
en: Lookup timed out. Try again later or open the source page.

zh: 查询结果格式变化，暂时无法解析。
en: Lookup result format changed and cannot be parsed yet.

zh: 查询失败，请检查网络后重试。
en: Lookup failed. Check the network and retry.

zh: 输入城市、网点或地址片段，查询中国邮政网点邮编。
en: Enter a city, site, or address fragment to find China Post site postal codes.

zh: 输入城市/网点/地址，例如：深圳、深圳大学
en: Enter city/site/address, e.g. Shenzhen, Shenzhen University

zh: 只显示网点、地址、邮编和必要电话；重要邮件仍建议按完整地址复核。
en: Only key site, address, postal code, and phone details are shown; verify important mail by full address.

zh: 输入地址、城市或邮编开始查询
en: Enter an address, city, or code to search

zh: 可以输入城市、网点名称或更具体的地址片段。
en: Enter a city, postal site name, or more specific address fragment.

zh: 可以换更完整的地址关键词，或打开来源页面继续查询「{query}」。
en: Try a fuller address keyword, or open the source page for "{query}".

zh: 当前来源为中国邮政网点查询，结果通常对应具体邮政网点；寄送重要文件前请按完整地址复核。
en: The current source is China Post site lookup, so results usually map to specific postal service sites; verify important mail by full address.

zh: 输入网点名、城市名或更具体的地址片段，更容易定位到可用邮编。
en: Site names, city names, or more specific address fragments make it easier to find a useful code.

zh: 证件、合同、发票等重要邮件请用完整地址和收件单位信息再次确认。
en: For IDs, contracts, invoices, and other important mail, verify with full address and recipient info.

zh: 结果来自中国邮政网点查询页面。若查询结果不完整，请打开来源页面继续核验。
en: Results come from China Post site lookup pages. If results look incomplete, open the source page to verify.

zh: 导入图片二维码内容失败: {error}
图片超过 32MB，二维码化会占用过多内存，请先裁切或用图片压缩页压小后再导入。
en: The image is larger than 32 MB. Crop it or compress it first to avoid high memory use.

zh: 本地生成 QR / Data Matrix / Aztec / PDF417，支持模板、样式、中心图和图片二维码化。
en: Generate QR, Data Matrix, Aztec, and PDF417 locally with templates, styles, center images, and image Data URL payloads.

zh: 选择内容类型后只显示相关输入，减少移动端滚动负担。
en: Only relevant fields are shown for the selected payload type.

zh: 图片二维码化会把缩略图压成 Data URL 写入码内，只适合很小的头像、图标或签名图。
en: Image QR payload embeds a compressed thumbnail as a Data URL. Use it only for tiny avatars, icons, or signatures.

zh: 导入后会自动压缩到约 {p0} 的二维码友好体积；超过 {p1} 的超大源图仍需先裁切或压缩。
en: Imported images are auto-compressed toward a QR-friendly {p0} payload. Sources above {p1} still need cropping or compression first.
{p0}: source {sourceWidth}x{sourceHeight} / {p3}, compressed to {width}x{height} / {p6}, Data URL {p7}, {compressionNote}, SHA {sha256Short}

zh: 已使用最小候选压缩，但仍超过建议体积。若扫码不稳定，请改用中心图模式或继续降低最长边。
en: The smallest candidate still exceeds the target payload. If scanning is unstable, use center-image mode or lower the max side.

zh: QR Code 支持完整样式、容错和中心图；其他二维标准保留高对比预览。
en: QR Code supports full style, error correction, and center images; other 2D standards use high-contrast previews.

zh: 关闭后模块之间有轻微间隔，更柔和但可能降低小尺寸可扫性。
en: Disable for softer gaps between modules; small codes may scan less reliably.

zh: 适合 Logo/头像叠加，不会把图片内容写入二维码。
en: Best for logos or avatars; the image content is not encoded.

zh: 弱纠错 + 大版本 + 强定位保护会给半调画像更多模块密度；抗污损能力更弱，发布前务必实机扫码。
en: Low correction + a larger version + stronger finder protection gives halftone art more module density; scan-test before publishing.

zh: 应用弱纠错定位码 V25
导入图片后会自动压缩为渲染友好的艺术图，再按图片明暗重绘半调轮廓；定位角、时序线和校验信息保持高对比。
en: Imported images are auto-compressed for rendering, then redrawn as halftone QR contours while finder patterns, timing lines, and format areas stay high contrast.

zh: 已自动压缩艺术图，但仍超过建议渲染体积；若预览卡顿，请先裁切源图或换更简单的图片。
en: The art image was compressed but still exceeds the rendering target; crop it or use a simpler image if preview feels slow.

zh: 当前内容超过所选版本/容错可承载范围。
en: Payload is too large for the selected version/correction.

zh: 点选关联关系，称呼会自动算出来。
en: Tap relations and see the title instantly.

zh: 点击下方关联关系开始
结果会在这里实时显示
暂时没有匹配称呼，可以换一条关系试试
en: No title matched yet. Try another relation.

zh: 上方看链路和结果，下方可退格、清空或套用示例。
en: View the chain and result, then backspace, clear, or try an example.

zh: 常用关系放前面，点一下就加入计算器。
en: Common relations are first; one tap adds them.

zh: 用树状节点看清“我”到当前称呼的路径。
en: See the path from me as a compact family tree.

zh: 性别、反向称呼和常用称呼偏好会影响部分结果。
en: Gender, reverse mode, and common-title preference affect some results.

zh: 例如：老婆，用来算“老婆的亲戚”
开启后按反向关系推算称谓。
en: Resolve the chain in reverse direction.

zh: 优先展示更日常、更短的称呼。
先选择一个关联关系再计算。
en: Select at least one relation first.

zh: 未找到可用称呼，请换一条关系试试。
en: No matched title. Try another relation.

zh: 计算失败，请检查关系链是否合法。
en: Calculation failed, please check relationship chain.

zh: 暂无链路。先点击关联关系，家族图谱会在这里同步更新。
en: No chain yet. Tap relations and the family map updates here.

zh: 聚合多个识图来源，统一展示图片信息、来源站点和来源链接。
en: Aggregate linked engines and show unified image info, source site, and source URL entries.

zh: 本地图片优先走百度直传解析，只有在需要公开图片地址时才使用临时上传兜底。
en: Local images prefer direct Baidu upload and parsing. Temporary public upload is used only as fallback.

zh: 预览失败，请重新选择图片。
en: Preview failed. Pick the image again.

zh: 当前聚合百度识图、搜狗识图、Google Lens 和 Yandex Images。
en: Baidu, Sogou, Google Lens, and Yandex are aggregated.

zh: 搜索后会用统一结构展示各搜索源返回的结果。
en: Engine results will be shown in a unified structure after search.

zh: {_successCount}/{length} 个引擎成功，共 {_totalEntries} 条结果{p4}。
未解析到结构化结果，可打开结果页手动查看。
en: No structured entries parsed. Open the result page for manual review.

zh: 如果搜索源策略变化，可直接打开来源页面手动识图。
en: If an engine changes its strategy, open the source page directly for manual search.

zh: 读取文件路径失败，请重试。
en: Failed to read file path. Please retry.

zh: 请先选择图片，或填写一个公开图片地址。
en: Pick an image first, or provide a public image URL.

zh: Google 返回 HTTP {statusCode}。请手动打开结果页。
en: Google returned HTTP {statusCode}. Open the result page manually.

zh: Google 请求超时或失败。请手动打开 Google Lens。
en: Google request timed out or failed. Open Google Lens manually.

zh: 双队计分 + 混合积分模式
用手机屏幕提供可控纯色补光，适合拍照、临时照明和氛围打光。
en: Use the phone screen as a controllable solid fill light for photos, temporary lighting, and soft ambience.

zh: 先调颜色、亮度和色温，再进入沉浸式全屏补光。
en: Tune color, brightness, and warmth before entering immersive full-screen lighting.

zh: 全屏模式会保持屏幕常亮；呼吸模式节奏较慢，避免高频闪烁。
en: Full-screen mode keeps the screen awake; breathing mode is intentionally slow to avoid rapid flashing.

zh: 点击屏幕隐藏或显示控制条。
en: Tap the screen to hide or show controls.

zh: 公开短链服务，兼容性较好，不支持自定义别名。
en: Public short-link service with broad compatibility; no custom alias.

zh: 公开短链服务，支持可用时的自定义别名。
en: Public short-link service with optional custom alias.

zh: is.gd 同源服务，适合备用生成。
en: Sister service of is.gd, useful as a fallback.

zh: 公开 API，响应为 JSON，不支持别名。
en: Public JSON API without custom alias support.

zh: 离线生成本地短码，不是公网可访问短链接。
en: Offline local code; not a public web redirect.

zh: 多服务短链生成、离线短码、重定向链路还原和可复制结果。
en: Generate public short links, create local aliases, and inspect redirect chains.

zh: 输入原始长链接或短链接；生成与还原共用同一输入框。
en: Enter a long URL or a short URL; generation and resolving share this input.

zh: 仅保留字母、数字、短横线和下划线；公开服务可能因占用而失败。
en: Letters, digits, dash, and underscore only; public services may reject taken aliases.

zh: 可省略 https://，会自动补全。
en: You may omit https://; it will be added automatically.

zh: 本地短码仅适合作为记录标签
en: Local alias is a record label only

zh: 共 {redirectCount} 次跳转，最终地址如下。
en: {redirectCount} redirects; final URL is shown below.

zh: 已达到最大跳转层数，最终地址可能仍会继续跳转。
en: Max redirect depth reached; the final URL may still redirect.

zh: 公开短链依赖第三方服务；还原链路只展示 HTTP 跳转，不检查目标页面安全性。
en: Public links depend on third-party services; resolving shows HTTP redirects only and does not audit page safety.

zh: 建议对重要链接保留原始地址；可疑短链请先还原再打开。
en: Keep the original URL for important links; resolve suspicious short links before opening them.

zh: 适合步行、骑行和车内临时测速；精度取决于定位信号。
en: Useful for walking, cycling, and temporary in-vehicle speed checks; accuracy depends on location signal.

zh: 开始后持续读取定位速度，并记录本次里程和最高速度。
en: Start tracking to read location speed continuously and record distance plus max speed.

zh: 定位流不可用，请稍后重试或检查设备定位能力。
en: The location stream is unavailable. Try again later or check device location capability.

zh: 统计字符信息，并在需要时展开自动拆分与逐块复制。
en: Count text and expand auto-splitting only when needed.

zh: 先统计全文；需要时再打开拆分开关生成分块。
en: Count first, then enable splitting when needed.

zh: 关闭时仅统计。打开后可按规则生成可复制分块。
en: Off for counting only. On to generate copyable chunks.

zh: 当前按 {p0} 统计，预计 {length} 块。
按当前计数标准计算，默认 300。
en: Uses the selected metric. Default is 300.

zh: 句末优先模式会尽量在这些符号处截断。
当前按 {p0} 统计，共 {totalEffective} 个有效字符，预计分成 {length} 块。
en: Using {p0}, there are {totalEffective} effective characters in {length} chunk(s).

zh: 输入文本后，这里会生成默认折叠的可复制分块。
en: Collapsed copyable chunks will appear here after input.

zh: 提示: 分块默认折叠，适合长文本快速处理。勾选后会保留划线完成态，方便逐块清理。
en: Tip: chunks stay collapsed by default, and checked chunks keep a done style.

zh: 将中文转成拼音、首字母、简拼和注音。
en: Convert Chinese into pinyin, initials, short pinyin, and zhuyin in one place.

zh: 进行简体与繁体互转，适合搭配拼音和文本清洗使用。
en: Convert between simplified and traditional Chinese for cleanup or publishing.

zh: 阿拉伯数字转罗马数字、中文数字与人民币大写。
en: Turn Arabic numerals into Roman numerals, Chinese numerals, and RMB uppercase.

zh: 晚清史：晚清帝系，时段为 1840-1912。主要内容：宣宗曼宁；（道光1820—1850）；文宗奕泞；（咸丰1850—1861）；醇亲王奕；穆宗载淳；（同治*1861—1875**）；德宗载活；（光绪1875一1908***）；醇亲王载沣；溥仪；（宣统1908—1912****）；咸丰十一年七月二十九日（1861，9，3）定年号为祺祥，十月初五日（11，7）；改年号为同治。；即位之初由慈安、慈禧两宫皇太后垂帘听政，同治十二年一月二十六日（1873，；2，23）亲政。；即位之初由慈禧太后垂帘听政，光绪十五年二月初三日（1889，3，4）亲政;；光绪二十四年八月初六日（1898，9，21）被囚禁，由慈禧太后重新训政。
en: 晚清史：晚清帝系; span 1840-1912. Main contents: 宣宗曼宁；（道光1820—1850）；文宗奕泞；（咸丰1850—1861）；醇亲王奕；穆宗载淳；（同治*1861—1875**）；德宗载活；（光绪1875一1908***）；醇亲王载沣；溥仪；（宣统1908—1912****）；咸丰十一年七月二十九日（1861，9，3）定年号为祺祥，十月初五日（11，7）；改年号为同治。；即位之初由慈安、慈禧两宫皇太后垂帘听政，同治十二年一月二十六日（1873，；2，23）亲政。；即位之初由慈禧太后垂帘听政，光绪十五年二月初三日（1889，3，4）亲政;；光绪二十四年八月初六日（1898，9，21）被囚禁，由慈禧太后重新训政.
History of the Late Qing: Late Qing Treaty Ports

zh: 晚清史：晚清通商口岸，时段为 1842-1911。主要内容：地点；开埠年；条约名称；备注；广州；《中英南京条约》；福州；同上；厦门；宁波；上海；《中俄伊犁塔尔巴哈台通商章；伊犁；程》；塔尔巴哈台；今塔城；台湾；《中俄天津条约》。
en: 晚清史：晚清通商口岸; span 1842-1911. Main contents: 地点；开埠年；条约名称；备注；广州；《中英南京条约》；福州；同上；厦门；宁波；上海；《中俄伊犁塔尔巴哈台通商章；伊犁；程》；塔尔巴哈台；今塔城；台湾；《中俄天津条约》.

zh: 可观测宇宙早期热大爆炸阶段
en: Hot Big Bang era of the observable universe

zh: 现代宇宙学的主流模型认为，可观测宇宙从约 138 亿年前的高温高密状态演化而来。
en: Modern cosmology places the hot, dense early state of the observable universe about 13.8 billion years ago.

zh: 放射性测年和陨石证据支持地球约在 45.4 亿年前形成。
en: Radiometric dating and meteorite evidence support an Earth age of about 4.54 billion years.

zh: 早期微生物生命证据通常被放在约 35 亿年前的时间范围内。
en: Common summaries place early microbial life evidence around 3.5 billion years ago.

zh: 地球大气和海洋中的氧含量显著上升，改变了后续生命演化环境。
en: Atmospheric and ocean oxygen rose substantially, reshaping later biological evolution.

zh: 具有细胞核的真核生物在古元古代到中元古代早期出现，是复杂生命的重要基础。
en: Nucleated eukaryotic cells appeared in the Paleoproterozoic to early Mesoproterozoic, enabling later complex life.

zh: ICS 2024/12 年代表将寒武纪起点置于约 5.388 亿年前。
en: The ICS 2024/12 chart places the start of the Cambrian at about 538.8 Ma.

zh: 植物向陆地扩展，为后续陆生生态系统奠定基础。
en: Plant expansion onto land laid the foundation for later terrestrial ecosystems.

zh: 恐龙在三叠纪晚期出现，并在中生代长期占据重要生态位。
en: Dinosaurs appeared in the Late Triassic and later dominated many Mesozoic ecosystems.

zh: 白垩纪-古近纪灭绝事件
一次大规模灭绝事件终结了非鸟类恐龙时代，并改变了哺乳动物演化格局。
en: A mass extinction ended non-avian dinosaurs and reshaped mammalian evolution.

zh: 人属早期化石通常放在约 280 万年前的时间范围内。
en: Early Homo fossil evidence is commonly placed around 2.8 million years ago.

zh: 奥杜威石器传统是早期人类技术行为的经典证据之一。
en: Oldowan tools are a classic evidence line for early human technological behavior.

zh: 现有化石与遗传证据通常将智人的出现放在约 30 万年前。
en: Current fossil and genetic evidence commonly places Homo sapiens around 300,000 years ago.

zh: 全球冰盖在末次冰期中达到接近最大范围，对人群迁徙和生态环境产生影响。
en: Ice sheets reached near-maximum extent during the last glacial cycle, affecting environments and human movement.

zh: 多地人群逐步驯化植物和动物，定居与食物生产成为重要趋势。
en: Plant and animal domestication developed in multiple regions, making settlement and food production increasingly important.

zh: 青铜冶金和复杂城市社会在多个区域逐步发展。
en: Bronze metallurgy and complex urban societies developed across several regions.

zh: 美索不达米亚楔形文字和埃及象形文字等早期文字系统出现。
en: Early writing systems such as Mesopotamian cuneiform and Egyptian hieroglyphs appeared.

zh: 铁工具和武器的广泛使用改变了农业、战争和社会组织。
en: Widespread iron tools and weapons changed agriculture, warfare, and social organization.

zh: 秦朝完成中国历史上重要的政治统一，并推行标准化制度。
en: The Qin dynasty completed a major political unification in Chinese history and promoted standardization.

zh: 造纸术改进与传播基础
传统记载将蔡伦改进造纸术置于东汉时期，纸张随后成为重要信息载体。
en: Traditional accounts place Cai Lun's papermaking improvements in the Eastern Han, after which paper became a major information medium.

zh: 黑死病席卷欧亚北非多地
en: Black Death across Eurasia and North Africa

zh: 14 世纪中叶的鼠疫大流行造成巨大人口和社会影响。
en: The mid-14th-century plague pandemic caused enormous demographic and social consequences.

zh: 古腾堡印刷技术推动书籍复制成本下降和知识传播加速。
en: Gutenberg-era printing lowered book reproduction costs and accelerated knowledge circulation.

zh: 牛顿系统阐述运动定律和万有引力，成为近代科学的重要里程碑。
en: Newton systematized laws of motion and universal gravitation, a major milestone in modern science.

zh: 机械化生产、化石能源和工厂制度逐步改变经济结构。
en: Mechanized production, fossil energy, and factory systems gradually transformed economies.
On the Origin of Species published

zh: 达尔文的自然选择理论成为现代生物学的核心基础之一。
en: Darwin's theory of natural selection became one of the foundations of modern biology.

zh: 门捷列夫按原子量和性质排列元素，并预测未知元素性质。
en: Mendeleev arranged elements by atomic weight and properties and predicted properties of undiscovered elements.

zh: 第二次世界大战后，联合国作为国际组织正式成立。
en: After World War II, the United Nations was formally established as an international organization.

zh: 沃森和克里克提出 DNA 双螺旋模型，连接遗传学与分子结构。
en: Watson and Crick proposed the DNA double-helix model, linking genetics with molecular structure.

zh: 人类首次在月球表面行走。
en: Humans walked on the Moon for the first time.
World Wide Web becomes publicly available

zh: 万维网将超文本、URL 和互联网连接为大众信息平台。
en: The Web combined hypertext, URLs, and the Internet into a public information platform.

zh: 人类基因组计划完成了人类基因组参考序列的重要阶段。
en: The Human Genome Project completed a major phase of the human reference genome sequence.
First direct detection of gravitational waves

zh: LIGO 首次直接探测到来自双黑洞并合的引力波信号。
en: LIGO directly detected gravitational waves from a binary black-hole merger.

zh: 早期人类控制用火证据
用火改变了取暖、防御、食物处理和迁徙能力，是人类行为演化的重要进程。
en: Fire changed warmth, protection, food processing, and mobility, becoming a major process in human behavioral evolution.

zh: 直立人相关化石和工具记录显示早期人属向非洲以外扩散，是人类迁徙史的重要阶段。
en: Homo erectus fossils and tools mark a major stage in early human dispersal beyond Africa.

zh: 尼安德特人在欧亚多地留下化石、工具和文化行为证据，并与现代人类存在复杂互动。
en: Neanderthals left fossils, tools, and cultural evidence across Eurasia and interacted with modern humans.

zh: 现代人类向非洲以外扩散
en: Major Homo sapiens dispersals beyond Africa

zh: 遗传和考古证据支持现代人类在晚更新世向欧亚和更远地区扩散。
en: Genetic and archaeological evidence supports Late Pleistocene dispersals of modern humans across Eurasia and beyond.

zh: 旧石器时代晚期艺术扩展
洞穴绘画、雕刻和象征性物件显示人类象征表达和社会传播能力的发展。
en: Cave paintings, carvings, and symbolic objects show expanding symbolic expression and social communication.

zh: 哥贝克力石阵等早期仪式遗址
en: Early monumental ritual sites such as Gobekli Tepe

zh: 大型石构遗址显示定居、仪式和组织能力在农业社会成熟前已开始发展。
en: Monumental stone sites show that settlement, ritual, and organization developed before mature farming societies.

zh: 加泰土丘是新石器时代大型聚落代表，体现早期定居生活、建筑和象征文化。
en: Catalhoyuk is a major Neolithic settlement showing early settled life, architecture, and symbolic culture.

zh: 陶器改善了储存、烹饪和定居生活的物质条件，在多地独立或扩散发展。
en: Pottery improved storage, cooking, and settled life and developed independently or through diffusion in multiple regions.

zh: 苏美尔城邦与城市文明
美索不达米亚南部形成城邦、神庙经济、文字管理和复杂城市社会。
en: Southern Mesopotamia developed city-states, temple economies, written administration, and complex urban society.

zh: 尼罗河流域上下埃及统一，形成持续数千年的王朝国家传统。
en: Upper and Lower Egypt unified along the Nile, beginning a dynastic state tradition lasting millennia.

zh: 哈拉帕、摩亨佐-达罗等城市体现规划、排水、贸易和标准化度量体系。
en: Cities such as Harappa and Mohenjo-daro show planning, drainage, trade, and standardized measures.

zh: 巴比伦法典传统展示早期国家治理、法律文本和社会等级秩序。
en: The Babylonian law-code tradition shows early state governance, legal writing, and social hierarchy.

zh: 商代甲骨文是中国早期文字和国家祭祀、王权管理的重要证据。
en: Shang oracle-bone inscriptions are key evidence for early Chinese writing, ritual, and royal administration.

zh: 奥尔梅克是中美洲早期复杂社会代表，其巨石头像和宗教艺术影响深远。
en: The Olmec were an early complex society in Mesoamerica, noted for colossal heads and influential religious art.
Zhou replaces Shang and Mandate of Heaven idea

zh: 周王朝建立后，天命观念成为东亚政治合法性叙事的重要传统。
en: After the Zhou replaced Shang, the Mandate of Heaven became a major East Asian narrative of political legitimacy.

zh: 希腊字母由腓尼基字母发展而来，对地中海文字传统和知识传播产生深远影响。
en: The Greek alphabet developed from Phoenician writing and deeply influenced Mediterranean literacy and knowledge transmission.

zh: 释迦牟尼相关教法在南亚形成，并在后续数世纪传播至亚洲多地。
en: Teachings associated with the Buddha formed in South Asia and later spread widely across Asia.

zh: 孔子思想经后世整理、传承和制度化，深刻影响东亚伦理、教育和政治文化。
en: Confucius' ideas, later compiled and institutionalized, profoundly shaped East Asian ethics, education, and political culture.

zh: 阿契美尼德波斯帝国兴起
波斯帝国建立跨区域行政、道路和贡赋体系，连接西亚、埃及和中亚。
en: The Persian Empire built cross-regional administration, roads, and tribute systems across West Asia, Egypt, and Central Asia.

zh: 雅典政治改革形成公民大会、抽签和陪审等制度传统，是古典民主史的重要节点。
en: Athenian reforms developed assemblies, selection by lot, and juries, a key node in the history of classical democracy.

zh: 罗马共和国形成执政官、元老院和公民政治传统，并为后来的地中海扩张奠定制度基础。
en: The Roman Republic developed consuls, senate traditions, and citizen politics, shaping later Mediterranean expansion.

zh: 阿育王统治与孔雀帝国
阿育王统治时期，孔雀帝国覆盖南亚大片地区，佛教传播和碑铭政治尤为重要。
en: Under Ashoka, the Mauryan Empire covered much of South Asia, with Buddhist patronage and edict inscriptions central to its legacy.

zh: 汉朝整合帝国行政、儒学传统和丝绸之路交流，成为东亚历史核心王朝之一。
en: The Han integrated imperial administration, Confucian traditions, and Silk Road exchange, becoming a core East Asian dynasty.

zh: 奥古斯都建立元首制，罗马从共和国转向帝国政治结构。
en: Augustus established the principate, shifting Rome from republican institutions toward imperial rule.

zh: 耶稣运动和早期教会在罗马帝国境内传播，逐步成为世界主要宗教传统之一。
en: The Jesus movement and early churches spread within the Roman Empire and became one of the world's major religious traditions.

zh: 君士坦丁堡位于欧亚交汇处，成为东罗马/拜占庭政治、宗教和贸易中心。
en: Constantinople, positioned between Europe and Asia, became a political, religious, and trade center of the eastern Roman/Byzantine world.

zh: 希吉拉与伊斯兰共同体
穆罕默德迁徙至麦地那，成为伊斯兰历元和早期穆斯林共同体形成的重要节点。
en: Muhammad's migration to Medina marks the Islamic calendar epoch and a key step in forming the early Muslim community.

zh: 唐朝连接东亚、中亚和海上贸易网络，文学、制度和国际交流高度发展。
en: The Tang linked East Asia, Central Asia, and maritime networks, with highly developed literature, institutions, and exchange.

zh: 查理曼加冕象征西欧拉丁基督教政治秩序重组，对中世纪欧洲影响深远。
en: Charlemagne's coronation symbolized a reorganization of Latin Christian political order in western Europe.

zh: 宋代城市商业、纸币、印刷和技术传播发展，改变东亚经济与知识流通。
en: Song urban commerce, paper money, printing, and technologies reshaped East Asian economy and knowledge circulation.

zh: 十字军运动改变地中海政治、宗教和贸易互动，也加深欧亚文化接触。
en: The Crusades reshaped Mediterranean politics, religion, and trade and intensified Eurasian cultural contacts.

zh: 成吉思汗统一蒙古诸部，随后建立横跨欧亚的帝国网络。
en: Chinggis Khan united Mongol groups, launching an empire-spanning Eurasian network.

zh: 马里帝国统治者曼萨·穆萨朝觐麦加，凸显西非黄金贸易、伊斯兰网络和廷巴克图声望。
en: Mansa Musa's pilgrimage highlighted West African gold trade, Islamic networks, and Timbuktu's prestige.

zh: 明代大型远航连接东南亚、印度洋、阿拉伯海和东非，展示国家级海上动员能力。
en: Ming maritime expeditions connected Southeast Asia, the Indian Ocean, the Arabian Sea, and East Africa.

zh: 奥斯曼帝国攻占君士坦丁堡，拜占庭帝国终结，地中海政治格局改变。
en: The Ottomans captured Constantinople, ending the Byzantine Empire and changing Mediterranean politics.

zh: 大西洋航行开启持续的欧亚非美洲交流、殖民扩张和哥伦布大交换。
en: Atlantic voyages initiated sustained exchange, colonial expansion, and the Columbian Exchange among Afro-Eurasia and the Americas.

zh: 达伽马抵达印度洋贸易网络
en: Vasco da Gama reaches India by sea

zh: 葡萄牙航路将欧洲直接接入印度洋贸易体系，重塑全球海上商业竞争。
en: The Portuguese sea route connected Europe directly to Indian Ocean trade and reshaped global maritime commerce.

zh: 阿兹特克帝国被西班牙征服
en: Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire

zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰陷落后，西班牙殖民统治在墨西哥中部展开。
en: After Tenochtitlan fell, Spanish colonial rule expanded in central Mexico.

zh: 印加帝国被西班牙征服
en: Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire

zh: 印加帝国核心被西班牙征服，安第斯地区殖民秩序逐步形成。
en: The Inca imperial core was conquered by Spain, and colonial order developed across the Andes.

zh: 马丁·路德相关争论引发西欧宗教、政治和印刷传播格局变化。
en: Debates associated with Martin Luther reshaped western European religion, politics, and print communication.

zh: 哥白尼日心说著作出版
《天体运行论》提出日心宇宙模型，成为近代科学革命的重要开端之一。
en: On the Revolutions proposed a heliocentric model and became a major starting point of the Scientific Revolution.

zh: 伽利略发表月面、木星卫星等观测，推动天文学和实验科学方法发展。
en: Galileo published observations of the Moon, Jupiter's moons, and more, advancing astronomy and experimental science.

zh: 三十年战争结束，欧洲国家主权和国际关系秩序出现重要重组。
en: The Thirty Years' War ended, and European sovereignty and international relations were significantly reorganized.

zh: 清朝在北京建立全国统治，成为中国最后一个帝制王朝。
en: The Qing established rule from Beijing and became China's last imperial dynasty.

zh: 英国通过法案禁止奴隶贸易，是跨大西洋奴隶制废除进程中的重要节点。
en: Britain banned the slave trade, a major step in the wider abolition of transatlantic slavery.

zh: 海地革命后建立独立国家，是大西洋世界奴隶制与殖民秩序中的重大转折。
en: After the Haitian Revolution, Haiti became independent, a major turning point in Atlantic slavery and colonial order.

zh: 西班牙和葡萄牙殖民体系在美洲多地瓦解，新的共和国和帝国政治体制出现。
en: Spanish and Portuguese colonial systems broke down across the Americas, producing new republics and imperial arrangements.

zh: 清朝与英国战争后签订《南京条约》，中国近代条约港和帝国主义压力格局形成。
en: After war with Britain, the Treaty of Nanjing opened treaty-port arrangements and intensified imperial pressure on Qing China.

zh: 日本重组政治制度、军队、教育和工业，快速进入现代国家建构进程。
en: Japan reorganized politics, military, education, and industry, rapidly entering modern state-building.
Scramble for Africa and Berlin Conference

zh: 欧洲列强加速殖民瓜分非洲，深刻影响非洲边界、经济和政治结构。
en: European powers accelerated colonial partition of Africa, profoundly shaping borders, economies, and politics.

zh: 清朝帝制终结，中华民国建立，中国政治秩序进入共和与军阀并存的新阶段。
en: The Qing imperial order ended and the Republic of China was founded, ushering in republican and warlord-era politics.

zh: 帝俄政权崩溃，布尔什维克夺取政权，世界社会主义运动和 20 世纪国际政治格局改变。
en: The Russian Empire collapsed, the Bolsheviks seized power, and world socialism and twentieth-century politics were transformed.

zh: 一战后国际联盟成立，代表早期全球集体安全和国际组织实验。
en: After World War I, the League of Nations represented an early experiment in global collective security and international organization.

zh: 英属印度结束殖民统治，印度和巴基斯坦分治，引发大规模迁徙和暴力。
en: British India ended colonial rule and was partitioned into India and Pakistan, causing mass migration and violence.

zh: 中国内战后，中华人民共和国在北京成立，东亚冷战格局随之重组。
en: After the Chinese Civil War, the People's Republic of China was founded in Beijing, reshaping Cold War East Asia.

zh: 罗马条约与欧洲一体化
en: Treaty of Rome and European integration

zh: 欧洲经济共同体建立，为后来的欧盟制度和欧洲一体化奠定基础。
en: The European Economic Community was founded, laying foundations for later European Union institutions and integration.

zh: 加纳成为撒哈拉以南非洲重要的独立国家之一，推动非洲去殖民化浪潮。
en: Ghana became a major independent state in sub-Saharan Africa and helped accelerate African decolonization.

zh: 美国通过民权法案，禁止公共场所和就业中的种族歧视，是民权运动的重要制度成果。
en: The U.S. Civil Rights Act banned discrimination in public accommodations and employment, a key institutional outcome of the civil rights movement.

zh: 高产品种、化肥、灌溉和农业技术推广提高粮食产量，同时带来环境和社会争议。
en: High-yield varieties, fertilizers, irrigation, and farming techniques raised food production while raising environmental and social debates.

zh: 微处理器将计算机中央处理能力集成到芯片上，推动个人计算和嵌入式计算发展。
en: The microprocessor integrated central processing onto a chip, driving personal and embedded computing.

zh: 柏林墙开放象征东欧剧变和冷战秩序瓦解。
en: The opening of the Berlin Wall symbolized the collapse of Eastern Bloc regimes and the Cold War order.

zh: 苏联解体标志冷战结构终结，欧亚政治和全球秩序重组。
en: The Soviet Union dissolved, ending the Cold War structure and reorganizing Eurasian and global politics.

zh: WTO 建立多边贸易规则框架，成为全球化经济治理的重要机构。
en: The WTO established a multilateral trade-rule framework and became a major institution of global economic governance.

zh: 多点触控智能手机和移动互联网平台改变通信、媒体、消费和软件生态。
en: Multi-touch smartphones and mobile internet platforms changed communication, media, consumption, and software ecosystems.

zh: CRISPR 基因编辑方法发展
CRISPR-Cas9 技术成为生物医学和农业研究中的重要基因编辑工具。
en: CRISPR-Cas9 became a major gene-editing tool for biomedical and agricultural research.

zh: 各国达成应对气候变化的国际协定，围绕温升目标、减排承诺和气候治理展开合作。
en: Countries adopted an international climate agreement around temperature targets, emissions pledges, and climate governance.

zh: 新冠疫情成为 21 世纪重大公共卫生危机，改变全球医疗、供应链、工作方式和治理实践。
en: COVID-19 became a major public-health crisis, changing medicine, supply chains, work patterns, and governance practices.

zh: 生成式 AI 大众化
大型语言模型和多模态生成系统进入公众使用，推动教育、软件、媒体和知识工作流程重组。
en: Large language models and multimodal generation systems entered public use, reshaping education, software, media, and knowledge work.

zh: 巴布尔在北印度建立莫卧儿帝国，后续形成南亚重要的帝国行政、艺术和建筑传统。
en: Babur founded the Mughal Empire in North India, later shaping South Asian administration, art, and architecture.

zh: 特许贸易公司成为早期现代商业帝国、殖民治理和全球商品网络的重要载体。
en: A chartered trading company became a vehicle of commercial empire, colonial governance, and global commodity networks.

zh: 江户时代开始，日本进入长期和平、城镇经济扩张和严格身份秩序并存的时期。
en: The Edo period began, combining long peace, urban economic growth, and structured social status orders.

zh: 王权、议会、宗教和军队之间的冲突改变英格兰政治制度和宪政传统。
en: Conflict among crown, Parliament, religion, and army transformed English politics and constitutional tradition.

zh: 英国王权与议会关系重组，权利法案和君主立宪传统获得关键制度基础。
en: Relations between crown and Parliament were reorganized, strengthening constitutional monarchy traditions.

zh: 欧洲、北美、印度和海上战场相互连接，重塑英法殖民竞争和财政压力。
en: Connected theaters in Europe, North America, India, and at sea reshaped imperial competition and state finance.

zh: 北美十三州宣布脱离英国，启发现代共和国、主权和革命政治的新实验。
en: The thirteen colonies declared separation from Britain, launching a modern republican and revolutionary experiment.

zh: 革命挑战旧制度等级和君主权威，推动公民权、民族国家和群众政治扩散。
en: The revolution challenged old-regime hierarchy and monarchy, spreading citizenship, nationalism, and mass politics.

zh: 法国革命战争扩展为欧洲大陆体系重组，影响法律、行政、民族主义和国际秩序。
en: The wars reorganized European power and affected law, administration, nationalism, and international order.

zh: 欧洲列强重建均势体系，形成 19 世纪国际会议外交的重要基础。
en: European powers rebuilt a balance-of-power system and a major basis for nineteenth-century conference diplomacy.

zh: 民族主义、自由主义和社会诉求在欧洲多地爆发，显示工业时代政治动员扩展。
en: Nationalist, liberal, and social demands erupted across Europe, showing expanded industrial-age mobilization.

zh: 马克思和恩格斯的小册子成为社会主义运动、阶级政治和现代思想史的重要文本。
en: The pamphlet by Marx and Engels became a major text in socialism, class politics, and modern intellectual history.

zh: 反英起义后，英国东印度公司统治终结，英属印度转入王冠直接治理。
en: After the anti-British rebellion, Company rule ended and British India moved under direct Crown rule.

zh: 战争围绕联邦、奴隶制和国家未来展开，最终推动奴隶制废除和美国国家重构。
en: The war over Union, slavery, and national future led to abolition and a reconstruction of the United States.

zh: 运河连接地中海和红海，大幅改变欧亚海运、帝国战略和全球贸易路径。
en: The canal linked the Mediterranean and Red Sea, changing Eurasian shipping, imperial strategy, and trade routes.

zh: 普鲁士主导德意志统一，欧洲大国体系和工业军事竞争格局随之改变。
en: Prussia-led unification changed European great-power politics and industrial-military competition.

zh: 受控动力飞行成功开启航空技术时代，改变战争、交通、贸易和全球感知。
en: Controlled powered flight opened the aviation age, changing war, transport, commerce, and global perception.

zh: 工业化总体战摧毁多个帝国，重塑边界、社会动员和国际政治语言。
en: Industrial total war destroyed empires and reshaped borders, mass mobilization, and international politics.

zh: 全球流感大流行造成巨大死亡，成为现代公共卫生和流行病史的重要参照。
en: The global influenza pandemic caused massive mortality and became a major reference in modern public health.

zh: 一战后和约重划欧洲和殖民秩序，同时留下赔款、安全和民族问题争议。
en: The postwar treaty redrew Europe and colonial order while leaving disputes over reparations, security, and nationalism.

zh: 全球经济危机冲击工业社会、贸易、金融和政治制度，推动国家干预政策扩展。
en: The global economic crisis disrupted industry, trade, finance, and politics, expanding state intervention.

zh: 希特勒出任德国总理后，民主制度迅速瓦解，极权统治和侵略政策展开。
en: After Hitler became German chancellor, democracy collapsed rapidly and totalitarian rule and aggression expanded.

zh: 全球战争造成巨大伤亡，重塑国际秩序、殖民体系、科技发展和集体安全制度。
en: The global war caused immense casualties and reshaped international order, colonial systems, technology, and security institutions.

zh: 纳粹德国及其合作者系统性屠杀欧洲犹太人和其他受迫害群体，是现代史重大罪行。
en: Nazi Germany and collaborators systematically murdered European Jews and other persecuted groups.

zh: 会议奠定战后国际货币金融机构框架，推动 IMF 和世界银行体系形成。
en: The conference laid foundations for postwar monetary institutions, including the IMF and World Bank system.

zh: 广岛与长崎原子弹爆炸
en: Atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki

zh: 核武器首次用于战争，开启核时代并深刻改变国际安全、伦理和科技治理。
en: Nuclear weapons were used in war for the first time, opening the nuclear age and transforming security ethics.

zh: 联合国大会通过宣言，形成战后国际人权语言和制度建设的重要基础。
en: The UN General Assembly adopted the declaration, grounding postwar international human-rights language.

zh: 北大西洋公约组织成立
北约成为冷战西方集体防务体系核心机构，并持续影响跨大西洋安全安排。
en: NATO became the core western collective-defense organization of the Cold War and later transatlantic security.

zh: 战争成为冷战亚洲格局的重要节点，朝鲜半岛分裂和军事安全结构延续至今。
en: The war became a major Cold War node in Asia, entrenching Korean division and regional security structures.

zh: 亚非国家会议推动反殖民、和平共处和不结盟政治语言的形成。
en: The Asian-African conference advanced anticolonial, peaceful-coexistence, and nonaligned political language.

zh: 第一颗人造地球卫星开启太空时代，并加速冷战科技、教育和航天竞争。
en: The first artificial satellite opened the space age and accelerated Cold War science and education competition.

zh: 多国在 1960 年独立，非洲去殖民化进入高潮并重塑联合国成员结构。
en: Many African states became independent in 1960, accelerating decolonization and reshaping UN membership.

zh: 美苏核对峙达到危险高峰，危机后军控沟通和核风险管理机制加强。
en: U.S.-Soviet nuclear confrontation peaked dangerously, later strengthening arms-control communication and risk management.

zh: 早期分组交换网络连接研究机构，成为互联网技术谱系中的关键实验。
en: The early packet-switching network connected research institutions and became a key experiment in Internet history.

zh: 联合国大会第 2758 号决议
该决议改变中国在联合国的代表权安排，成为 20 世纪国际组织史的重要节点。
en: The resolution changed China representation arrangements at the UN, a major institutional moment in twentieth-century diplomacy.

zh: 油价冲击改变能源安全、通胀、工业政策和全球南北经济关系。
en: The oil shock changed energy security, inflation, industrial policy, and global economic relationships.

zh: 经济政策转向市场化、开放和工业化，加速中国社会经济结构与全球贸易联系变化。
en: Policy shifted toward markets, opening, and industrialization, accelerating China economic and global trade transformation.

zh: 巴列维王朝结束，伊朗伊斯兰共和国建立，西亚政治和国际关系格局改变。
en: The Pahlavi monarchy ended and the Islamic Republic was founded, changing West Asian and global politics.

zh: 核电站事故造成长期环境和健康影响，也改变核安全、透明度和风险治理实践。
en: The accident caused long-term environmental and health impacts and changed nuclear safety and risk governance.

zh: 南非种族隔离制度终结
南非举行首次多族群普选，种族隔离制度正式结束，民主转型开启。
en: South Africa held its first multiracial election, formally ending apartheid and beginning democratic transition.

zh: 袭击改变美国和全球安全政策，推动反恐战争、航空安检和国际情报合作扩展。
en: The attacks changed U.S. and global security policy, expanding counterterrorism, aviation security, and intelligence cooperation.

zh: 中国加入世界贸易组织
中国加入 WTO 后深度接入多边贸易体系，影响全球制造、供应链和消费市场。
en: China WTO accession deepened integration into multilateral trade, affecting global manufacturing, supply chains, and markets.

zh: 美国次贷危机扩散为全球金融冲击，改变监管、货币政策和公众对金融风险的认识。
en: The U.S. subprime crisis spread globally, changing regulation, monetary policy, and public views of financial risk.

zh: 西亚北非多国抗议和政权危机显示数字传播、青年失业和政治改革压力交织。
en: Protests and regime crises across MENA showed intertwined digital communication, youth unemployment, and reform pressure.

zh: 欧洲核子研究中心实验确认希格斯玻色子，完善粒子物理标准模型的关键环节。
en: CERN experiments confirmed the Higgs boson, a key piece of the Standard Model of particle physics.

zh: 詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜首批图像
韦布望远镜首批科学图像展示深空、星云和系外行星观测能力，开启红外天文学新阶段。
en: JWST first science images showed deep-field, nebula, and exoplanet capabilities, opening a new infrared astronomy phase.

zh: 手斧等阿舍利工具体现早期人属长期稳定的技术传统和空间规划能力。
en: Hand axes and other Acheulean tools show durable early human technical traditions and spatial planning.

zh: 海德堡人常被视为尼安德特人、丹尼索瓦人和现代人类演化谱系中的重要近亲。
en: Homo heidelbergensis is often treated as an important relative in the ancestry of Neanderthals, Denisovans, and modern humans.

zh: 布隆伯斯洞穴象征物证据
刻划赭石和贝壳饰物显示早期现代人象征行为、装饰和社会身份表达。
en: Engraved ochre and shell beads show early modern human symbolic behavior, ornament, and social signaling.

zh: 人类抵达澳大利亚大陆
考古证据显示现代人类很早便跨越海峡进入萨胡尔地区，扩展了全球迁徙范围。
en: Archaeological evidence shows modern humans crossed sea gaps into Sahul early in global dispersal.

zh: 拉斯科壁画是旧石器时代晚期视觉艺术的重要代表，呈现复杂动物图像和洞穴空间组织。
en: Lascaux is a major Upper Paleolithic visual-art site, with complex animal imagery and cave-space organization.

zh: 犬成为人类最早驯化动物之一，参与狩猎、警戒、迁徙和社会生活。
en: Dogs became among the earliest domesticated animals, joining hunting, guarding, mobility, and social life.

zh: 纳图夫文化与半定居生活
黎凡特地区纳图夫文化显示采集狩猎人群的半定居、墓葬和谷物利用趋势。
en: Natufian culture in the Levant shows semi-sedentary foragers, burials, and intensive grain use.
Farming expands in the Fertile Crescent

zh: 小麦、大麦、山羊和绵羊等驯化推动定居村落、储存经济和人口增长。
en: Domesticated wheat, barley, goats, and sheep supported villages, storage economies, and population growth.
Rice domestication and East Asian farming

zh: 稻作农业在长江流域等地区发展，成为东亚社会长期人口承载力的重要基础。
en: Rice farming developed in regions such as the Yangtze basin and became a long-term foundation of East Asian populations.

zh: 轮车与陶轮等技术改变运输、生产和区域交换，是欧亚技术史中的关键节点。
en: Wheeled vehicles and potter wheels changed transport, production, and regional exchange across Eurasia.

zh: 马的驯化增强长距离移动、运输和军事能力，深刻影响欧亚草原与农耕世界互动。
en: Horse domestication strengthened mobility, transport, and warfare, reshaping steppe and farming-world interactions.

zh: 吉萨金字塔群体现古埃及国家动员、工程组织、宗教观念和王权象征。
en: The Giza pyramids show ancient Egyptian state mobilization, engineering, religion, and royal symbolism.

zh: 阿卡德帝国常被视为最早的跨城邦帝国之一，整合美索不达米亚多地政治网络。
en: The Akkadian Empire is often treated as an early inter-city empire integrating Mesopotamian political networks.

zh: 克里特岛宫殿中心和海上网络展示青铜时代爱琴海复杂社会和艺术传统。
en: Cretan palace centers and maritime networks show complex Bronze Age Aegean society and art.

zh: 迈锡尼宫殿、线形文字 B 和武士贵族文化构成希腊青铜时代晚期的重要形态。
en: Mycenaean palaces, Linear B writing, and warrior elites shaped Late Bronze Age Greece.

zh: 东地中海多处宫殿国家瓦解，贸易、战争、气候和迁徙等因素共同重塑区域秩序。
en: Palace states across the eastern Mediterranean collapsed amid trade, war, climate, and migration pressures.

zh: 腓尼基字母通过贸易网络扩散，深刻影响希腊、拉丁和多种后世字母系统。
en: The Phoenician alphabet spread through trade networks and influenced Greek, Latin, and later alphabets.

zh: 周王室权威下降，诸侯竞争和思想流派发展，奠定东亚古典政治文化背景。
en: Zhou royal authority weakened as interstate competition and philosophical traditions developed in ancient China.

zh: 古代奥林匹克运动会传统
奥林匹亚竞技会成为希腊城邦共同宗教、竞技和纪年传统的重要象征。
en: The games at Olympia became a shared Greek symbol of religion, athletics, and chronological tradition.

zh: 传统纪年公元前 753 年
罗马建城传统虽含传说成分，但成为罗马身份、纪年和政治记忆的核心起点。
en: The founding tradition includes legend but became central to Roman identity, chronology, and political memory.

zh: 奥义书文本传统讨论梵、我、轮回和解脱，对南亚宗教哲学产生长期影响。
en: Upanishadic texts explored brahman, atman, rebirth, and liberation, deeply shaping South Asian thought.

zh: 耶路撒冷陷落和流亡经历深刻影响犹太宗教传统、文本整理和共同体身份。
en: The fall of Jerusalem and exile deeply affected Jewish religious tradition, textual formation, and communal identity.

zh: 居鲁士进入巴比伦后，阿契美尼德帝国接管两河核心区，并形成帝国统治叙事。
en: After Cyrus entered Babylon, the Achaemenid Empire took over Mesopotamian cores and shaped imperial rule narratives.

zh: 希腊城邦与波斯帝国的战争重塑爱琴海政治格局，并影响古典希腊自我叙事。
en: Wars between Greek city-states and Persia reshaped Aegean politics and classical Greek self-understanding.

zh: 雅典与斯巴达联盟体系的长期战争削弱希腊城邦，并成为政治史书写经典案例。
en: The long war between Athenian and Spartan alliance systems weakened Greek poleis and became a classic political history case.

zh: 苏格拉底之死成为哲学、城邦法律、公共言论和教育传统讨论中的关键象征。
en: The death of Socrates became a key symbol in debates on philosophy, civic law, speech, and education.

zh: 马其顿扩张连接东地中海、埃及、波斯和中亚，开启广泛的希腊化交流。
en: Macedonian expansion linked the eastern Mediterranean, Egypt, Persia, and Central Asia, launching Hellenistic exchange.

zh: 罗马与迦太基的系列战争确立罗马在西地中海的霸权，并推动共和国扩张。
en: The wars between Rome and Carthage established Roman dominance in the western Mediterranean.

zh: 丝绸之路陆路交流扩展
汉代向西交通与中亚网络结合，推动商品、技术、宗教和外交信息跨欧亚流动。
en: Han westward routes joined Central Asian networks, moving goods, technologies, religions, and diplomacy across Eurasia.

zh: 凯撒遇刺加剧罗马共和国危机，最终推动罗马政治向帝国结构转变。
en: Caesar assassination intensified the Roman Republic crisis and helped push Roman politics toward empire.

zh: 罗马军队攻陷耶路撒冷，第二圣殿被毁，犹太宗教与离散历史进入新阶段。
en: Roman forces captured Jerusalem and destroyed the Second Temple, reshaping Jewish religion and diaspora history.

zh: 贵霜帝国连接欧亚贸易
贵霜帝国控制中亚与北印度关键通道，促进佛教艺术、钱币和商贸传播。
en: The Kushan Empire controlled key Central Asian and North Indian routes, spreading Buddhist art, coinage, and trade.
Three Kingdoms period begins in China

zh: 东汉结束后，魏蜀吴鼎立，长期影响中国政治记忆、军事叙事和文学传统。
en: After the Han, Wei, Shu, and Wu shaped Chinese political memory, military narratives, and literature.

zh: 君士坦丁与李锡尼承认基督徒合法地位，改变罗马帝国宗教政策格局。
en: Constantine and Licinius recognized Christian legal standing, changing Roman imperial religious policy.

zh: 尼西亚会议处理基督论争议并形成信经传统，是早期基督教制度化的重要节点。
en: Nicaea addressed Christological disputes and shaped creedal tradition in early Christian institutional history.

zh: 笈多时期南亚数学、文学、宗教和艺术繁荣，成为古典印度文明的重要阶段。
en: The Gupta era saw major developments in South Asian mathematics, literature, religion, and art.

zh: 西罗马皇帝被废常被作为古代晚期向欧洲中世纪政治结构转变的象征节点。
en: The deposition of the western emperor is often used as a marker of late antique political transformation.

zh: 拜占庭法典整理罗马法传统，对后世欧洲法律教育和民法体系影响深远。
en: The Byzantine codification organized Roman law and deeply influenced later European legal traditions.

zh: 隋朝结束南北长期分裂，重建大一统帝国行政，并开启大运河等工程。
en: The Sui ended long north-south division, rebuilt imperial administration, and launched major canal works.

zh: 倭马亚哈里发王朝建立
倭马亚王朝推动阿拉伯帝国从伊比利亚至中亚的扩张和行政整合。
en: The Umayyads expanded and administered an Arab empire stretching from Iberia toward Central Asia.

zh: 阿拔斯革命与巴格达建都
阿拔斯王朝建立后建都巴格达，推动伊斯兰世界政治、商业和学术网络重组。
en: The Abbasids founded Baghdad and reorganized political, commercial, and scholarly networks in the Islamic world.

zh: 迁都平安京后，日本宫廷文化、文学和贵族政治发展出稳定传统。
en: After the capital moved to Heian-kyo, court culture, literature, and aristocratic politics developed durable forms.

zh: 玛雅低地城市国家发展出碑铭、天文历法、王权建筑和复杂区域竞争。
en: Maya lowland city-states developed inscriptions, astronomy, royal architecture, and regional competition.

zh: 斯堪的纳维亚航海者在欧洲、北大西洋和河流网络中贸易、定居和劫掠。
en: Scandinavian seafarers traded, settled, and raided across Europe, the North Atlantic, and river networks.

zh: 高棉吴哥政治中心依托水利、寺庙建筑和区域权力网络发展。
en: Angkorian centers developed through hydraulic works, temple architecture, and regional power networks.

zh: 查理曼帝国被分割，成为西欧中世纪王国格局演变的重要起点之一。
en: The Carolingian Empire was divided, shaping later medieval kingdom patterns in western Europe.

zh: 罗马公教和东正教传统的分裂加深，影响欧洲和地中海宗教政治格局。
en: The split between Roman Catholic and Eastern Orthodox traditions deepened across European and Mediterranean politics.

zh: 诺曼征服重塑英格兰贵族、土地制度、语言文化和王权结构。
en: The Norman Conquest reshaped English elites, landholding, language, and royal administration.

zh: 石构城址和贸易网络展示南部非洲复杂社会、黄金贸易和区域权力。
en: Stone enclosures and trade networks show complex society, gold trade, and regional power in southern Africa.

zh: 武家政权制度化，日本政治从宫廷贵族主导转向幕府和武士集团长期并存。
en: Warrior government became institutionalized as Japanese politics shifted toward shogunate and samurai power.

zh: 《大宪章》限制王权并确认部分贵族权利，后世成为法治和宪政传统的重要象征。
en: Magna Carta constrained royal power and became an enduring symbol in later rule-of-law traditions.

zh: 蒙古军攻陷巴格达，阿拔斯哈里发在当地的政治中心终结，西亚格局重组。
en: Mongol forces captured Baghdad, ending the local Abbasid political center and reshaping West Asian politics.

zh: 忽必烈建立元朝，蒙古帝国东亚部分转化为中国王朝体制，并连接欧亚网络。
en: Kublai Khan founded the Yuan, transforming the East Asian Mongol realm into a Chinese dynastic state.

zh: 安纳托利亚边疆政权逐步扩展为跨欧亚非三洲的奥斯曼帝国。
en: A frontier polity in Anatolia gradually expanded into the Ottoman Empire across Europe, Asia, and Africa.

zh: 英法长期战争推动王权财政、军事组织和民族政治认同变化。
en: The long Anglo-French war transformed royal finance, military organization, and political identity.

zh: 人文主义、古典文本复兴、艺术赞助和城市经济共同推动欧洲知识与视觉文化转型。
en: Humanism, classical texts, patronage, and urban economies transformed European knowledge and visual culture.

zh: 西班牙与葡萄牙划分海外势力范围，显示早期大西洋殖民扩张的制度化竞争。
en: Spain and Portugal divided overseas spheres, showing institutionalized competition in early Atlantic expansion.

zh: 横屏全屏翻页时钟。轻触可显示设置按钮，3 秒无操作后自动隐藏。
en: Landscape fullscreen flip clock. Tap to reveal a tiny settings button, hidden after 3 seconds.

zh: 进入全屏后会自动横屏、常亮并尽量保持简洁。
en: Fullscreen keeps the screen awake, bright, and landscape.

zh: 调整后立即生效，点空白处可返回时钟。
en: Changes apply immediately. Tap empty space to return.

zh: 输入数字后会实时显示换算结果。
en: Enter a number to see the conversion result live.

zh: 常见证件照尺寸会同时给出英制别名、公制尺寸和指定 DPI 下的像素参考。
en: Common ID photo sizes show their inch alias, metric size, and pixel reference at the selected DPI.

zh: CSS 换算会用当前基准字号计算 rem / em，并保留 96px = 1in 的常见浏览器口径。
en: CSS conversions use the current base font size for rem / em and keep the standard 96px = 1in browser reference.

zh: 长度、重量、温度、力、密度、功率、热量等分类都可双向编辑换算。
en: Length, weight, temperature, force, density, power, heat, and more all support bidirectional conversion.

zh: 覆盖更多常用单位、CSS 尺寸和证件照尺寸参考；既能做日常标量换算，也能处理设计与打印场景。
en: Covers more everyday units, CSS sizing, and ID photo references so it works for both scalar conversions and design or print tasks.

zh: 先选类别，再决定是做普通单位换算，还是查看证件照的尺寸参考。
en: Pick a category first, then either do a normal conversion or inspect ID photo dimensions.

zh: 直接给出英制、公制和像素口径，方便做证件照排版或下单核对。
en: See inch, metric, and pixel references together for print or ordering checks.

zh: 用当前源值快速查看同类里的几个常用单位，适合日常估算。
en: See a few common units from the same category using the current source value.

zh: 输入一个数字后，这里会显示同类常用单位的速览结果。
en: Enter a number and this area will show quick results for common units in the same category.

zh: 证件照里的“寸”通常是市场称呼，页面同时给出英制别名和实际公制尺寸；像素结果按当前 DPI 计算，适合作为排版和打印前核对参考。
en: Chinese ID photo inch names are common market aliases, so the page shows both the inch label and the actual metric size. Pixel values are calculated from the current DPI for layout and print checks.

zh: CSS 里的 rem / em 依赖字号上下文。这里为了便于换算，默认把 em 也按当前基准字号处理；真实页面里如果父级字号不同，结果会跟着变化。
en: In CSS, rem and em depend on font-size context. This calculator treats em with the current base size for convenience; real pages may differ when parent font sizes change.

zh: 当前以本地静态单位表做换算，不依赖网络；温度使用开尔文作中间基准，数据单位同时保留十进制与二进制口径。
en: All conversions run locally with a static unit table. Temperature uses Kelvin as the anchor, and data units keep both decimal and binary conventions.

zh: 统计总字符、符号、去符号、去空白。
趣味编码 + Base64 + MD5 + SHA256 + Morse + 兽语。
en: Fun codes + Base64 + MD5 + SHA256 + Morse + Beast.

zh: 支持长度、重量、温度等常见单位换算。
en: Convert common units including length, weight, and temperature.

zh: 增加生活开销、保险公积金与健康因子。
en: Includes living cost, insurance/fund, and health factor.

zh: 等额本息快速估算月供和总利息。
en: Quickly estimate monthly payments and total interest using equal installments.

zh: 将文本和数字转换为上标或下标样式。
en: Convert text and numbers to superscript or subscript style.

zh: 把提醒节奏、力度和停顿先调清楚，再一键试震，适合找手感或做安静提醒。
en: Shape rhythm, strength, and pauses first, then test the vibration in one tap for quiet alerts or tactile tuning.

zh: 首屏先看预设、能力状态和预计脉冲数量，再决定要不要开震。
en: Start with the preset, capability state, and expected pulse count before triggering the motor.

zh: 准备好后点右下角试震
en: Tap the action button when ready

zh: Android 会优先使用原生波形；不支持的平台会降级为系统轻触感。
en: Android prefers native waveforms; unsupported targets fall back to light system haptics.

zh: 当前设备或运行环境没有可用震动马达，页面只保留节奏预览。
en: This device or runtime has no accessible vibration motor, so only the rhythm preview is available.

zh: 脉冲宽度决定每一下的存在感，间隔决定节奏，循环次数决定总长度。
en: Pulse width controls each hit, gap shapes rhythm, and cycle count sets total length.

zh: 每日首页壁纸，附带原始摄影来源说明。
en: Daily homepage wallpapers with original attribution.

zh: 聚合公开资源页，默认加载 9 张随机壁纸，支持搜索、预览、下载和设置壁纸。
en: Aggregates public sources, loads 9 random wallpapers by default, and supports search, preview, download, and setting wallpaper.

zh: 正在从公开来源获取随机壁纸。
en: Fetching random wallpapers from public sources.

zh: 当前屏幕约 {p0} x {p1} px，可优先匹配接近比例和尺寸的图片。
en: Current screen is about {p0} x {p1} px; matching can prioritize similar ratio and size.

zh: 搜索关键词，例如 nature / city / sky
en: Search keywords, e.g. nature / city / sky

zh: 默认只聚合公开资源链接与运行时图片，不内置第三方壁纸文件；版权和使用范围请以来源页面说明为准。
en: This tool aggregates public links and runtime images without bundling third-party wallpaper files; copyright and usage rights follow each source page.

zh: 预览和下载会复用本地缓存；来源短暂不可用时也会尝试读取已缓存结果。
en: Previews and downloads reuse local cache; cached source results are used when a source is temporarily unavailable.

zh: 来源快照 {sourceSnapshots} 组 · 图片 {imageFiles} 张 · {p2}
部分来源暂时不可用，已保留可访问来源结果。
en: Some sources are temporarily unavailable; available results are still shown.

zh: 请检查网络或直接打开下方来源页面。
en: Check the network or open the source pages below.

zh: 可切换为不限尺寸，或换一个关键词后重新获取。
en: Switch to any size or try another keyword and fetch again.

zh: 壁纸助手当前仅保留 Bing Wallpaper 来源，版权、下载与使用范围以来源页面说明为准。
en: Wallpaper helper now keeps only Bing Wallpaper; rights, downloads, and usage follow the source page.

zh: 当前平台不支持直接设置壁纸，已保留本地缓存文件。
en: This platform does not support direct wallpaper setting; the cached file was kept locally.

zh: 综合工时、环境、收入与生活开销的工作性价比评估。
en: A work value assessment combining hours, environment, income, and living costs.

zh: 先估算每月真实能留下多少钱，再把它放回工作分数里。
en: Estimate real monthly surplus, then feed it into the score.

zh: 工作日越少、通勤越短、休息越可恢复，分母越轻。
en: Fewer workdays, shorter commute, and recoverable breaks reduce the denominator.

zh: 它们会影响健康损耗、环境系数，以及不同职业阶段的薪资预期。
en: These affect health reserve, environment multiplier, and career-stage salary expectations.

zh: 分数适合横向比较 offer，不是财务、医疗或职业建议。
en: Use the score to compare offers, not as financial, medical, or career advice.

zh: 核心口径：标准化日薪 × 环境系数 × 生活现金系数 ÷（35 × 时间成本 × 学历/经验预期）。健康层级会额外估算每月健康损耗预算。
en: Core formula: standardized daily income x environment x cashflow factor / (35 x time cost x education/career expectation). Health tier also reserves monthly health load.

zh: 这些值不是强制标准，只是帮助你快速校准输入。
en: These are calibration hints, not mandatory standards.

zh: 常用城市当前时间、本地时差、办公时段与昼夜状态速查。
en: Check current time, local difference, business hours, and day state across common cities.

zh: 内置常见城市与基础夏令时规则，适合当前时间速查；政策变化、历史时间和极端切换边界请以系统时区或权威时区库为准。
en: Uses built-in common cities and basic daylight-saving rules for current-time lookup; policy changes, historical dates, and edge transitions should be checked with system time zones or an authoritative timezone database.

zh: 无需网络请求，不上传位置信息；本地时差按当前设备时区与城市 UTC 偏移计算。
en: No network request or location upload; local difference is calculated from the current device timezone and each city UTC offset.

zh: 搜索城市、国家、机场缩写或按地区缩小范围。
en: Search by city, country, airport hint, or narrow by region.

zh: 按当地时间排序，适合快速判断今天/明天和是否还能联系。
en: Sorted by local time for quick day-shift and contact timing checks.

zh: 没有匹配城市，试试清空搜索或关闭办公时间筛选。
en: No matching city. Try clearing search or turning off the business-hours filter.

zh: 纯色全屏补光，支持亮度、色温、色板和柔和呼吸模式。
en: Full-screen solid color fill light with brightness, warmth, presets, and a gentle breathing mode.

zh: 基于定位流显示实时速度、最高速度、里程和定位精度。
en: Show live speed, max speed, distance, and GPS accuracy from the location stream.

zh: 相机实时放大，支持变焦、补光灯、冻结画面和摄像头切换。
en: Live camera magnifier with zoom, torch, freeze frame, and camera switching.

zh: 读取环境光传感器，显示 lux、最小/最大值和光照等级。
en: Read the ambient light sensor and show lux, min/max values, and light bands.

zh: 查看系统、屏幕、电量、充电状态、内存和热状态快照。
en: View system, screen, battery, charging, memory, and thermal snapshots.

zh: 支持 GPS 两点距离和基于倾角的近距离估算。
en: Supports GPS two-point distance and tilt-based close-range estimation.

zh: 导入视频，截取指定片段并压缩导出为 GIF。
en: Import a video, trim a selected range, and export a compressed GIF.

zh: 本地创建 ZIP/TAR/GZip/BZip2/XZ 归档，并预览或解压常见归档。
en: Create ZIP, TAR, GZip, BZip2, or XZ archives locally, and preview or extract common archives.

zh: 专业科学计算器，支持表达式、数值积分、导数、极限、方程求根、线性代数和概率计算。
en: Professional scientific calculator for expressions, numerical integrals, derivatives, limits, root solving, linear algebra, and probability.

zh: 女性生理周期辅助工具，估算经期、排卵日、易孕窗口和下次经期。
en: Menstrual cycle assistant for estimating period dates, ovulation, fertile window, and next period.

zh: 浏览、配置并个性化您的健康工具包。
en: Browse, configure, and personalize your wellness toolkit.

zh: 隐藏不常用的工具，重新排列您的收藏，并固定快捷方式。
en: Hide tools you rarely use, reorder your favorites, and pin shortcuts.

zh: 快速访问睡眠、专注、声音和放松工具。
en: Quick access to sleep, focus, sound, and calm tools.

zh: 点击眼睛图标隐藏或恢复。拖动手柄重新排序。置顶条目显示在顶部。
en: Tap the eye icon to hide or restore. Drag the handle to reorder. Pinned entries appear at the top.

zh: 点击任意工具打开。将条目拖到快速面板以实现一键访问。
en: Tap any tool to open it. Drag entries onto the Quick panel for one-tap access.

zh: 隐藏或显示工具以匹配您的日常习惯。
en: Hide or show tools to match your daily routine.

zh: 拖拽调整顺序，常用工具触手可及。
将最常用的工具固定到快速入口面板。
en: Pin your most-used tools to the Quick entry panel.

zh: 隐藏的工具只是隐藏，并未删除——轻点即可恢复。
en: Hidden tools are hidden, not deleted — one tap restores them.

zh: 该工具将在工具箱中隐藏。您可以随时从编辑面板恢复它。
en: This tool will be hidden from the toolbox. You can restore it anytime from the edit panel.

zh: 点击眼睛图标以隐藏或显示工具。拖动手柄以重新排序。
en: Tap the eye icon to hide or show a tool. Drag the handle to reorder.

zh: 所有可用工具当前均可见。要隐藏工具，请点击其名称旁边的眼睛图标。
en: All available tools are currently visible. To hide a tool, tap the eye icon next to its name.

zh: 某些工具当前被隐藏。使用下面的隐藏部分来恢复它们。
en: Some tools are currently hidden. Use the hidden section below to restore them.

zh: {count} 个隐藏工具可恢复显示
点击眼睛图标以恢复隐藏的工具。
en: Tap the eye icon to restore a hidden tool.

zh: 选择一个频率，挑选一个声部，并以自己的慢节奏敲击。
en: Pick a frequency, choose a voice, and tap at your own slow rhythm.

zh: 手动敲击时添加轻脉冲
en: Add a light pulse on manual strike

zh: 释放焦虑与恐惧，让呼吸和身体重新落地，回到稳稳托住自己的根基。
en: Releases anxious tension and helps the body settle into grounded stability.

zh: 松开压抑的情绪结块，让能量重新流动，带回温暖、柔软和生机。
en: Loosens emotional heaviness and restores warmth, softness, and flow.

zh: 著名的"奇迹频率"，带来更清晰的内在中心感，扶起行动力与自信。
en: The well-known miracle tone that brightens the center and lifts confidence.

zh: 促进人与自己、人与外界之间更柔和的联结，适合久听与沉静放松。
en: Softens inner and outer connection, making it especially suited to longer listening.

zh: 清理纷乱思绪，带来通透与轻盈，更自由地表达真实的感受与声音。
en: Clears mental noise and encourages a lighter, freer sense of expression.

zh: 让注意力从外界收回到内在，保持冷静、清澈的观察感与直觉。
en: Draws attention inward and supports calm, lucid observation and intuition.

zh: 收束杂音、回到纯净的精神秩序，适合更冥想、更空灵的停留。
en: Invites a more spacious, meditative stillness with a lighter and more transcendental halo.

zh: 更低、更厚、更靠近身体感，适合夜里、疲惫时或压力沉重的时候。
en: A lower, denser resonance for heavy, tired moments that need deeper grounding.

zh: 像一条柔和的修复带，在低频和中心频率之间架起更平衡的过渡。
en: Feels like a restorative bridge between the lower field and the more centered tones.

zh: 像更慢、更深的一层冥想底床，接地、安静，带着沉稳的归属感。
en: A slower, deeper meditative bed that feels grounded, calm, and belonging.

zh: 与更自然的呼吸和节律贴近，适合当作长时间背景共振慢慢陪伴。
en: A more natural-feeling tuning that settles into longer, softer background resonance.

zh: 空灵清脆，带着更明亮、更通透的泛音边缘。
en: Airy and bright, with a clearer crystalline overtone edge.

zh: 泛音饱满，金属体感更厚，尾音更稳、更宽。
en: Fuller metallic overtones with a broader, steadier tail.

zh: 低沉厚重，下潜感更强，更适合夜晚与深度放松。
en: Lower and weightier, suited to night listening and deep unwinding.

zh: 极简正弦，只保留最核心的频率与朴素的回响。
en: Minimal and pure, focused almost entirely on the core tone.

zh: 敲击碗，让它绽放、扩散并稳定下来。
en: Tap the bowl and let it bloom, spread, and settle.

zh: 十一种自然调谐频率和四种音钵声部，为更柔和、更长时间的聆听体验设计。
en: Eleven nature-tuned frequencies and four bowl voices, shaped for a softer, longer listening session.

zh: 四种可轮换的谐波模式
en: Four harmonic profiles to rotate through

zh: 夜间尝试深层音与 Om / 地球音或 174 Hz。轻松的白天重置时，水晶音配合和音、528 Hz 或 639 Hz 感觉更温和。
en: At night, try Deep with Om / Earth or 174 Hz. For lighter daytime reset sessions, Crystal with Harmony, 528 Hz, or 639 Hz feels gentler.

zh: 手动敲击时添加轻脉冲
en: Add a light pulse on manual strike

zh: 你的个人睡眠指南——评估、追踪和每晚支持。
en: Your personal sleep guide — assessment, tracking, and nightly support.

zh: 收集三晚的数据以解锁个性化模式。
en: Collect 3 nights of data to unlock personalized patterns.

zh: 保存当前排列以便快速重用。
en: Save the current arrangement for quick reuse.

zh: 单曲循环为默认设置。切换到编排模式以在主题和曲目间自动前进。
en: Single loop is the default. Switch to arrangement mode to auto-advance across themes and tracks.

zh: 精选舒缓循环，带呼吸光效，本地曲目，以及移动优先的沉浸式布局。
en: Curated calming loops with breathing light effects, local tracks, and a mobile-first immersive layout.

zh: 选择模式会关闭菜单，并清晰突出当前模式。
en: Selecting a mode closes the menu and keeps the current mode clearly highlighted.

zh: 标记你经常使用的模式，它们将出现在此处，便于快速切换。
en: Mark modes you use often and they will appear here for quick switching.

zh: 一旦你切换或播放几个模式，你的最近历史将显示在这里。
en: Once you switch or play a few modes, your recent history will appear here.

zh: 长尾音的金属钟管，适合明亮慢速旋律。
en: Long ringing metal tubes for bright slow melodies.

zh: 柔和金属延音，适合梦幻和弦。
en: Soft metallic sustain for dreamy chords.

zh: 更低更厚的木质键盘，适合温暖低音线。
en: Lower thicker wooden bars for warm bass lines.

zh: 高音域金属片，声音清脆明亮。
en: High metal bars with crisp bright tone.

zh: 彩虹 12 音木琴，适合儿童敲击感和短旋律。
en: Rainbow 12 note xylophone for playful taps and short melodies.

zh: 材质会影响尾音、混响和视觉管色。
en: Material shapes tail reverb and resonator color.

zh: 腔体会改变共鸣管长度、空间感和敲击收尾。
en: Cavity changes resonator length space and note finish.

zh: 90 度横向排列，沿竖向滑动可扫过琴键。
en: A 90 degree layout lets vertical swipes sweep the bars.

zh: 点击单个彩色琴键，横向扫过可形成明亮音阶。
en: Tap one colored bar or sweep across for a bright run.

zh: 声音优先使用 FluidR3Mono_GM 采样，不支持平台才降级为轻量预览。
en: Sound prioritizes FluidR3Mono_GM samples and falls back only on unsupported platforms.

zh: 精选舒缓循环与呼吸光效，适合放松、阅读和入睡前陪伴。
en: Curated calming loops with breathing light effects for relaxing, reading, or winding down before sleep.

zh: 从竖琴开始演奏，也可切换其他模拟乐器。
en: Start with harp, or switch to other simulated instruments.

zh: 触摸琴键演奏旋律，支持滑奏与音区切换。
en: Play melodies on the keys with glissando and register switching.

zh: 通过触摸与滑动控制气息感和音高变化。
en: Use touch and glide gestures to shape breath and pitch.

zh: 一尺八寸 D 管尺八，五孔布局：前四后一，按孔与气流分列控制。
en: 1.8 D shakuhachi with five holes: four front and one rear, split into hole and air controls.

zh: 用鼓垫触发节奏、底鼓和氛围打击音。
en: Trigger rhythms, kicks, and atmospheric percussion on the pads.

zh: 拨动虚拟琴弦，快速切换和弦与节奏。
en: Strum virtual strings and switch chords or rhythm patterns quickly.

zh: 轻敲三角铁，获得清亮的短促铃音。
en: Tap the triangle for bright, short ringing tones.

zh: 用适合手机的大琴齿演奏清亮短音。
en: Play clear plucked tones on large phone friendly tines.

zh: 默认是儿童彩虹木琴，也可切换排钟、颤音琴、马林巴和钢片琴。
en: Defaults to a rainbow xylophone and can switch to bells vibraphone marimba or glockenspiel.

zh: 监测麦克风输入，观察音量、峰值、音高与音色。
en: Monitor microphone input for level, peak, pitch, and tone.
Tap keys or glide to play

zh: 长按发声，滑动改变音高
en: Hold to play, slide to bend pitch

zh: 左侧按孔，右侧按住滑动控气
en: Left controls holes; right side holds and slides air
Tap to strike, hold to sustain
Tap tines or swipe to play

zh: 轻触琴键或沿排横向扫奏
开启监听后演奏或发声
en: Start monitoring, then play or make sound

zh: 现代五孔尺八与触控气流
en: Modern five-hole fingering and touch air

zh: 混合底鼓、军鼓、镲片与效果
en: Mix kick, snare, hats, and effects

zh: 切换木琴排钟和共鸣材质
en: Switch mallet type and resonance material

zh: 调节前级、门限、亮度与相位
en: Adjust preamp, gate, presence, and phase

zh: 调整音色、音阶、和弦与混响
en: Shape timbre, scale, chord, and reverb

zh: 建议横屏获得更大的演奏区域
en: Landscape is recommended for a larger playing area.

zh: 选择要演奏的乐器。全屏入口在舞台下方。
en: Choose the instrument to play. Full screen is below the stage.

zh: 用节拍、拍号和循环编排保持专注节奏。
en: Keep focus with tempo, meter, and loop arrangements.

zh: 轻触敲击或自动节奏，用于专注与放松。
en: Tap manually or use auto rhythm for focus and relaxation.

zh: 触摸琴键演奏旋律，支持滑奏与音区切换。
en: Play melodies on the keys with glissando and register switching.

zh: 通过触摸与滑动控制气息感和音高变化。
en: Use touch and glide gestures to shape breath and pitch.

zh: 用鼓垫触发节奏、底鼓和氛围打击音。
en: Trigger rhythms, kicks, and atmospheric percussion on the pads.

zh: 拨动虚拟琴弦，快速切换和弦与节奏。
en: Strum virtual strings and switch chords or rhythm patterns quickly.

zh: 轻敲三角铁，获得清亮的短促铃音。
en: Tap the triangle for bright, short ringing tones.

zh: 用实时输入检查乐器拾音和音准。
en: Check instrument pickup and tuning with live input.

zh: 更轻柔的起音和更竹子的音体，适合平静的五声音阶短句。
en: Gentler attacks and a more bamboo-like body for calm pentatonic phrases.

zh: 更明亮的主音色，旋律短句表现力更强。
en: Brighter lead tone with stronger presence for melodic phrases.

zh: 更温暖的中音和更柔和的尾部，用于平静的伴奏层。
en: Warmer midrange and softer tail for calm backing layers.

zh: 自然气息音色，适合温柔流畅的演奏。
en: Natural breathy tone for gentle and flowing play.

zh: 麦克风权限不可用。触摸播放仍可使用。
en: Microphone permission unavailable. Touch play is still available.

zh: 为竖屏手机重建长笛主体、指孔和音符轨道。
en: Rebuild the flute body, finger holes, and note rail for portrait phones.

zh: 一拍一声，低干扰，适合快速进入专注。
en: One click per beat with low distraction for quick focus.

zh: 慢速双细分，适合呼吸、阅读和长时间稳定跟拍。
更快节奏和短段循环，适合收尾冲刺或整理动作。
en: Faster tempo with short sections for closing sprints or cleanup routines.

zh: 模板格式无效，无法应用。
en: Template format is invalid and cannot be applied.

zh: 模板包含非整数拍段，当前版本暂不支持。
en: This template contains non-integer beat segments, which are not supported yet.

zh: 按拍段逐个加减，可插入与删除。
en: Adjust each segment, then insert or delete segments as needed.
Favorite, rename, apply, or delete saved templates.

zh: 还没有模板，可先编辑拍段后点击“保存为模板”。
en: No templates yet. Edit the segments, then tap "Save as template".

zh: 一键切换速度、拍号、细分、音色和视觉，先开始再细调。
更圆润、更柔和，适合慢速琶音和指弹。
en: Rounder and softer for slow arpeggios and finger picking.

zh: 延长闪烁和泛音，用于环境层次。
en: Longer shimmer and overtones for ambient layers.

zh: 清晰的钢核音色，适合节奏扫弦。
en: Clear steel-core tone tuned for rhythmic strumming.

zh: 选择和弦，拨动或扫弦，移动变调夹以提升音色。
en: Pick a chord, pluck or sweep the strings, and move the capo to lift the voicing.

zh: 缩短延音并收紧高频泛音以适应节奏性扫弦。
en: Shortens sustain and tightens upper harmonics for rhythmic strokes.

zh: 垂直滑动以扫弦；点击琴弦弹奏单音。
en: Swipe vertically to strum; tap a string to pluck single notes.

zh: 手机布局保持扫弦界面为主，同时将和声控制移入紧凑行列。
en: The phone layout keeps the strum surface primary and moves harmony controls into compact rows.

zh: 扫弦界面保持主要位置，而和弦、变调夹和音色控制环绕其周围。
en: The strum surface stays primary while chords, capo, and tone controls sit around it.

zh: 共鸣塑造音箱响应，拨片位置调整亮度。
en: Resonance shapes body response and pick position shifts brightness.

zh: 更多的音色主体和更慢的尾音。
清晰的攻击感用于主动拨弦。
细腻的音色和闪亮的高音。
类似踏板竖琴的平衡和延音。
更强的核心音，更明亮的攻击音。
紧凑的瞬态和清晰的音符分离。
en: Tight transient and clear note separation.

zh: 柔和的指弹，带柔和泛音。
圆润音体，控制的大厅尾音。
en: Round body with controlled hall tail.
Tap for single note, swipe for sweep.

zh: 先点击一个音符，然后滑过弦进行扫弦。
en: Tap a note, then glide across strings to sweep.

zh: 音色、音阶、和弦和手感在乐谱中体现。
en: Timbre, scale, chord, and feel live in the sheet.

zh: 阻尼、扫弦死区和和弦根。
en: Damping, sweep deadzone, and chord root.

zh: 攻击更清楚，适合短句和滑扫。
en: Clearer attack for short phrases and swipes.

zh: 更像音乐盒的清亮高频，适合睡前氛围。
en: Music box like sparkle for bedtime ambience.

zh: 圆润木质感，适合慢速放松旋律。
en: Rounded woody tone for slow relaxing melodies.

zh: 五声音阶更容易随手弹出稳定旋律。
en: Pentatonic scales make casual melodies easier.

zh: 大琴齿适合单手点击，横向滑动可连续拨奏。
en: Large tines fit one handed taps and sideways swipes.

zh: 点击单音，横向扫过琴齿可形成轻柔滑奏。
en: Tap notes and sweep across tines for soft glissando.

zh: 预设会同时切换采样音色、共鸣和空间。
en: Presets switch sampled tone resonance and space together.

zh: 适合贴近琴体、桌面或外壳的低噪声拾音。
en: For low-noise pickup close to an instrument body, desk, or shell.

zh: 适合电吉他等磁性拾音输入。
en: For magnetic pickup inputs such as electric guitar.

zh: 适合空气感更强、细节更明亮的输入。
en: Best for airy input with brighter detail.

zh: 适合较强声压和嘈杂环境。
en: Good for higher sound pressure and noisy spaces.

zh: 适合原声乐器桥位或贴片拾音。
en: For bridge or surface pickup on acoustic instruments.

zh: 需要麦克风权限才能监听输入。
en: Microphone permission is required to monitor input.

zh: 点击开始监听，检查输入电平与音高。
en: Tap start monitoring to check level and pitch.

zh: 峰值过高，建议降低前级避免削波。
en: Peak is high; lower preamp to avoid clipping.

zh: 输入偏低，请靠近音源或提高前级。
en: Input is low; move closer or raise preamp.

zh: 开始监听后会显示实时建议。
en: Start monitoring to see live guidance.

zh: 允许麦克风权限后，工具会显示实时电平、峰值、音高和音色。
en: After microphone permission is granted, the tool shows live level, peak, pitch, and tone.

zh: 指南 播放音符正文
指南 调整参数正文
指南 保存预设正文
紧凑显示实时输入状态。
查看电平、峰值、音高、频谱与建议。
en: View level, peak, pitch, spectrum, and guidance.

zh: 按常见拾音场景快速设置输入参数。
en: Set input parameters quickly for common pickup scenarios.

zh: 校准输入灵敏度、噪声门和亮度。
en: Calibrate input gain, noise gate, and presence.

zh: 根据当前拾音方式微调前级、门限、亮度与相位。
en: Fine-tune preamp, gate, presence, and phase for the current pickup type.

zh: 当声音变薄或抵消时，可尝试切换相位反转。
en: If the sound thins out or cancels, try toggling phase reverse.

zh: 进入全屏后使用现代五孔布局和触控气流面板演奏。
en: Enter fullscreen to play with modern five-hole fingering and a touch air panel.

zh: 现代尺八通常是五孔端吹竹管，前四后一；一尺八寸管常以 D 为筒音。
en: Modern shakuhachi is usually an end-blown bamboo flute with five holes, four front and one rear; the 1.8 length is commonly rooted in D.

zh: 尺八原是东亚纵吹管乐器，因管长约一尺八寸得名；唐宋时期随音乐交流传入日本并在当地发展。日本尺八保留五孔端吹竹管形制，江户时期虚无僧以吹禅和本曲传承，近现代又形成琴古、都山等流派与独奏/合奏传统。
en: Shakuhachi began as an East Asian vertical flute named for its 1.8-shaku length; it travelled through China-Japan musical exchange and developed in Japan into a five-hole bamboo end-blown flute. Edo-period komuso used it for suizen and honkyoku while modern schools such as Kinko and Tozan shaped solo and ensemble traditions.

zh: 现代常见尺八为竹制端吹管，吹口有斜切歌口，五个指孔为前四后一。长度以一尺八寸最常见，筒音约 D；更长的管音更低，更短的管音更高。
en: A common modern shakuhachi is a bamboo end-blown flute with an angled blowing edge and five finger holes: four front, one rear. The 1.8 length is the standard D instrument; longer flutes sound lower and shorter flutes sound higher.

zh: 尺八音色带有明显气声、竹管共鸣和边棱噪声，弱吹可近似耳语，强吹会更明亮粗粝。真实演奏会用气口角度、口腔形状、meri/kari 俯仰和半孔改变音高与音色。
en: Its tone includes breath noise, bamboo resonance, and edge turbulence. Soft blowing can feel whisper-like; strong blowing becomes brighter and rougher. Real players shape pitch and color with embouchure, mouth cavity, meri/kari angle, and half-holing.

zh: 基础音列可理解为全按 D，逐步开放得到 F、G、A、C、D。实际尺八不是简单键盘：手指半开、气息强弱、吹口角度和头部俯仰都会让同一指法产生不同音高和色彩。
en: The basic scale can be read as all holes closed for D, then opening holes for F, G, A, C, and D. A real shakuhachi is not a simple keyboard: half holes, breath, embouchure, and head angle make one fingering produce different pitches and colors.

zh: 孔位保持两列竖排：直接按孔仍是临时盖孔，松开即开孔；点击孔上方图钉会把该孔锁定为长按，再点一次解除。右侧按住后持续发声，上下滑动只改变气流强弱，只有松开右侧触点才停止。
en: Holes stay in two vertical columns: press a hole directly for temporary cover and release to open it; tap the pin above a hole to lock it as held then tap again to release. Hold the right panel for continuous air and slide to change intensity. Release the right touch to stop.

zh: 左侧竖直双列模拟现代尺八五孔，上方图钉可锁定长按；右侧按住吹气并上下滑动控制强弱。
en: Left stage uses a vertical two-column five-hole layout; pin a hole above it for hold-lock. Hold the right side for air and slide for intensity.

zh: 在三种本地合成的音色质地之间切换。
en: Switch between three locally synthesized textures.

zh: 高音更柔和，尾部较短，以提供温和的节奏支持。
en: Softer highs and a shorter tail for gentle rhythm support.

zh: 攻击更明亮，共鸣更强，用于强调。
en: Brighter attack and stronger ring to mark accents.

zh: 平衡亮度和衰减，接近管弦乐效果。
en: Balanced brightness and decay close to orchestral behavior.

zh: 左侧更柔和，右侧更明亮；滚动模式创造紧密重复的重音。
en: Left is softer, right is brighter; roll mode creates tight repeated accents.

zh: 预设同时调整音色、材质和默认共鸣长度。
en: Presets move tone, material, and default ring length together.

zh: 直接点击三角形：左边较柔和，右边较亮，模式改变手势输出。
en: Tap directly on the triangle: left is softer, right is brighter, and the mode changes the gesture output.

zh: 材质塑造泛音，而打击点和阻尼控制敲击和尾音。
en: Material shapes overtones while strike point and damping control attack and tail.

zh: 冷色水墨底纹，檀木纹理更克制，适合静坐与夜读。
en: Cool ink texture with restrained sandalwood details.

zh: 暗夜灯影与暖金光晕，重击时更有香火流动感。
en: Lantern-like night glow with warm ritual highlights.

zh: 古寺暖木配色，带轻微金粉与木纹起伏。
en: Warm temple wood palette with subtle golden dust.

zh: 回弹半径更大，击槌抬手更舒展，适合仪式感节奏。
en: Larger rebound radius with a wider return arc.

zh: 回弹半径更短，轨迹收紧，适合稳定而克制的敲击。
en: Shorter rebound radius for a tighter return path.

zh: 先选预设入手，再微调 BPM、拍数与重音，让节律更贴合呼吸。
en: Start with presets, then tune BPM, pulse count, and accents.

zh: 调节共鸣、亮度、音高与击打力度，塑造你自己的木鱼声场。
en: Tune resonance, brightness, pitch, and strike hardness.

zh: 设置每日目标、触感反馈、自动止拍与漂浮愿词，让体验更沉静。
en: Fine tune target, haptics, auto-stop, and floating blessings.

zh: 手动叩击时给出轻微震感，帮助建立节律沉浸。
en: Add subtle vibration to manual strikes.

zh: 自动节拍达到目标数后自动停下，便于结束当次修持。
en: Stop auto rhythm once the target is reached.

zh: 轻触一叩，长按连击；亦可启拍，让呼吸与节律自然归一。
en: Tap to strike, hold to roll, or start auto mode for stable pulse.

zh: 细密金砂与平行底纹，适合慢慢梳理呼吸和注意力。
en: Fine golden grains with calm parallel base lines.

zh: 轻海雾与退潮纹路，更适合波纹和留白构图。
en: Shoreline contours with sea-mist light and softer rhythm.

zh: 冷灰砂面与环形静波，适合极简景石布局。
en: Cool ash-grey sand with orbital ripples for stone layouts.

zh: 微暖陶土调，适合更柔和的指尖与抚平笔触。
en: Warm clay tones for softer fingertip and smoothing trails.

zh: 拖动画出多齿沙纹，用来建立秩序感和节奏。
en: Drag multi-prong grooves to build rhythm and order.

zh: 更宽更柔的单线笔触，像手指轻轻划过沙面。
en: A wider single groove like tracing the tray by hand.

zh: 用可调色颜料做涂抹和涂鸦，适合创作主题色层。
en: Lay down colored pigment for doodles and themed accents.

zh: 半透明水痕会顺着路径铺开，适合做流动质感。
en: Spread translucent water trails for a fluid texture.

zh: 生成起伏曲线，适合呼吸节奏与水波感。
en: Paint rhythmic waves for breathing and water-like motion.

zh: 宽面推开沙层，在两侧留下起伏堆线。
en: Push sand aside with a broad shovel and raised banks.

zh: 沿着笔迹堆出颗粒沙砾，适合铺路与点缀。
en: Build granular gravel trails for paths and texture accents.

zh: 局部抚平已有痕迹，让沙面重新安静下来。
en: Calm a local area and restore a quieter surface.

zh: 轻点安放景石，为画面建立重心和留白。
en: Tap to place stones and set a visual anchor.

zh: 从舒缓波纹起笔，适合睡前放松、慢速呼吸和单手描摹。
en: Start from soft tidal waves for bedtime unwinding and slow breathing.

zh: 先摆重心石，再沿石旁留白，适合安静构图和减压。
en: Place anchor stones first, then leave calm space around them.

zh: 先铺一条水痕小径，再补砂砾与石点，适合做流动层次。
en: Lay down a damp path first, then add gravel and stones for flow.

zh: 用规律耙纹和中轴构图稳住视线，适合短时专注重置。
en: Use rhythmic rake furrows and a stable centerline for quick refocus.

zh: 这会移除所有笔触和景石，但会保留当前场景和工具设置。
en: This removes all strokes and stones but keeps the current scene and tool setup.
Use this preset on the current tray?

zh: 可以直接替换当前沙盘，也可以把预设作为新一层叠加到现有构图上。
en: You can replace the current tray or layer the preset on top of the existing composition.

zh: 先用一个构图预设起笔，再继续手工修整，移动端会更容易进入状态。
en: Start from a guided composition, then keep shaping it by hand on mobile.

zh: 不同底纹会改变沙面的情绪和层次。
en: Different base patterns change the tray mood and visual rhythm.

zh: 调整笔触宽度、切换工具，并管理触感反馈。
en: Adjust stroke width, switch tools, and manage tactile feedback.

zh: 切换工具、落石和撤销时给出轻微振动。
en: Adds light feedback when switching tools, placing stones, and undoing.

zh: 在画布上显示当前工具的手势说明。
en: Shows contextual hints for the active tool.

zh: 给木耙、水迹、沙铲和景石加入轻柔摩擦声，连续拖动时会自动节流。
en: Adds gentle rake, water, shovel, and stone textures with throttled playback during drags.

zh: 可以直接从接触点落笔，或把笔尖上移一段距离，减少手指遮挡。
en: Draw directly from the contact point or lift the tip upward so your finger covers less of the mark.

zh: 单指负责绘制或落石，双指负责缩放和平移；如果想避开手指遮挡，可以切到上移笔尖。
en: Single-finger input keeps drawing or placing stones, while two fingers handle zoom and pan for detail work.

zh: 画布保持全屏，常用操作收在这里。
en: Keep the tray full screen; controls stay folded here.

zh: 像在沙面上作画一样，自由涂鸦、铺陈留白、安放景石。
en: Sketch freely as if drawing on sand, leaving space and placing stones.

zh: 拖动即可留下连续沙纹。
en: Drag to leave continuous sand trails.

zh: 空白沙盘也可以直接画；预设只是帮你更快进入手感。
en: Blank trays are welcome too. Presets simply get you into the flow faster.

zh: 单指绘制，双指缩放/平移
en: One finger draws, two fingers zoom/pan

zh: 双指已识别，停顿后进入缩放/平移
en: Two fingers detected. Hold briefly to zoom/pan

zh: 折叠查看全部工具，避免在手机上反复横向滑动。
en: Open the folded tool drawer instead of swiping through everything on mobile.

zh: 快速调笔触宽度，并预览当前工具在沙面上的表现。
en: Tune brush size and preview how the active tool behaves on sand.

zh: 把触感、持续音效和触点锚定集中到一个折叠卡片里。
en: Keep haptics, continuous sand audio, and touch anchoring in one folded card.

zh: 拖动时持续播放沙沙底噪，停手即停。
en: Keeps a continuous sand texture running while you drag and stops as soon as you lift.

zh: 按画布相对尺寸自适应对齐，可直接贴合触点，也可把笔尖抬到手指上方。
en: The anchor now adapts relative to canvas size, so you can draw right under the touch or lift the tip above your finger.

zh: 把缩放、视角和沉浸模式也收进折叠卡片里。
en: Keep zoom, view reset, and immersive mode inside a folded card as well.

zh: 单指绘制或落石，双指缩放和平移；水迹长按会继续向周围积湿加深。
en: Use one finger for drawing or stones and two fingers for zoom/pan; holding the water tool keeps building damp diffusion.

zh: 点击套用，可替换或叠加。
en: Tap to apply, replace, or layer.

zh: 阿里百炼识别会把录音作为音频输入发送到 DashScope 多模态接口。
en: Ali Bailian recognition sends the recording as audio input to the DashScope multimodal endpoint.

zh: 豆包识别会把录音作为音频输入发送到火山方舟 Responses 接口。
en: Doubao recognition sends the recording as audio input to the Volcano Ark Responses endpoint.

zh: 统一配置本地朗读、远程 TTS、模型、音色和语言。
en: Configure local reading, remote TTS, models, voices, and languages in one place.

zh: 先选 provider，再选可用于 TTS 的模型、语言和该模型支持的音色。
en: Choose the provider first, then a TTS-capable model, language, and a supported voice for that model.

zh: 使用系统或本机 TTS 音色。
en: Use a system or device TTS voice.

zh: 调整后立即试听当前发音效果。
en: Preview pronunciation immediately after changing settings.

zh: 当前没有可试听的单词
调整朗读语速和音量，播放页会同步使用。
en: Adjust reading speed and volume; the playback page uses the same values.

zh: 复用已下载的远程音频，减少重复请求。
en: Reuse downloaded remote audio to reduce repeated API calls.

zh: 启用本地 API 语音缓存
模型刷新只保留 TTS 候选；不同平台的音色不会混用。
en: Model refresh keeps only TTS candidates; voices are not shared across providers.

zh: 例如：温柔、低声、适合睡前复习。阿里按提示词传入；豆包按 emotion 字段透传。
en: Example: gentle, quiet, suitable for bedtime review. Aliyun receives it as an instruction; Doubao receives it through the emotion field.

zh: 豆包 TTS 需要 App ID 与访问令牌；模型字段对应火山语音 cluster。
en: Doubao TTS needs an App ID and access token; the model field maps to the Volcano speech cluster.

zh: 自定义 TTS 需要 API Key 与 Base URL；模型和音色需由服务端支持。
en: Custom TTS needs an API key and base URL; models and voices must be supported by the server.

zh: 远程 TTS 需要 API Key；模型拉取失败时仍可手动输入模型 ID。
en: Remote TTS requires an API key; if model fetching fails, you can still enter a model ID manually.

zh: 将本地声音、下载内容和预设保存在一起以便更快切换。
en: Keep local sounds, downloads, and presets together for faster switching.

zh: 已启用 {enabledCount} 环境音。将此混音保存为预设以便快速调用。
en: {enabledCount} ambient sounds enabled. Save this mix as a preset for quick recall.

zh: 开启。一次静音所有环境音源。
en: On. Mute every ambient source at once.

zh: 关闭。启用时恢复当前混音。
en: Off. Restore the current mix when enabled.
Download failed. Please try again later.
Delete failed. Please try again later.

zh: 从远程库下载环境声音并缓存在本地以便立即重用。
en: Download ambient sounds from the remote library and cache them locally for instant reuse.

zh: 更平静的视觉效果，专注于播放和环境声音。
en: Calmer visuals centered on playback and ambient sound.

zh: 为搜索、浏览和练习提供更高的信息密度。
en: Sharper information density for search, browsing, and practice.

zh: 先选好语言、主题和常用场景；权限会在你使用对应功能时再按需申请。
en: Choose language, theme, and common scenarios first. Permissions are requested later only when a matching feature needs them.

zh: 这些设置会立即保存，之后也可在设置中心修改。
en: These settings are saved now and can be changed later in Settings.

zh: 本引导不会主动申请权限；当前应用权限均与具体功能绑定，可按需开启。
en: This guide does not request permissions. Current app permissions are optional and tied to specific features.

zh: 应用基础浏览、学习和多数工具不需要先授予系统权限。
en: Basic browsing, learning, and most tools work without granting system permissions first.

zh: 用于语音输入、跟读评测、听力和声音测试等需要录音的功能。
en: Used for voice input, pronunciation practice, hearing checks, and sound tools that need recording.

zh: 用于把语音转成文本；仅在你选择系统识别或语音输入时触发。
en: Used to turn speech into text, only when you choose system recognition or voice input.

zh: 用于量角器相机背景、图片和证件照等需要拍摄或预览的实用工具。
en: Used by utility tools that need live preview or capture, such as the protractor background and photo tools.

zh: 用于附近地点地图、天气等需要当前位置的功能，可使用大致位置。
en: Used by nearby-place maps, weather, and features that need your current area. Approximate location is enough.

zh: 用于将待办提醒同步到系统日历，并在你关闭同步时移除对应事件。
en: Used to sync todo reminders into the system calendar and remove the matching events when sync is turned off.

zh: 用于待办提醒、假来电提醒、全屏提醒、振动、唤醒和开机后恢复提醒。
en: Used for todo reminders, fake-call reminders, full-screen alerts, vibration, wake, and restoring reminders after startup.

zh: 用于导入导出单词本、备份、选择图片或音频、选择背景和保存工具结果。
en: Used to import or export wordbooks, make backups, pick images or audio, choose backgrounds, and save tool results.

zh: 用于天气、地图、在线语音、在线音景资源、壁纸和用户主动配置的外部服务。
en: Used for weather, maps, online speech, online ambient resources, wallpapers, and external services you configure yourself.

zh: 用于声音工具在你启用时临时调整系统音量。
en: Used by sound tools to temporarily adjust system volume when you enable that behavior.

zh: 用于壁纸工具在你确认后把生成或下载的图片设为系统壁纸。
en: Used by the wallpaper tool to set a generated or downloaded image as system wallpaper after you confirm.

zh: 默认本地优先，没有账号或云端同步。
en: Local-first by default, with no account or cloud sync.

zh: 应用自身没有自有远端服务、账号系统或遥测；不会主动收集、上传或售卖你的使用信息。
en: The app has no own remote service, account system, or telemetry. It does not actively collect, upload, or sell your usage information.

zh: 当你主动使用联网功能时，请求只发往对应公开资源或你配置的第三方/API 服务；本应用不接收这些数据。
en: When you actively use online features, requests go only to the public resource or third-party/API service you configured. This app does not receive that data.

zh: 选择一个或多个使用场景，应用会先启用相关模块；之后可在模块管理中调整。
en: Select one or more scenarios to enable related modules first. You can adjust them later in Module Management.

zh: 在不离开当前页面的情况下查看队列和快速工具。
en: Review queue and quick tools without leaving the current page.

zh: 当前范围内没有队列项目可用。
en: No queue items available in the current scope.

zh: 你有 {weakCount} 个最近的薄弱单词。建议接下来练习。
en: You have {weakCount} recent weak words. Practice is recommended next.

zh: 你可以继续练习或返回单词本。
en: You can continue in Practice or return to the Library.

zh: 睡眠定时器已启用：将在约 {minutes} 分钟后停止
en: Sleep timer enabled: stop in about {minutes} min

zh: 播放被睡眠计时器停止
播放将在 {durationInMinutes} 分钟后停止
大词汇书可能会继续播放一段时间。
en: Playback may continue for a while on large wordbooks.

zh: 切换词书或加载当前词书
en: Switch wordbook or load the current one

zh: 已选中《{wordbook}》。列表可轻量浏览；播放或练习前会完整加载 {count} 个单词
en: Selected {wordbook}. Browsing uses a light list. Playback or practice will load {count} words first

zh: 首次打开会初始化这个内置词书
en: This built-in wordbook initializes on first open

zh: 当前搜索没有匹配结果
当前词书已加载：{count} 个单词
《{wordbook}》包含 {count} 个单词。首次打开可能需要一点时间。确认后切换
en: {wordbook} contains {count} words. The first load may take a little time. Confirm to switch
Recall first, then reveal the answer.

zh: 从核心字段开始，然后仅在需要时扩展使用和辅助部分。
en: Start with the core fields, then expand usage and supporting sections only when needed.

zh: 阿里百炼默认使用 DashScope 语音模型；Qwen TTS Instruct 会用语速指令贴近当前朗读速度。
en: Ali Bailian uses DashScope speech models by default; Qwen TTS Instruct receives a speed instruction matching the current reading speed.

zh: 豆包语音合成需要 App ID 与访问令牌；模型字段对应火山语音 cluster。
en: Doubao TTS requires an App ID and access token; the model field maps to the Volcano speech cluster.

zh: 自定义 TTS 需提供 OpenAI 兼容 Base URL、模型 ID、音色 ID 和 API Key。
en: Custom TTS needs an OpenAI-compatible base URL, model ID, voice ID, and API key.

zh: SiliconFlow 使用 OpenAI 兼容的 /audio/speech 接口；模型与音色需由当前账号支持。
en: SiliconFlow uses an OpenAI-compatible /audio/speech endpoint; models and voices must be supported by your account.

zh: 自定义 ASR 需提供 OpenAI 兼容 Base URL、模型 ID 和 API Key。
en: Custom ASR needs an OpenAI-compatible base URL, model ID, and API key.

zh: SiliconFlow 使用 OpenAI 兼容的 /audio/transcriptions 接口，适合跟读识别与语音输入。
en: SiliconFlow uses an OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions endpoint for follow-along recognition and voice input.
